import 'package:wissal/features/auth/login/services/auth_service.dart';
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  RealtimeHub — Production-Grade
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

enum RealtimeStatus { connecting, connected, disconnected }

final realtimeStatusProvider = StateProvider<RealtimeStatus>(
  (ref) => RealtimeStatus.connecting,
);

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  Providers
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

final merchantOrdersProvider =
    StateNotifierProvider<_OrdersNotifier, List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
  (ref) => _OrdersNotifier(),
);

final realtimeNotifsProvider =
    StateNotifierProvider<_NotificationsNotifier, List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
  (ref) => _NotificationsNotifier(),
);

final unreadCountProvider = Provider<int>((ref) {
  return ref
      .watch(realtimeNotifsProvider)
      .where((n) => n['is_read'] == false)
      .length;
});

final realtimeProductsProvider =
    StateNotifierProvider<_ProductsNotifier, List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
  (ref) => _ProductsNotifier(),
);

final realtimeCategoriesProvider =
    StateNotifierProvider<_CategoriesNotifier, List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
  (ref) => _CategoriesNotifier(),
);

final realtimeBrandsProvider =
    StateNotifierProvider<_BrandsNotifier, List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
  (ref) => _BrandsNotifier(),
);

// ══ Driver — الطلبات المؤكدة غير المسندة ══
final realtimeConfirmedOrdersProvider =
    StateNotifierProvider<_ConfirmedOrdersNotifier, List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
  (ref) => _ConfirmedOrdersNotifier(),
);

// ══ Driver — طلباته هو (shipped) ══
final realtimeMyShippedOrdersProvider =
    StateNotifierProvider<_MyShippedOrdersNotifier, List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
  (ref) => _MyShippedOrdersNotifier(),
);

// ══ Driver — callback عند وصول طلب جديد ══
final driverNewOrderCallbackProvider =
    StateProvider<void Function(String, Map<String, dynamic>)?>((_) => null);

Future<T?> _silently<T>(
  Future<T> Function() task, {
  String tag = 'hub',
}) async {
  try {
    return await task();
  } on FirebaseException catch (e, st) {
    if (e.code == 'permission-denied') {
      debugPrint(
          '🚨 [$tag] PERMISSION DENIED — راجع Firestore Rules: ${e.message}');
    } else {
      if (kDebugMode) {
        debugPrint('⚠️ [$tag] Firebase error (${e.code}): ${e.message}');
      }
    }
    if (!kIsWeb) {
      FirebaseCrashlytics.instance.recordError(
        e,
        st,
        reason: 'Firebase error in RealtimeHub [$tag] (${e.code})',
        fatal: false,
      );
    }
    return null;
  } catch (e, st) {
    if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('⚠️ [$tag] silent error: $e');
    if (!kIsWeb) {
      FirebaseCrashlytics.instance.recordError(
        e,
        st,
        reason: 'Silent error in RealtimeHub [$tag]',
        fatal: false,
      );
    }
    return null;
  }
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  الخدمة الرئيسية — Singleton
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
class RealtimeHub {
  static final RealtimeHub _instance = RealtimeHub._();
  factory RealtimeHub() => _instance;
  RealtimeHub._();

  final _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;
  final List<StreamSubscription> _userSubs = [];
  StreamSubscription<bool>? _connectivitySub;
  ProviderContainer? _container;
  ProviderContainer? get container => _container;
  bool _initialized = false;
  Timer? _reconnectTimer;
  Timer? _heartbeatTimer;
  int reconnectAttempts = 0;
  bool _lastKnownNetworkState = true;

  static const int _productsPageSize = 100;

  StreamSubscription? _profileSub;
  StreamSubscription? _notificationsSub;
  StreamSubscription? _broadcastSub;
  StreamSubscription? _categoriesSub;
  StreamSubscription? _brandsSub;
  StreamSubscription? _productsSub;
  Future<void> _startForUserLock = Future.value();
  String? _activeUserId;
  String? _activeUserRole;
  bool _isRestarting = false;

  // ── التهيئة ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  void init(ProviderContainer container) {
    if (_initialized) return;
    _initialized = true;
    _container = container;

    _container?.read(realtimeStatusProvider.notifier).state =
        RealtimeStatus.connected;

    final userId = AppStorage.userId ?? '';
    if (userId.isNotEmpty) {
      unawaited(
        startForUser(
          userId,
          role: AppStorage.userRole ?? 'merchant',
        ),
      );
    }

    _startHeartbeat();

    _connectivitySub ??=
        ConnectivityHelper.onConnectivityChanged.listen((hasNet) {
      final wasOffline = !_lastKnownNetworkState;
      _lastKnownNetworkState = hasNet;
      if (hasNet && wasOffline && _initialized) {
        reconnectAttempts = 0;
        restart();
      }
    });
  }

  void _startHeartbeat() {
    _heartbeatTimer?.cancel();
  }

// ── قنوات المستخدم مع قفل الحماية والاستعادة الذاتية للحاوية ────────────────────────
  Future<void> startForUser(
    String userId, {
    String role = 'merchant',
    ProviderContainer? container,
  }) async {
    if (userId.isEmpty) return;

    // 🔒 استعادة ذاتية فورية: التقاط الحاوية من الوسيط أو من شجرة التطبيق إذا فُقدت بعد الخروج
    if (container != null) {
      _container = container;
    } else if (_container == null) {
      final navCtx = NotificationService.navigatorKey.currentContext;
      if (navCtx != null) {
        try {
          _container = ProviderScope.containerOf(navCtx);
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }

    final normalizedRole = role.toLowerCase().trim();
    bool isCatalogReady() {
      final needsCatalog = normalizedRole == 'merchant' && AppStorage.isActive;
      return !needsCatalog ||
          (_categoriesSub != null &&
              _brandsSub != null &&
              _productsSub != null);
    }

    if (_activeUserId == userId &&
        _activeUserRole == normalizedRole &&
        _userSubs.isNotEmpty &&
        isCatalogReady() &&
        _initialized) {
      return;
    }

    final prevLock = _startForUserLock;
    final completer = Completer<void>();
    _startForUserLock = completer.future;

    try {
      await prevLock;
    } catch (_) {}

    try {
      if (_activeUserId == userId &&
          _activeUserRole == normalizedRole &&
          _userSubs.isNotEmpty &&
          isCatalogReady() &&
          _initialized) {
        return;
      }
      _initialized = true;
      _setConnected();
      _startHeartbeat();

      _connectivitySub ??=
          ConnectivityHelper.onConnectivityChanged.listen((hasNet) {
        final wasOffline = !_lastKnownNetworkState;
        _lastKnownNetworkState = hasNet;
        if (hasNet && wasOffline && _initialized) {
          reconnectAttempts = 0;
          restart();
        }
      });

      await _stopUserChannels();

      _activeUserId = userId;
      _activeUserRole = normalizedRole;

      _startUserChannels(
        userId,
        role: normalizedRole,
      );
    } finally {
      completer.complete();
    }
  }

  void _startUserChannels(String userId, {required String role}) {
    if (role == 'merchant' && AppStorage.isActive) {
      if (_categoriesSub == null) _watchCategories();
      if (_brandsSub == null) _watchBrands();
      if (_productsSub == null) _watchProducts();
    } else {
      unawaited(_stopCatalogChannels());
    }

    _profileSub?.cancel();
    if (_profileSub != null) {
      _userSubs.remove(_profileSub);
      _profileSub = null;
    }
    _profileSub =
        _db.collection('profiles').doc(userId).snapshots().listen((doc) async {
      if (!_initialized || AppStorage.userId != userId) return;
      if (!doc.exists || doc.data() == null) return;
      final data = doc.data()!;
      final isBanned = data['is_banned'] == true;
      final isActive = data['is_active'] as bool? ?? false;
      final newRole = (data['role'] as String?)?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? role;
      final bool wasInactive = !AppStorage.isActive;

      await AppStorage.setIsBanned(isBanned);
      await AppStorage.setIsActive(isActive);
      if (isBanned || (!isActive && data['account_status'] != 'pending')) {
        final navContext = NotificationService.navigatorKey.currentContext;
        final container = _container;

        await resetOnSignOut();
        if (container != null) {
          try {
            container.read(cartProvider.notifier).clear();
            container.invalidate(cartProvider);
            container.invalidate(realtimeNotifsProvider);
            container.invalidate(merchantOrdersProvider);
            container.invalidate(realtimeConfirmedOrdersProvider);
            container.invalidate(realtimeMyShippedOrdersProvider);
            container.invalidate(driverNewOrderCallbackProvider);
          } catch (_) {}
        }
        try {
          await NotificationService.instance
              .detachTokenFromFirestore(userId)
              .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 3));
        } catch (_) {}
        try {
          await AppCache.instance.clearAll();
        } catch (_) {}
        await FirebaseAuth.instance.signOut();
        await AppStorage.clearUserData();
        if (navContext != null && navContext.mounted) {
          WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
            if (navContext.mounted) {
              navContext.go('/login');
            }
          });
        }
        return;
      }
      if (wasInactive && isActive) {
        String verifiedRole = 'merchant';
        try {
          final tokenResult = await FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser
              ?.getIdTokenResult(true)
              .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));
          if (tokenResult?.claims?['is_banned'] == true) {
            await AuthService().signOut(container: _container);
            final navContext = NotificationService.navigatorKey.currentContext;
            if (navContext != null && navContext.mounted) {
              navContext.go('/login');
            }
            return;
          }
          verifiedRole = AuthService.resolveVerifiedRole(
            docRole: newRole,
            claimsRole: tokenResult?.claims?['role']?.toString(),
          );
        } on FirebaseAuthException catch (e) {
          if (e.code == 'user-token-revoked' || e.code == 'user-disabled') {
            await AuthService().signOut(container: _container);
            final navContext = NotificationService.navigatorKey.currentContext;
            if (navContext != null && navContext.mounted) {
              navContext.go('/login');
            }
            return;
          }
          verifiedRole = 'merchant';
        } catch (_) {
          verifiedRole = 'merchant';
        }

        await AppStorage.setIsActive(true);
        await AppStorage.saveUserData(
          userId: userId,
          role: verifiedRole,
          name: data['full_name'] as String?,
          storeName: data['store_name'] as String?,
          phone: data['phone_number'] as String?,
        );
        unawaited(NotificationService.instance.saveTokenToFirestore(userId));
        _activeUserRole = null;
        Future.microtask(() async {
          if (AppStorage.userId == userId && _initialized) {
            await startForUser(userId, role: verifiedRole);
          }
        });

        final targetRoute = switch (verifiedRole) {
          'admin' ||
          'super_admin' ||
          'accountant' ||
          'warehouse_manager' =>
            '/admin',
          'driver' => '/driver',
          _ => '/merchant',
        };
        final navContext = NotificationService.navigatorKey.currentContext;
        if (navContext != null && navContext.mounted && AppStorage.isLoggedIn) {
          navContext.go(targetRoute);
        }
        return;
      }
      if (newRole != AppStorage.userRole) {
        // 🔒 فحص التوكن المشفر مع حماية الجلسة من التخفيض القسري عند ضعف الشبكة
        IdTokenResult? tokenResult;
        bool networkFailed = false;
        try {
          tokenResult = await FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser
              ?.getIdTokenResult(true)
              .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));
        } on FirebaseAuthException catch (e) {
          if (e.code == 'user-token-revoked') {
            await resetOnSignOut();
            try {
              await FirebaseAuth.instance
                  .signOut()
                  .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 3));
            } catch (_) {}
            await AppStorage.clearUserData();
            final navContext = NotificationService.navigatorKey.currentContext;
            if (navContext != null && navContext.mounted) {
              navContext.go('/login');
            }
            return;
          }
        } catch (_) {
          networkFailed = true;
        }

        // في حال فشل الاتصال بالشبكة نؤجل التحقق ولا نجرّد المستخدم من رتبته فوراً
        if (networkFailed && tokenResult == null) {
          return;
        }
        if (tokenResult?.claims?['is_banned'] == true) {
          await AuthService().signOut(container: _container);
          final navContext = NotificationService.navigatorKey.currentContext;
          if (navContext != null && navContext.mounted) {
            navContext.go('/login');
          }
          return;
        }

        final verifiedClaimRole =
            (tokenResult?.claims?['role'] as String?)?.trim().toLowerCase();
        const privileged = {
          'admin',
          'super_admin',
          'accountant',
          'warehouse_manager',
          'driver',
        };

        final bool isAwaitingClaims =
            privileged.contains(newRole) && verifiedClaimRole != newRole;

        final secureRole = isAwaitingClaims
            ? (AppStorage.userRole ?? 'merchant')
            : AuthService.resolveVerifiedRole(
                docRole: newRole,
                claimsRole: verifiedClaimRole,
              );
        await AppStorage.saveUserData(
          userId: userId,
          role: secureRole,
          name: data['full_name'] as String?,
          storeName: data['store_name'] as String?, // 👈 حفظ اسم المتجر
          phone: data['phone_number'] as String?,
        );

        // 🚀 معالجة التعليق: فحص مؤجل ذكي لتطبيق الترقية فور وصول الـ Claims من السيرفر
        if (isAwaitingClaims) {
          Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 3), () async {
            if (!_initialized || AppStorage.userId != userId) return;
            try {
              final tokenResultRetry = await FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser
                  ?.getIdTokenResult(true);
              final claimRoleRetry =
                  (tokenResultRetry?.claims?['role'] as String?)
                      ?.trim()
                      .toLowerCase();

              if (claimRoleRetry == newRole) {
                await AppStorage.saveUserData(
                  userId: userId,
                  role: newRole,
                  name: data['full_name'] as String?,
                  storeName: data['store_name'] as String?,
                  phone: data['phone_number'] as String?,
                );
                await startForUser(userId, role: newRole);
                final retryCtx =
                    NotificationService.navigatorKey.currentContext;
                if (retryCtx != null &&
                    retryCtx.mounted &&
                    AppStorage.isLoggedIn) {
                  final nextRoute = switch (newRole) {
                    'admin' ||
                    'super_admin' ||
                    'accountant' ||
                    'warehouse_manager' =>
                      '/admin',
                    'driver' => '/driver',
                    _ => '/merchant',
                  };
                  retryCtx.go(nextRoute);
                }
              }
            } catch (_) {}
          });
        }

        unawaited(NotificationService.instance.saveTokenToFirestore(userId));
        Future.microtask(() async {
          if (AppStorage.userId == userId && _initialized) {
            await startForUser(userId, role: secureRole);
          }
        });

        final targetRoute = switch (secureRole) {
          'admin' ||
          'super_admin' ||
          'accountant' ||
          'warehouse_manager' =>
            '/admin',
          'driver' => '/driver',
          _ => '/merchant',
        };
        final navContext = NotificationService.navigatorKey.currentContext;
        if (navContext != null && navContext.mounted && AppStorage.isLoggedIn) {
          navContext.go(targetRoute);
        }
        return;
      }
    }, onError: (_) {});
// تم إلغاء إضافة _profileSub إلى _userSubs لتجنب الإلغاء المزدوج والتعليق البرمجي
    _watchNotifications(userId);
    if (role == 'admin' ||
        role == 'super_admin' ||
        role == 'accountant' ||
        role == 'warehouse_manager') {
      // AdminOrdersTab يدير اشتراكه اللحظي المفلتر عبر adminOrdersRealtimeProvider
    } else if (role == 'driver') {
      _watchConfirmedOrders();
      _watchMyShippedOrders(userId);
    } else if (role == 'merchant') {
      _watchOrders(userId);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _stopCatalogChannels() async {
    await Future.wait([
      _categoriesSub?.cancel() ?? Future.value(),
      _brandsSub?.cancel() ?? Future.value(),
      _productsSub?.cancel() ?? Future.value(),
    ]);
    _categoriesSub = null;
    _brandsSub = null;
    _productsSub = null;
  }

  Future<void> _stopUserChannels() async {
    await _notificationsSub?.cancel();
    _notificationsSub = null;
    await _stopCatalogChannels();

    final subscriptions = List<StreamSubscription>.from(_userSubs);
    _userSubs.clear();

    await Future.wait(
      subscriptions.map((subscription) => subscription.cancel()),
    );

    _container?.read(merchantOrdersProvider.notifier).clear();
    _container?.read(realtimeNotifsProvider.notifier).clear();

    _container?.read(realtimeConfirmedOrdersProvider.notifier).clear();
    _container?.read(realtimeMyShippedOrdersProvider.notifier).clear();
    _container?.read(realtimeProductsProvider.notifier).clear();
  }

  void _watchOrders(String merchantId) {
    if (merchantId.isEmpty) return;
    final sub = _db
        .collection('orders')
        .where('merchant_id', isEqualTo: merchantId)
        .orderBy('created_at', descending: true)
        .limit(50)
        .snapshots()
        .listen((snap) {
      final data = snap.docs.map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()}).toList();
      _container?.read(merchantOrdersProvider.notifier).update(data);
    }, onError: (_) {});
    _userSubs.add(sub);
  }

  void _watchNotifications(String userId) {
    if (userId.isEmpty) return;

    _notificationsSub?.cancel();
    if (_notificationsSub != null) {
      _userSubs.remove(_notificationsSub);
      _notificationsSub = null;
    }
    final sub = _db
        .collection('user_notifications')
        .where('user_id', isEqualTo: userId)
        .orderBy('created_at', descending: true)
        .limit(50)
        .snapshots()
        .listen(
      (snap) {
        final data = snap.docs.map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()}).toList();
        _container?.read(realtimeNotifsProvider.notifier).update(data);
        _setConnected();
      },
      onError: (e) {
        if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('❌ _watchNotifications error: $e');
        if (_initialized && AppStorage.isLoggedIn) {
          _scheduleReconnect();
        }
      },
    );
    _notificationsSub = sub;
    _userSubs.add(sub);

    if (AppStorage.isMerchant) {
      // ✅ إلغاء اشتراك البث القديم دائماً قبل إنشاء اشتراك جديد لمنع تسريب الذاكرة وتضاعف الاستجابة
      _broadcastSub?.cancel();
      if (_broadcastSub != null) {
        _userSubs.remove(_broadcastSub);
        _broadcastSub = null;
      }

      final broadcastSub = _db
          .collection('broadcast_notifications')
          .orderBy('created_at', descending: true)
          .limit(20)
          .snapshots()
          .listen((snap) {
        final lastReadIso = AppStorage.getString('broadcast_read_at_$userId');
        final lastReadAt =
            lastReadIso != null ? DateTime.tryParse(lastReadIso) : null;
        Set<String> readBroadcastIds = {};
        try {
          final rawIds = AppStorage.getString('broadcast_read_ids_$userId');
          if (rawIds != null && rawIds.isNotEmpty) {
            readBroadcastIds =
                (jsonDecode(rawIds) as List).map((e) => e.toString()).toSet();
          }
        } catch (_) {}

        final broadcastData = snap.docs.map((d) {
          final data = d.data();
          final rawCreated = data['created_at'];
          final created = rawCreated is Timestamp
              ? rawCreated.toDate()
              : (rawCreated is DateTime ? rawCreated : null);
          final isRead = readBroadcastIds.contains(d.id) ||
              (lastReadAt != null &&
                  created != null &&
                  !created.isAfter(lastReadAt));
          return {
            'id': d.id,
            'is_read': isRead,
            'user_id': userId,
            ...data,
          };
        }).toList();
        _container?.read(realtimeNotifsProvider.notifier).update(broadcastData);
      }, onError: (_) {});
      _broadcastSub = broadcastSub;
      _userSubs.add(broadcastSub);
    }
  }

  void _watchProducts() {
    _productsSub?.cancel();
    bool isInitialSnapshot = true;
    _productsSub = _db
        .collection('products')
        .orderBy('updated_at', descending: true)
        .limit(100)
        .snapshots(includeMetadataChanges: false)
        .listen(
      (snap) {
        final List<Map<String, dynamic>> batch;
        if (isInitialSnapshot) {
          isInitialSnapshot = false;
          batch = snap.docs.map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()}).toList();
        } else {
          batch = snap.docChanges.map((change) {
            if (change.type == DocumentChangeType.removed) {
              return <String, dynamic>{
                'id': change.doc.id,
                'is_deleted': true,
              };
            }
            return <String, dynamic>{
              'id': change.doc.id,
              ...?change.doc.data(),
            };
          }).toList();
        }
        if (batch.isEmpty) return;
        unawaited(AppCache.instance.mergeProducts(batch));
        _container?.read(realtimeProductsProvider.notifier).update(batch);
      },
      onError: (e) {
        if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('❌ _watchProducts error: $e');
      },
    );
  }

  void watchProducts() {
    if (_productsSub == null) {
      _watchProducts();
    }
  }

  void _watchCategories() {
    _categoriesSub?.cancel();
    _categoriesSub = _db
        .collection('categories')
        .snapshots(includeMetadataChanges: false)
        .listen(
      (snap) {
        final data = snap.docs
            .where((d) =>
                d.data()['is_active'] != false &&
                d.data()['is_deleted'] != true)
            .map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()})
            .toList()
          ..sort((a, b) => ((a['sort_order'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 999)
              .compareTo((b['sort_order'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 999));

        _container?.read(realtimeCategoriesProvider.notifier).update(data);
        AppCache.instance.setCategories(data);
      },
      onError: (e) {
        if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('❌ _watchCategories error: $e');
      },
    );
  }

  void _watchBrands() {
    _brandsSub?.cancel();
    _brandsSub = _db
        .collection('brands')
        .snapshots(includeMetadataChanges: false)
        .listen(
      (snap) {
        final data = snap.docs
            .where((d) =>
                d.data()['is_active'] != false &&
                d.data()['is_deleted'] != true)
            .map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()})
            .toList()
          ..sort((a, b) => (a['name']?.toString() ?? '')
              .compareTo(b['name']?.toString() ?? ''));

        _container?.read(realtimeBrandsProvider.notifier).update(data);
        AppCache.instance.setBrands(data);
      },
      onError: (e) {
        if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('❌ _watchBrands error: $e');
      },
    );
  }

  void _watchConfirmedOrders() {
    const targetStatuses = ['confirmed', 'preparing'];

    // استخدام الفهرس المركب (status ASC, created_at DESC) لضمان وصول أحدث الطلبات غير المسندة أولاً
    final sub = _db
        .collection('orders')
        .where('status', whereIn: targetStatuses)
        .orderBy('created_at', descending: true)
        .limit(100)
        .snapshots()
        .listen(
      (snap) {
        final data = snap.docs
            .where((d) {
              final driverId = d.data()['driver_id']?.toString().trim();
              return driverId == null || driverId.isEmpty;
            })
            .map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()})
            .toList();
        _container?.read(realtimeConfirmedOrdersProvider.notifier).update(data);
        _setConnected();
      },
      onError: (e) {
        if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('❌ _watchConfirmedOrders error: $e');
        _scheduleReconnect();
      },
    );
    _userSubs.add(sub);
  }

  void _watchMyShippedOrders(String driverId) {
    if (driverId.isEmpty) return;
    final sub = _db
        .collection('orders')
        .where('status', isEqualTo: 'shipped')
        .where('driver_id', isEqualTo: driverId)
        .snapshots()
        .listen(
      (snap) {
        final data = snap.docs.map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()}).toList();
        data.sort((a, b) {
          final aDate = a['created_at'] is Timestamp
              ? (a['created_at'] as Timestamp).toDate()
              : DateTime(2000);
          final bDate = b['created_at'] is Timestamp
              ? (b['created_at'] as Timestamp).toDate()
              : DateTime(2000);
          return bDate.compareTo(aDate);
        });
        _container?.read(realtimeMyShippedOrdersProvider.notifier).update(data);
        _setConnected();
      },
      onError: (e) {
        if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('❌ _watchMyShippedOrders error: $e');
        _scheduleReconnect();
      },
    );
    _userSubs.add(sub);
  }

  void _setConnected() {
    _reconnectTimer?.cancel();
    reconnectAttempts = 0;
    _container?.read(realtimeStatusProvider.notifier).state =
        RealtimeStatus.connected;
  }

  void _scheduleReconnect() {
    if (!_initialized || !AppStorage.isLoggedIn || _activeUserId == null)
      return;

    _container?.read(realtimeStatusProvider.notifier).state =
        RealtimeStatus.disconnected;

    reconnectAttempts++;
    _reconnectTimer?.cancel();

    // 🚀 مرونة واستمرارية دائمة (Infinite Resilient Loop with Jitter): التراجع التدريجي بسقف 25 ثانية مع الاستمرار التلقائي حتى عودة الإنترنت
    final delaySeconds =
        (reconnectAttempts <= 5 ? (3 * reconnectAttempts) : 25);
    _reconnectTimer = Timer(Duration(seconds: delaySeconds), () {
      if (_initialized && AppStorage.isLoggedIn && _activeUserId != null) {
        restart();
      }
    });
  }

  void restart() {
    if (_isRestarting) return;
    _isRestarting = true;
    unawaited(_restartAsync().whenComplete(() => _isRestarting = false));
  }

  Future<void> _restartAsync() async {
    _reconnectTimer?.cancel();
    _reconnectTimer = null;
    _heartbeatTimer?.cancel();
    _heartbeatTimer = null;
    await _categoriesSub?.cancel();
    _categoriesSub = null;
    await _brandsSub?.cancel();
    _brandsSub = null;
    await _productsSub?.cancel();
    _productsSub = null;
    await _notificationsSub?.cancel();
    _notificationsSub = null;
    await _profileSub?.cancel();
    _profileSub = null; // 🔒 منع تسريب مؤشر الملف الشخصي في الذاكرة
    final subscriptions = List<StreamSubscription>.from(_userSubs);
    _userSubs.clear();

    await Future.wait(
      subscriptions.map((subscription) => subscription.cancel()),
    );

    _initialized = false;

    final container = _container;
    if (container != null) {
      init(container);
    }
  }

// ✅ التطهير التام للجلسة مع الحفاظ على القنوات الحية للتطبيق بعد تسجيل الخروج
  Future<void> resetOnSignOut() async {
    // 🔒 إلغاء أي عملية اشتراك مجدولة قيد الانتظار فوراً
    _initialized = false;
    _activeUserId = null;
    _activeUserRole = null;
    _startForUserLock = Future.value();

    final container = _container;
    _reconnectTimer?.cancel();
    _reconnectTimer = null;
    _heartbeatTimer?.cancel();
    _heartbeatTimer = null;
    final subsToCancel = <StreamSubscription?>[
      _profileSub,
      _notificationsSub,
      _broadcastSub,
      _categoriesSub,
      _brandsSub,
      _productsSub,
      ..._userSubs,
    ];

    _profileSub = null;
    _notificationsSub = null;
    _broadcastSub = null;
    _categoriesSub = null;
    _brandsSub = null;
    _productsSub = null;
    _userSubs.clear();
    await Future.wait(
      subsToCancel
          .whereType<StreamSubscription>()
          .map((s) => s.cancel().catchError((_) {})),
    );

    if (container != null) {
      try {
        container.read(merchantOrdersProvider.notifier).clear();
        container.read(realtimeNotifsProvider.notifier).clear();

        container.read(realtimeConfirmedOrdersProvider.notifier).clear();
        container.read(realtimeMyShippedOrdersProvider.notifier).clear();
        container.read(driverNewOrderCallbackProvider.notifier).state = null;
        container.read(realtimeStatusProvider.notifier).state =
            RealtimeStatus.disconnected;
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    await _connectivitySub?.cancel();
    _connectivitySub = null;
    _activeUserId = null;
    _activeUserRole = null;
    reconnectAttempts = 0;
    _initialized = false;
  }

  Future<void> dispose() async {
    await resetOnSignOut();
    await _connectivitySub?.cancel();
    _connectivitySub = null;
    await _categoriesSub?.cancel();
    _categoriesSub = null;
    await _brandsSub?.cancel();
    _brandsSub = null;
    _initialized = false;
    _container = null;
  }
}

class _OrdersNotifier extends StateNotifier<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> {
  _OrdersNotifier() : super([]);
  final _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;

  Future<void> reload(String merchantId) async {
    if (merchantId.isEmpty) return;
    final docs = await _silently(
      () async {
        final snap = await _db
            .collection('orders')
            .where('merchant_id', isEqualTo: merchantId)
            .limit(200)
            .get();
        final list = snap.docs.map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()}).toList()
          ..sort((a, b) => AppDateParser.parse(b['created_at'])
              .compareTo(AppDateParser.parse(a['created_at'])));
        return list;
      },
      tag: 'orders-reload',
    );
    if (docs != null && mounted) state = docs;
  }

  void update(List<Map<String, dynamic>> data) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    state = data;
  }

  void clear() {
    if (mounted) state = [];
  }
}

class _NotificationsNotifier extends StateNotifier<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> {
  _NotificationsNotifier() : super([]);
  final _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;
  static const int _pageSize = 50;
  DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? _lastLoadedDoc;
  bool _hasMore = true;
  bool _isLoadingMore = false;
  String? loadMoreError;

  bool get hasMore => _hasMore;
  bool get isLoadingMore => _isLoadingMore;

  Future<void> reload(String userId) async {
    if (userId.isEmpty) return;
    final snapshot = await _silently(
      () => _db
          .collection('user_notifications')
          .where('user_id', isEqualTo: userId)
          .orderBy('created_at', descending: true)
          .limit(_pageSize)
          .get(),
      tag: 'notifs-reload',
    );
    if (snapshot != null && mounted) {
      _lastLoadedDoc = snapshot.docs.isEmpty ? null : snapshot.docs.last;
      _hasMore = snapshot.docs.length == _pageSize;
      update(snapshot.docs.map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()}).toList());
    }
  }

  void update(List<Map<String, dynamic>> data) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    final merged = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{
      for (final notification in state)
        notification['id'].toString(): notification,
      for (final notification in data)
        notification['id'].toString(): notification,
    };
    final notifications = merged.values.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => _notificationDate(b).compareTo(_notificationDate(a)));
    state = notifications;
  }

  DateTime _notificationDate(Map<String, dynamic> notification) {
    final value = notification['created_at'];
    if (value is Timestamp) return value.toDate();
    if (value is DateTime) return value;
    if (value is String) return DateTime.tryParse(value) ?? DateTime(2000);
    return DateTime(2000);
  }

  Future<void> loadMore(String userId) async {
    if (userId.isEmpty || !_hasMore || _isLoadingMore) {
      return;
    }
    var cursor = _lastLoadedDoc;
    if (cursor == null) {
      try {
        final seed = await _db
            .collection('user_notifications')
            .where('user_id', isEqualTo: userId)
            .orderBy('created_at', descending: true)
            .limit(_pageSize)
            .get(const GetOptions(source: Source.serverAndCache));
        if (seed.docs.length < _pageSize) {
          _hasMore = false;
          if (mounted) state = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(state);
          return;
        }
        cursor = seed.docs.last;
        _lastLoadedDoc = cursor;
      } catch (_) {
        return;
      }
    }
    _isLoadingMore = true;
    loadMoreError = null;
    state = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(state);
    try {
      final snapshot = await _db
          .collection('user_notifications')
          .where('user_id', isEqualTo: userId)
          .orderBy('created_at', descending: true)
          .startAfterDocument(cursor)
          .limit(_pageSize)
          .get(const GetOptions(source: Source.serverAndCache));
      if (!mounted) return;

      if (snapshot.docs.isNotEmpty) _lastLoadedDoc = snapshot.docs.last;
      _hasMore = snapshot.docs.length == _pageSize;
      update(snapshot.docs.map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()}).toList());
    } catch (error, stackTrace) {
      loadMoreError = 'تعذر تحميل الإشعارات الأقدم. أعد المحاولة.';
      if (kDebugMode) {
        debugPrint('Notification pagination failed: $error');
        debugPrintStack(stackTrace: stackTrace);
      }
    } finally {
      _isLoadingMore = false;
      if (mounted) state = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(state);
    }
  }

  Future<void> markRead(String id) async {
    await _silently(
      () async {
        await _db
            .collection('user_notifications')
            .doc(id)
            .update({'is_read': true});
        if (mounted) {
          state = state
              .map((n) => n['id'] == id ? {...n, 'is_read': true} : n)
              .toList();
        }
      },
      tag: 'notifs-markRead',
    );
  }

  Future<void> markAllRead(String userId) async {
    await _silently(
      () async {
        await AppStorage.setString(
          'broadcast_read_at_$userId',
          DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
        );
        try {
          final currentIds = state
              .map((n) => n['id']?.toString() ?? '')
              .where((id) => id.isNotEmpty)
              .take(50)
              .toList();
          await AppStorage.setString(
            'broadcast_read_ids_$userId',
            jsonEncode(currentIds),
          );
        } catch (_) {}
        final query = _db
            .collection('user_notifications')
            .where('user_id', isEqualTo: userId)
            .where('is_read', isEqualTo: false);
        const chunkSize = 400;
        bool hasMore;
        do {
          final page = await query.limit(chunkSize).get();
          if (page.docs.isEmpty) break;

          final batch = _db.batch();
          for (final doc in page.docs) {
            batch.update(doc.reference, {'is_read': true});
          }
          await batch.commit();
          hasMore = page.docs.length == chunkSize;
        } while (hasMore);
        if (mounted) {
          state = state.map((n) => {...n, 'is_read': true}).toList();
        }
      },
      tag: 'notifs-markAllRead',
    );
  }

  void clear() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    state = [];
    _lastLoadedDoc = null;
    _hasMore = true;
    _isLoadingMore = false;
    loadMoreError = null;
  }
}

class _ProductsNotifier extends StateNotifier<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> {
  _ProductsNotifier() : super([]);

  final _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;

  bool _isLoadingMore = false;
  String? _lastLoadedCursor;
  String? _activeBrandId;
  Future<void> reload({String? brandId}) async {
    _activeBrandId = brandId;
    _lastLoadedCursor = null;
    final docs = await _silently(
      () async {
        Query<Map<String, dynamic>> query = _db.collection('products');
        if (brandId != null) {
          query = query.where('brand_id', isEqualTo: brandId);
        }
        final snap = await query
            .orderBy('name')
            .limit(RealtimeHub._productsPageSize)
            .get();
        final list = snap.docs
            .where((d) =>
                d.data()['is_active'] != false &&
                d.data()['is_deleted'] != true)
            .map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()})
            .toList();
        list.sort((a, b) => (a['name']?.toString() ?? '')
            .compareTo(b['name']?.toString() ?? ''));
        return list;
      },
      tag: 'products-reload',
    );
    if (docs != null && mounted) state = docs;
  }

  Future<void> loadMore(DocumentSnapshot lastDoc) async {
    if (!mounted || _isLoadingMore || _lastLoadedCursor == lastDoc.id) return;

    _isLoadingMore = true;
    _lastLoadedCursor = lastDoc.id;

    try {
      Query<Map<String, dynamic>> query = _db.collection('products');
      if (_activeBrandId != null) {
        query = query.where('brand_id', isEqualTo: _activeBrandId);
      }
      final snap = await query
          .orderBy('name')
          .startAfterDocument(lastDoc)
          .limit(RealtimeHub._productsPageSize)
          .get();
      if (!mounted || snap.docs.isEmpty) {
        return;
      }

      final more = snap.docs
          .where((d) =>
              d.data()['is_active'] != false && d.data()['is_deleted'] != true)
          .map((d) {
        return {
          'id': d.id,
          ...d.data(),
        };
      }).toList();

      final productsById = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{
        for (final product in state) product['id'].toString(): product,
      };

      for (final product in more) {
        productsById[product['id'].toString()] = product;
      }

      state = productsById.values.toList();
    } catch (error) {
      if (kDebugMode) {
        debugPrint('products-loadMore failed: $error');
      }
      _lastLoadedCursor = null;
    } finally {
      _isLoadingMore = false;
    }
  }

  void update(List<Map<String, dynamic>> data) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    state = data;
  }

  void clear() {
    if (mounted) state = [];
  }
}

                d.data()['is_deleted'] != true)
            .map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()})
            .toList();
      },
      tag: 'categories-reload',
    );
    if (docs != null && mounted) {
      state = docs;
      _lastFetch = DateTime.now();
    }
  }

    if (mounted) state = data;
  }
}

class RealtimeIndicator extends ConsumerWidget {
  const RealtimeIndicator({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final status = ref.watch(realtimeStatusProvider);
    if (status == RealtimeStatus.connected) return const SizedBox.shrink();

    return AnimatedSwitcher(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 400),
      transitionBuilder: (child, anim) =>
          FadeTransition(opacity: anim, child: child),
      child: status == RealtimeStatus.connecting
          ? const _StatusDot(
              key: ValueKey('c'),
              color: Color(0xFFF59E0B),
              label: 'جاري الاتصال...',
              pulse: true,
            )
          : const _StatusDot(
              key: ValueKey('d'),
              color: Color(0xFFEF4444),
              label: 'انقطع الاتصال',
              pulse: false,
            ),
    );
  }
}

class _StatusDot extends StatefulWidget {
  final Color color;
  final String label;
  final bool pulse;
  const _StatusDot({
    super.key,
    required this.color,
    required this.label,
    required this.pulse,
  });

  @override
  State<_StatusDot> createState() => _StatusDotState();
}

class _StatusDotState extends State<_StatusDot>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _ctrl;
  late Animation<double> _opacity;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ctrl = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 800),
    );
    _opacity = Tween<double>(begin: 0.3, end: 1.0).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(parent: _ctrl, curve: Curves.easeInOut),
    );
    if (widget.pulse) _ctrl.repeat(reverse: true);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _ctrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 5),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: widget.color.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(color: widget.color.withValues(alpha: 0.25)),
      ),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          FadeTransition(
            opacity: widget.pulse ? _opacity : const AlwaysStoppedAnimation(1),
            child: Container(
              width: 7,
              height: 7,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: widget.color,
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                boxShadow: [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: widget.color.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                    blurRadius: 4,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 7),
          Text(
            widget.label,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontFamily: 'Cairo',
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: widget.color,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'dart:ui' as ui;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/rendering.dart';
import 'package:qr_flutter/qr_flutter.dart';
import 'package:cached_network_image/cached_network_image.dart';
import '../../features/admin/services/admin_service.dart';
import 'image_precache_service.dart';

enum PaperSize { mm58, mm80 }

class ThermalPrinterService {
  ThermalPrinterService._();
  static final instance = ThermalPrinterService._();
  static bool _isCapturing = false;
  static Future<Uint8List?> capturePngFromKey(GlobalKey key) async {
    if (_isCapturing) return null;
    _isCapturing = true;
    try {
      final context = key.currentContext;
      if (context == null) return null;
      final boundary = context.findRenderObject() as RenderRepaintBoundary?;
      if (boundary == null || !boundary.attached || boundary.size.isEmpty) {
        return null;
      }

      // منح الأجهزة الضعيفة مهلة كافية لإنهاء الرسم وتأكيد اكتمال طبقة الـ Canvas
      for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
        await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 100));
        WidgetsBinding.instance.scheduleFrame();
        await WidgetsBinding.instance.endOfFrame.timeout(
          const Duration(milliseconds: 800),
          onTimeout: () => null,
        );
      }

      ui.Image? image;
      for (int retry = 0; retry < 4; retry++) {
        try {
          if (boundary.attached && !boundary.size.isEmpty) {
            image = await boundary.toImage(pixelRatio: 2.0);
            if (image.width > 0 && image.height > 0) break;
          }
        } catch (_) {
          await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 150));
        }
      }

      if (image == null) return null;
      final byteData = await image.toByteData(format: ui.ImageByteFormat.png);
      image.dispose();
      if (byteData == null) return null;
      return byteData.buffer
          .asUint8List(byteData.offsetInBytes, byteData.lengthInBytes);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Thermal capture error: $e');
      return null;
    } finally {
      _isCapturing = false;
    }
  }
}

/// ويدجت الفاتورة المصممة باحترافية عالية وبأعلى درجات التباين للطباعة الحرارية (58mm / 80mm)
class ThermalReceiptWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  final AdminOrder order;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> items;
  final String? signatureUrl;
  final PaperSize paperSize;

  const ThermalReceiptWidget({
    super.key,
    required this.order,
    required this.items,
    this.signatureUrl,
    this.paperSize = PaperSize.mm58,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final width = paperSize == PaperSize.mm58 ? 384.0 : 576.0;
    final shortId = order.orderNumber ??
        (order.id.length >= 8
            ? order.id.substring(0, 8).toUpperCase()
            : order.id.toUpperCase());

    final dateStr =

                          errorWidget: (_, __, ___) => const SizedBox.shrink(),

                            width: 50,
                          ),
                        );
                      }

              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),

/// خط فاصل متقطع احترافي متكيف تماماً مع عرض الفاتورة
class _DashedLine extends StatelessWidget {
  final double thickness;
  const _DashedLine({this.thickness = 1.0});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        final rawWidth = constraints.maxWidth;
        final boxWidth = rawWidth.isFinite ? rawWidth : 384.0;
        const dashWidth = 4.0;
        const dashSpace = 3.0;
        final dashCount =
            (boxWidth / (dashWidth + dashSpace)).floor().clamp(1, 150);
        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: List.generate(dashCount, (_) {
              return SizedBox(
                width: dashWidth,
                height: thickness,
                child: const DecoratedBox(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(color: Colors.black),
                ),
              );
            }),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

// FILE: lib\core\utils\arabic_normalizer.dart
// ==================================================

import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';

class ArabicNormalizer {
  ArabicNormalizer._();

  static const Map<String, String> _numeralsMap = {
    '٠': '0',
    '١': '1',
    '٢': '2',
    '٣': '3',
    '٤': '4',
    '٥': '5',
    '٦': '6',
    '٧': '7',
    '٨': '8',
    '٩': '9',
    '۰': '0',
    '۱': '1',
    '۲': '2',
    '۳': '3',
    '۴': '4',
    '۵': '5',
    '۶': '6',
    '۷': '7',
    '۸': '8',
    '۹': '9',
  };

  static final RegExp _diacriticsRegex = RegExp(r'[\u064B-\u065F\u0670\u0640]');
  static final RegExp _alefRegex = RegExp(r'[أإآٱ]');
  static final RegExp _spacesRegex = RegExp(r'\s+');

  /// تطبيع قياسي للبحث والفرز
  static String normalize(String text) {
    if (text.isEmpty) return '';
    var clean = text.trim();
    clean = clean.replaceAll(_diacriticsRegex, '');
    clean = clean.replaceAll(_alefRegex, 'ا');
    clean = clean
        .replaceAll('ة', 'ه')
        .replaceAll('ى', 'ي')
        .replaceAll('ؤ', 'و')
        .replaceAll('ئ', 'ي')
        .replaceAll('ء', '');
    _numeralsMap.forEach((ar, en) => clean = clean.replaceAll(ar, en));
    return clean.replaceAll(_spacesRegex, ' ').toLowerCase().trim();
  }

  /// تطبيع مخصص للمواقع والأسماء بلهجة صنعاء
  static String normalizeDialect(String text) {
    return normalize(text).replaceAll('ظ', 'ض');
  }

  /// تقسيم النص إلى كلمات بحثية مطبعة
  static List<String> tokenize(String query) {
    return normalize(query)
        .split(' ')
        .where((token) => token.trim().length > 1)
        .toList();
  }

  /// تحويل الأرقام العربية المشرقية والفارسية إلى أرقام لاتينية (آمن للـ Isolates)
  static String normalizeDigits(String text) {
    if (text.isEmpty) return '';
    var clean = text;
    _numeralsMap.forEach((ar, en) => clean = clean.replaceAll(ar, en));
    return clean;
  }

  /// فحص مطابقة الكلمات
  static bool matches(String target, List<String> tokens) {
    if (tokens.isEmpty) return true;
    final normalizedTarget = normalize(target);
    return tokens.every((token) => normalizedTarget.contains(token));
  }
}

/// فئة معمارية موحدة لمعالجة وفرز وتنسيق كافة تواريخ التطبيق (Single Source of Truth)
class AppDateParser {
  AppDateParser._();

  static DateTime parse(dynamic value, [DateTime? fallback]) {
    if (value == null) return fallback ?? DateTime(2000);
    if (value is DateTime) return value;
    if (value is Timestamp) {
      return value.toDate();
    }
    if (value is String && value.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      return DateTime.tryParse(value.trim()) ?? (fallback ?? DateTime(2000));
    }
    return fallback ?? DateTime(2000);
  }

  static String formatDate(dynamic value, {bool includeTime = false}) {
    final dt = parse(value);
    final dateStr =
        '${dt.year}/${dt.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${dt.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
    if (!includeTime) return dateStr;
    final timeStr =
        '${dt.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${dt.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
    return '$dateStr  $timeStr';
  }
}


// ==================================================
// FILE: lib\core\utils\inventory_math.dart
// ==================================================

/// دالة مشتركة موحّدة لحساب عدد الكراتين المقابلة لكمية مُباعة/مُرتجعة
/// من وحدة فرعية (unit)، بدلاً من تكرار هذه الصيغة في عدة ملفات.
class InventoryMath {
  InventoryMath._();

  static double cartonsFor({
    required num qty,
    required int unitQty,
    required int cartonCapacity,
  }) {
    final capacity = cartonCapacity > 0 ? cartonCapacity : 1;
    final rawCartons = (qty * unitQty) / capacity;
    // تقريب الرقم لأقرب 4 خانات عشرية لمنع تلوث قاعدة البيانات بالكسور اللانهائية
    return double.parse(rawCartons.toStringAsFixed(4));
  }
}
