class _ScannerOverlayPainter extends CustomPainter {
  final Rect scanWindow;
  final double borderRadius;
  _ScannerOverlayPainter({
    required this.scanWindow,
    required this.borderRadius,
  });

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final backgroundPath = Path()
      ..addRect(Rect.fromLTWH(0, 0, size.width, size.height));
    final cutoutPath = Path()
      ..addRRect(
        RRect.fromRectAndRadius(scanWindow, Radius.circular(borderRadius)),
      );
    final overlayPath =
        Path.combine(PathOperation.difference, backgroundPath, cutoutPath);
    final paint = Paint()..color = Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.65);
    canvas.drawPath(overlayPath, paint);
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _ScannerOverlayPainter oldDelegate) =>
      oldDelegate.scanWindow != scanWindow;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// مدير الفهرسة الموحد فائق السرعة بالذاكرة العشوائية
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
class BarcodeIndexManager {
  BarcodeIndexManager._();
  static final instance = BarcodeIndexManager._();
  final Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> _index = {};
  DateTime? _lastRebuildTime;

  void ensureInitialized() {
    if (_index.isEmpty) rebuildIndex();
  }

  bool rebuildIfStale() {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    if (_lastRebuildTime == null ||
        now.difference(_lastRebuildTime!).inMinutes > 5) {
      rebuildIndex();
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  void rebuildIndex() {
    _index.clear();
    final allProducts = AppCache.instance.getAllCachedProducts();
    for (final p in allProducts) {
      indexProduct(p);
    }
    _lastRebuildTime = DateTime.now();
  }

  void indexProduct(Map<String, dynamic> product) {
    if (product['is_deleted'] == true || product['is_active'] == false) return;

    void addVar(String raw) {
      final c = BarcodeScannerScreen.cleanBarcode(raw);
      if (c.isEmpty) return;
      final stripped = c.replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^0+'), '');
      _index[c] = product;
      if (stripped.isNotEmpty) {
        _index[stripped] = product;
        _index['0$stripped'] = product;
        _index['00$stripped'] = product;
      }
    }

    if (product['barcode'] != null) addVar(product['barcode'].toString());

    if (product['all_barcodes'] is List) {
      for (final b in product['all_barcodes']) {
        if (b != null) addVar(b.toString());
      }
    }

    if (product['variants'] is List) {
      for (final v in (product['variants'] as List).whereType<Map>()) {
        if (v['barcode'] != null) addVar(v['barcode'].toString());
      }
    }
  }

  Map<String, dynamic>? find(String rawCode) {
    ensureInitialized();
    final clean = BarcodeScannerScreen.cleanBarcode(rawCode);
    final stripped = clean.replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^0+'), '');
    return _index[clean] ??
        _index[stripped] ??
        _index['0$stripped'] ??
        _index['00$stripped'];
  }
}

                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),

              const SliverToBoxAdapter(child: SizedBox(height: 20)),

              // ══ Grid الشركات ══
              SliverPadding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
                sliver: brandsAsync.when(
                  loading: () => const SliverToBoxAdapter(
                    child: BrandsSkeleton(),
                  ),
                  error: (e, _) => SliverToBoxAdapter(
                    child: _ErrorState(
                      onRetry: () =>
                          ref.invalidate(brandsStreamProvider(categoryId)),
                    ),
                  ),
                  data: (brands) {
                    if (brands.isEmpty) {
                      return const SliverToBoxAdapter(child: _EmptyState());
                    }

                    return SliverGrid(
                      delegate: SliverChildBuilderDelegate(
                        (context, index) {
                          final brand = brands[index];
                          return BrandCard(
                            brand: brand,
                            onTap: () {
                              // 🚀 استخدام MaterialPageRoute ليسمح بتفعيل السحب من اليمين للرجوع
                              Navigator.of(context).push(
                                MaterialPageRoute(
                                  builder: (_) => ProductsScreen(
                                    brandId: brand.id,
                                    brandName: brand.name,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              );
                            },
                          );
                        },
                        childCount: brands.length,
                      ),
                      gridDelegate:
                          const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
                        crossAxisCount: 2,
                        crossAxisSpacing: 14,
                        mainAxisSpacing: 14,
                        childAspectRatio: 0.78,
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),

              const SliverToBoxAdapter(child: SizedBox(height: 30)),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// FILE: lib\features\merchant\brands\services\brands_service.dart

import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:wissal/core/services/app_cache.dart';

class BrandModel {
  final String id;
  final String name;
  final String? logoUrl;
  final String? description;
  final String categoryId;

  const BrandModel({
    required this.id,
    required this.name,
    this.logoUrl,
    this.description,
    required this.categoryId,
  });

  factory BrandModel.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) => BrandModel(
        id: map['id'].toString(),
        name: map['name'] ?? '',
        logoUrl: map['logo_url'],
        description: map['description'],
        categoryId: map['category_id'].toString(),
      );
}

final brandsStreamProvider =
    StreamProvider.autoDispose.family<List<BrandModel>, String>((
  ref,
  categoryId,
) {
  return FirebaseFirestore.instance
      .collection('brands')
      .where('category_id', isEqualTo: categoryId)
      .limit(150)
      .snapshots(includeMetadataChanges: false)
      .map(
    (snap) {
      final rawDocs = snap.docs
          .where((d) =>
              d.data()['is_deleted'] != true && d.data()['is_active'] != false)
          .map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()})
          .toList();

      if (rawDocs.isNotEmpty) {
        AppCache.instance.setBrands(rawDocs, categoryId: categoryId);
      }
      final list = rawDocs.map((d) => BrandModel.fromMap(d)).toList();
      list.sort((a, b) => a.name.compareTo(b.name));
      return list;
    },
  );
});

// FILE: lib\features\merchant\cart\models\cart_item_model.dart
// ==================================================

import '../../products/services/products_service.dart';
import 'package:wissal/core/models/product_unit.dart';

class CartItem {
  final ProductModel product;
  final int quantity;
  final ProductUnit? selectedUnit;
  final ProductVariant? selectedVariant;

  const CartItem({
    required this.product,
    required this.quantity,
    this.selectedUnit,
    this.selectedVariant,
  });

  String get cartKey {
    final variantPart =
        selectedVariant != null ? '__v_${selectedVariant!.id}' : '';
    final label = selectedUnit?.label.trim() ?? 'كرتون';
    final unitPart = label == 'كرتون' ? '' : '__$label';
    return '${product.id}$variantPart$unitPart';
  }

  String get displayName {
    final isCustomVariant = selectedVariant != null &&
        selectedVariant!.id != 'base_default' &&
        selectedVariant!.label.trim().isNotEmpty;
    final baseTitle =
        isCustomVariant ? selectedVariant!.label.trim() : product.name;
    final unitName =
        (selectedUnit != null && selectedUnit!.label.trim().isNotEmpty)
            ? selectedUnit!.label.trim()
            : 'كرتون';
    return '$baseTitle - $unitName';
  }

  double get unitPrice =>
      selectedUnit?.price ?? selectedVariant?.price ?? product.price;

  String get unitLabel => selectedUnit?.label ?? 'كرتون';

  double get total => unitPrice * quantity;

  CartItem copyWith({
    int? quantity,
    ProductUnit? selectedUnit,
    ProductVariant? selectedVariant,
  }) =>
      CartItem(
        product: product,
        quantity: quantity ?? this.quantity,
        selectedUnit: selectedUnit ?? this.selectedUnit,
        selectedVariant: selectedVariant ?? this.selectedVariant,
      );

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final unitMap = selectedUnit?.toJson();
    final variantMap = selectedVariant?.toJson();

    return {
      'product': {
        'id': product.id,
        'name': product.name,
        'price': product.price,
        'image_url': product.imageUrl,
        'imageUrl': product.imageUrl,
        'brandId': product.brandId,
        'size_ml': product.sizeMl,
        'size_text': product.sizeText,
        'barcode': product.barcode,
        'stock': product.stock,
        'base_stock': product.baseStock,
        'has_base_stock': product.hasBaseStock,
        'items_per_carton': product.itemsPerCarton,
        'units': product.units.map((u) => u.toJson()).toList(),
        'variants': product.variants.map((v) => v.toJson()).toList(),
      },
      'quantity': quantity,
      'snapshot_at': DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
      if (unitMap != null) 'selectedUnit': unitMap,
      if (variantMap != null) 'selectedVariant': variantMap,
    };
  }

  factory CartItem.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> j) {
    final p = j['product'] as Map<String, dynamic>;
    final unitMap = j['selectedUnit'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
    final variantMap = j['selectedVariant'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
    final img = (p['image_url'] ?? p['imageUrl']) as String?;

    final parsedUnit = unitMap != null ? ProductUnit.fromMap(unitMap) : null;
    final parsedVariant =
        variantMap != null ? ProductVariant.fromMap(variantMap) : null;
    final rawUnits = p['units'] as List<dynamic>?;
    final rawVariants = p['variants'] as List<dynamic>?;

    return CartItem(
      product: ProductModel.fromMap({
        'id': p['id'],
        'name': p['name'],
        'price': p['price'],
        'image_url': img,
        'brand_id': p['brandId'] ?? p['brand_id'] ?? '',
        'size_ml': p['size_ml'],
        'size_text': p['size_text'],
        'barcode': p['barcode'],
        'items_per_carton': p['items_per_carton'],
        'units': rawUnits ?? (parsedUnit != null ? [parsedUnit.toMap()] : []),
        'variants': rawVariants ??
            (parsedVariant != null ? [parsedVariant.toJson()] : []),
        'category_id': '',
        'cost_price': 0,
        'stock': (p['stock'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
        if (p['base_stock'] != null) 'base_stock': p['base_stock'],
        if (p['has_base_stock'] != null) 'has_base_stock': p['has_base_stock'],
        'is_active': true,
      }),
      quantity: (j['quantity'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 1,
      selectedUnit: parsedUnit,
      selectedVariant: parsedVariant,
    );
  }
}


// ==================================================
// FILE: lib\features\merchant\cart\providers\cart_provider.dart
// ==================================================

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:firebase_crashlytics/firebase_crashlytics.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:wissal/core/services/local_storage.dart';
import 'package:wissal/core/models/product_unit.dart';
import '../models/cart_item_model.dart';
import '../../products/services/products_service.dart';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';

final cartProvider =
    StateNotifierProvider<CartNotifier, Map<String, CartItem>>((ref) {
  return CartNotifier();
});

final cartTotalProvider = Provider<double>((ref) {
  final cart = ref.watch(cartProvider);
  return cart.values.fold(0.0, (sum, item) => sum + item.total);
});

final cartCountProvider = Provider<int>((ref) {
  final cart = ref.watch(cartProvider);
  return cart.values.fold(0, (sum, item) => sum + item.quantity);
});

class CartNotifier extends StateNotifier<Map<String, CartItem>> {
  CartNotifier() : super({}) {
    _loadFuture = _load();
  }

  late final Future<void> _loadFuture;
  static String get _key {
    final uid = AppStorage.userId ?? 'guest';
    return 'wissal_cart_v2_$uid';
  }

  static const int _maxQuantity = 999;
  final _repository = const CartStorageRepository();
  bool _isLoaded = false;
  final List<VoidCallback> _pendingMutations = [];
  Future<void> _cartSaveChain = Future.value();
  Timer? _saveDebounceTimer;
  Future<void> _load() async {
    if (kIsWeb) {
      _isLoaded = true;
      return;
    }
    try {
      var loaded = await _repository.readCart(_key);

      final currentUid = AppStorage.userId;
      if (currentUid != null && currentUid.isNotEmpty) {
        const guestKey = 'wissal_cart_v2_guest';
        final guestCart = await _repository.readCart(guestKey);
        if (guestCart != null && guestCart.isNotEmpty) {
          final mergedCart = Map<String, CartItem>.from(loaded ?? {});
          guestCart.forEach((key, guestItem) {
            if (mergedCart.containsKey(key)) {
              final existing = mergedCart[key]!;
              mergedCart[key] = existing.copyWith(
                quantity: (existing.quantity + guestItem.quantity)
                    .clamp(1, _maxQuantity),
              );
            } else {
              mergedCart[key] = guestItem;
            }
          });
          loaded = mergedCart;
          await _repository.saveCart(
            key: _key,
            items: mergedCart,
          );
          await _repository.deleteCart(guestKey);
        }
      }

      if (loaded != null && loaded.isNotEmpty) {
        final merged = Map<String, CartItem>.from(loaded);
        state.forEach((key, freshItem) {
          if (merged.containsKey(key)) {
            final diskItem = merged[key]!;
            final combinedQty =
                (diskItem.quantity + freshItem.quantity).clamp(1, _maxQuantity);
            merged[key] = diskItem.copyWith(quantity: combinedQty);
          } else {
            merged[key] = freshItem;
          }
        });
        state = merged;
      }
    } catch (e, st) {
      if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('❌ CartNotifier._load failed: $e\n$st');
    } finally {
      _isLoaded = true;
      if (_pendingMutations.isNotEmpty) {
        for (final mutation in _pendingMutations) {
          mutation();
        }
        _pendingMutations.clear();
      }
    }
  }

  void _save() {
    if (!_isLoaded) {
      _pendingMutations.add(() => _save());
      return;
    }

    _saveDebounceTimer?.cancel();
    _saveDebounceTimer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 250), () {
      _flushSaveToDisk();
    });
  }

  void _flushSaveToDisk() {
    final itemsSnapshot = Map<String, CartItem>.from(state);
    final targetKey = _key;

    _cartSaveChain = _cartSaveChain.then((_) async {
      await _loadFuture;
      await _repository.saveCart(
        key: targetKey,
        items: itemsSnapshot,
      );
    }).catchError((Object error, StackTrace stackTrace) {
      if (kDebugMode) {
        debugPrint('Cart persistence failed: $error\n$stackTrace');
      }
      if (!kIsWeb) {
        FirebaseCrashlytics.instance
            .recordError(error, stackTrace, reason: 'Cart persistence failed');
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> forceSave() async {
    _saveDebounceTimer?.cancel();
    _saveDebounceTimer = null;
    _flushSaveToDisk();
    await _loadFuture;
    return _cartSaveChain;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _saveDebounceTimer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  bool changeItemUnit(CartItem oldItem, ProductUnit newUnit) {
    final oldKey = oldItem.cartKey;
    final probeItem = CartItem(
      product: oldItem.product,
      quantity: oldItem.quantity,
      selectedUnit: newUnit,
      selectedVariant: oldItem.selectedVariant,
    );
    final newKey = probeItem.cartKey;
    if (oldKey == newKey) return true;

    final maxTotalForTarget = _maxUnitsAllowedFor(
      probeItem,
      ignoreKeys: {oldKey, newKey},
    );
    if (maxTotalForTarget <= 0) {
      return false;
    }

    final newState = Map<String, CartItem>.from(state);
    newState.remove(oldKey);

    if (newState.containsKey(newKey)) {
      final existing = newState[newKey]!;
      newState[newKey] = existing.copyWith(
        quantity:
            (existing.quantity + oldItem.quantity).clamp(1, maxTotalForTarget),
      );
    } else {
      newState[newKey] = probeItem.copyWith(
        quantity: oldItem.quantity.clamp(1, maxTotalForTarget),
      );
    }
    state = newState;
    _save();
    return true;
  }

  int _maxUnitsAllowedFor(
    CartItem targetItem, {
    String? ignoreKey,
    Set<String> ignoreKeys = const {},
  }) {
    final double availableStock =
        targetItem.selectedVariant?.stock ?? targetItem.product.baseStock;
    if (availableStock <= 0) return 0;

    final int cartonCap = (targetItem.selectedVariant?.itemsPerCarton ??
            targetItem.product.itemsPerCarton ??
            1)
        .clamp(1, 9999);
    final int unitQty =
        (targetItem.selectedUnit?.qty ?? cartonCap).clamp(1, 9999);

    double usedCartonsByOtherUnits = 0.0;
    final String targetVarId = targetItem.selectedVariant?.id ?? '';

    for (final entry in state.entries) {
      if (entry.key == ignoreKey || ignoreKeys.contains(entry.key)) continue;
      final other = entry.value;
      if (other.product.id == targetItem.product.id &&
          (other.selectedVariant?.id ?? '') == targetVarId) {
        final otherCap = (other.selectedVariant?.itemsPerCarton ??
                other.product.itemsPerCarton ??
                1)
            .clamp(1, 9999);
        final otherUnitQty =
            (other.selectedUnit?.qty ?? otherCap).clamp(1, 9999);
        usedCartonsByOtherUnits += (other.quantity * otherUnitQty) / otherCap;
      }
    }

    final remainingCartons =
        (availableStock - usedCartonsByOtherUnits).clamp(0.0, availableStock);
    return ((remainingCartons * cartonCap) / unitQty)
        .floor()
        .clamp(0, _maxQuantity);
  }

  void addItem(
    ProductModel product,
    int quantity, {
    ProductUnit? unit,
    ProductVariant? variant,
  }) {
    if (quantity <= 0) return;
    final item = CartItem(
      product: product,
      quantity: quantity,
      selectedUnit: unit,
      selectedVariant: variant,
    );
    final key = item.cartKey;
    final maxAllowed = _maxUnitsAllowedFor(item, ignoreKey: key);
    if (maxAllowed <= 0) return;

    final existing = state[key];
    final currentQty = existing?.quantity ?? 0;
    final newQty = (currentQty + quantity).clamp(1, maxAllowed);

    state = {
      ...state,
      key: item.copyWith(quantity: newQty),
    };
    _save();
  }

  void setQuantity(CartItem item, int quantity) {
    final key = item.cartKey;
    if (quantity <= 0) {
      removeItem(key);
      return;
    }
    final existing = state[key] ?? item;
    final maxAllowed = _maxUnitsAllowedFor(existing, ignoreKey: key);
    if (maxAllowed <= 0) {
      removeItem(key);
      return;
    }
    state = {
      ...state,
      key: existing.copyWith(quantity: quantity.clamp(1, maxAllowed)),
    };
    _save();
  }

  void removeItem(String cartKey) {
    if (!state.containsKey(cartKey)) return;
    final newState = Map<String, CartItem>.from(state)..remove(cartKey);
    state = newState;
    _save();
  }

  void incrementItem(CartItem item) {
    final key = item.cartKey;
    final existing = state[key];
    if (existing == null) {
      addItem(
        item.product,
        1,
        unit: item.selectedUnit,
        variant: item.selectedVariant,
      );
      return;
    }
    final maxAllowed = _maxUnitsAllowedFor(existing, ignoreKey: key);
    if (existing.quantity >= maxAllowed) return;
    state = {
      ...state,
      key: existing.copyWith(quantity: existing.quantity + 1),
    };
    _save();
  }

  void decrementItem(CartItem item) {
    final key = item.cartKey;
    final existing = state[key];
    if (existing == null) return;
    if (existing.quantity <= 1) {
      removeItem(key);
      return;
    }
    state = {
      ...state,
      key: existing.copyWith(quantity: existing.quantity - 1),
    };
    _save();
  }

  Future<void> clearAsync() async {
    await _loadFuture;
    state = {};
    await forceSave();
  }

  void clear() {
    _saveDebounceTimer?.cancel();
    _saveDebounceTimer = null;
    state = {};
    _flushSaveToDisk();
  }

  int quantityOf(String cartKey) => state[cartKey]?.quantity ?? 0;

  bool validateAndUpdatePrices(
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> latestProducts, {
    Set<String>? queriedBatchIds,
  }) {
    if (state.isEmpty) return false;
    bool hasChanges = false;
    final Map<String, CartItem> resolvedMap = {};
    final Map<String, double> usedCartonsByPool = {};
    final returnedProductsMap = {
      for (final p in latestProducts) p['id']?.toString(): p
    };

    for (final entry in state.entries) {
      final item = entry.value;
      final productId = item.product.id;

      if (queriedBatchIds != null && !queriedBatchIds.contains(productId)) {
        resolvedMap[entry.key] = item;
        final safeCap = (item.selectedVariant?.itemsPerCarton ??
                item.product.itemsPerCarton ??
                1)
            .clamp(1, 9999);
        final uQty = (item.selectedUnit?.qty ?? safeCap).clamp(1, 9999);
        final poolKey = '${productId}__v_${item.selectedVariant?.id ?? ''}';
        usedCartonsByPool[poolKey] = (usedCartonsByPool[poolKey] ?? 0.0) +
            (item.quantity * uQty) / safeCap;
        continue;
      }

      final liveProductMap = returnedProductsMap[productId];

      if (liveProductMap == null ||
          liveProductMap.isEmpty ||
          liveProductMap['is_deleted'] == true ||
          liveProductMap['is_active'] == false) {
        hasChanges = true;
        continue;
      }
      final liveProduct = ProductModel.fromMap(liveProductMap);
      final currentLabel = item.selectedUnit?.label.trim() ?? 'كرتون';

      ProductVariant? matchingVariant;
      if (item.selectedVariant != null) {
        matchingVariant = liveProduct.variants
            .where((v) =>
                v.id == item.selectedVariant!.id ||
                v.label.trim() == item.selectedVariant!.label.trim())
            .firstOrNull;
        if (matchingVariant == null) {
          hasChanges = true;
          continue;
        }
      }

      final unitSource =
          matchingVariant != null ? matchingVariant.units : liveProduct.units;
      ProductUnit? matchingUnit =
          unitSource.where((u) => u.label.trim() == currentLabel).firstOrNull;

      if (matchingUnit == null && currentLabel == 'كرتون') {
        matchingUnit = ProductUnit(
          label: 'كرتون',
          qty: matchingVariant?.itemsPerCarton ??
              liveProduct.itemsPerCarton ??
              1,
          price: matchingVariant?.price ?? liveProduct.price,
          imageUrl: matchingVariant?.imageUrl ?? liveProduct.imageUrl,
          sizeMl: matchingVariant?.sizeMl ?? liveProduct.sizeMl,
        );
      }

      if (matchingUnit == null) {
        hasChanges = true;
        continue;
      }

      final availableStock = matchingVariant?.stock ?? liveProduct.baseStock;
      final poolKey = '${productId}__v_${matchingVariant?.id ?? ''}';
      final remainingCartons =
          (availableStock - (usedCartonsByPool[poolKey] ?? 0.0))
              .clamp(0.0, availableStock > 0 ? availableStock : 0.0);
      final cartonCapacity =
          (matchingVariant?.itemsPerCarton ?? liveProduct.itemsPerCarton ?? 1)
              .clamp(1, 9999);
      final unitQty = matchingUnit.qty > 0 ? matchingUnit.qty : 1;
      final maxUnitsAllowed =
          ((remainingCartons * cartonCapacity) / unitQty).floor();

      if (maxUnitsAllowed <= 0) {
        hasChanges = true;
        continue;
      }

      final safeQty = item.quantity.clamp(1, maxUnitsAllowed);
      if (safeQty != item.quantity ||
          matchingUnit.price != item.unitPrice ||
          liveProduct.price != item.product.price) {
        hasChanges = true;
      }

      usedCartonsByPool[poolKey] = (usedCartonsByPool[poolKey] ?? 0.0) +
          (safeQty * unitQty) / cartonCapacity;

      final updatedItem = CartItem(
        product: liveProduct,
        quantity: safeQty,
        selectedUnit: matchingUnit,
        selectedVariant: matchingVariant,
      );
      final targetKey = updatedItem.cartKey;
      if (resolvedMap.containsKey(targetKey)) {
        final existing = resolvedMap[targetKey]!;
        resolvedMap[targetKey] = existing.copyWith(
          quantity:
              (existing.quantity + updatedItem.quantity).clamp(1, _maxQuantity),
        );
        hasChanges = true;
      } else {
        resolvedMap[targetKey] = updatedItem;
      }
    }
    if (hasChanges || resolvedMap.length != state.length) {
      state = resolvedMap;
      _save();
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
}

class CartStorageRepository {
  const CartStorageRepository();

  Future<File?> _getFile(String name) async {
    if (kIsWeb) return null;
    final dir = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
    return File('${dir.path}/$name');
  }

  Future<Map<String, CartItem>?> readCart(String key) async {
    String? raw;
    final file = await _getFile('$key.json');
    if (file != null && await file.exists()) {
      try {
        raw = await file.readAsString();
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    // 🛡️ تراجع آمن (Fallback): إذا لم يتوفر الملف يُقرأ الكاش البديل من AppStorage فوراً
    if (raw == null || raw.trim().isEmpty || raw.trim() == '{}') {
      raw = AppStorage.getString(key);
    }

    if (raw == null || raw.trim().isEmpty || raw.trim() == '{}') return null;

    try {
      final map = jsonDecode(raw) as Map<String, dynamic>;
      return map.map(
          (k, v) => MapEntry(k, CartItem.fromJson(v as Map<String, dynamic>)));
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  Future<void> deleteCart(String key) async {
    if (kIsWeb) return;
    try {
      final file = await _getFile('$key.json');
      if (file != null && await file.exists()) await file.delete();
      await AppStorage.remove(key);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> saveCart({
    required String key,
    required Map<String, CartItem> items,
  }) async {
    if (kIsWeb) return;
    final file = await _getFile('$key.json');
    if (file == null) return;

    if (items.isEmpty) {
      if (await file.exists()) await file.delete();
      await AppStorage.remove(key);
      return;
    }
    final jsonString = jsonEncode(
      items.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, v.toJson())),
      toEncodable: (nonEncodable) {
        if (nonEncodable is Timestamp) {
          return nonEncodable.toDate().toIso8601String();
        }
        if (nonEncodable is DateTime) {
          return nonEncodable.toIso8601String();
        }
        return nonEncodable.toString();
      },
    );
    await file.writeAsString(jsonString, flush: true);
    await AppStorage.setString(key, jsonString);
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

class CartScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const CartScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<CartScreen> createState() => _CartScreenState();
}

class _CartScreenState extends ConsumerState<CartScreen> {
  double get _minOrder => AppConfig.minOrderValue;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      _syncCartPrices();
    });
  }

  Future<void> _syncCartPrices() async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    final cart = ref.read(cartProvider);
    if (cart.isEmpty) return;
    final bool hasInternet = await ConnectivityHelper.hasActiveInternet();
    // 🛡️ حماية السلة: منع التحقق الجزئي أوفلاين لحماية أصناف التاجر من الحذف الخاطئ
    if (!hasInternet || !mounted) return;

    final cartProductIds =
        cart.values.map((e) => e.product.id).toSet().toList();
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> latestProducts = [];

    try {
      final chunks = <List<String>>[];
      for (var i = 0; i < cartProductIds.length; i += 30) {
        chunks.add(cartProductIds.sublist(i,
            i + 30 > cartProductIds.length ? cartProductIds.length : i + 30));
      }
      final successfullyQueriedIds = <String>{};
      for (final chunk in chunks) {
        try {
          final snap = await FirebaseFirestore.instance
              .collection('products')
              .where(FieldPath.documentId, whereIn: chunk)
              .get(const GetOptions(source: Source.server));
          if (!mounted) return;
          latestProducts
              .addAll(snap.docs.map((d) => {...d.data(), 'id': d.id}));
          successfullyQueriedIds.addAll(chunk);
        } catch (_) {
          // في حال فشل أي Chunk شبكياً، لا نعتبر منتجاته محذوفة ونحفظها للمحاولة القادمة
        }
      }
      if (!mounted || successfullyQueriedIds.isEmpty) return;

      final hasChanges =
          ref.read(cartProvider.notifier).validateAndUpdatePrices(
                latestProducts,
                queriedBatchIds: successfullyQueriedIds,
              );

      if (hasChanges && mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text(
                '⚠️ تم تحديث سلتك واستبعاد الأصناف التي لم تعد متوفرة ومطابقة أحدث الأسعار',
                style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo')),
            backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
            behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
            duration: Duration(seconds: 4),
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (_) {
      return;
    }
  }

  void _handleDelete(CartItem item) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    ref.read(cartProvider.notifier).removeItem(item.cartKey);
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    if (mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).clearSnackBars();
    }
  }

  void _openQuickAdd() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => const QuickAddSheet(),
    );
  }

  void _goToCheckout() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    final cart = ref.read(cartProvider);
    if (cart.isEmpty) return;

    final uid = AppStorage.userId;

    if (uid == null || uid.isEmpty) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(
          content: Text('يرجى تسجيل الدخول أولاً',
              style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo')),
          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        ));
      }
      return;
    }

    HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
    Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute(
        settings: const RouteSettings(name: '/checkout'),
        builder: (_) => CheckoutScreen(merchantId: uid),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cart = ref.watch(cartProvider);
    final items = cart.values.toList();
    final total = ref.watch(cartTotalProvider);
    final count = ref.watch(cartCountProvider);
    final progress = (total / _minOrder).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    final belowMin = total < _minOrder;

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: context.bgPage,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          children: [
            _buildHeader(context, count),
            Expanded(
              child: cart.isEmpty
                  ? const _EmptyCart()
                  : ListView.separated(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 12),
                      itemCount: items.length,
                      separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      itemBuilder: (_, i) => CartItemCard(
                        item: items[i],
                        onDelete: () => _handleDelete(items[i]),
                      ),
                    ),
            ),
            if (cart.isNotEmpty) _buildBottom(total, belowMin, progress),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildHeader(BuildContext context, int count) {
    return Container(
      color: context.bgHeader,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 16, 20, 14),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          GestureDetector(
            onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
            child: Container(
              width: 40,
              height: 40,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: context.bgPage,
                borderRadius: AppRadius.mdAll,
              ),
              child: const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_ios_rounded, size: 18),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              const Text('سلتي',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                      fontSize: 20,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)),
              Text(
                count == 0 ? 'فارغة' : '$count صنف',
                style: TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'Cairo', fontSize: 12, color: Colors.grey[500]),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const Spacer(),
          GestureDetector(
            onTap: _openQuickAdd,
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
                borderRadius: AppRadius.circleAll,
                border:
                    Border.all(color: AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.3)),
              ),
              child: const Row(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Icon(Icons.add_rounded, size: 16, color: AppColors.primary),
                  SizedBox(width: 4),
                  Text('إضافة',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                          fontSize: 13,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                          color: AppColors.primary)),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBottom(double total, bool belowMin, double progress) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: context.bgCard,
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
              color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.06),
              blurRadius: 12,
              offset: const Offset(0, -4)),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              const Text('الإجمالي',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'Cairo', fontSize: 15, color: Colors.grey)),
              Text(
                '${total.toStringAsFixed(0)} ر.ي',
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                    fontSize: 22,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                    color: AppColors.primary),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          if (belowMin) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                Text(
                  'الحد الأدنى للطلب',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                      fontSize: 11,
                      color: Colors.grey[500]),
                ),
                Text(
                  '${((_minOrder - total) <= 0 ? 0 : (_minOrder - total).ceil())} ر.ي متبقي',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                      fontSize: 11,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      color: Colors.orange),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            ClipRRect(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
              child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                value: progress,
                minHeight: 5,
                backgroundColor: Colors.grey[200],
                color: Colors.orange,
              ),
            ),
          ],
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          SizedBox(
            width: double.infinity,
            child: ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: belowMin ? null : _goToCheckout,
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: AppColors.primary,
                foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                elevation: 0,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
                shape:
                    const RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: AppRadius.lgAll),
              ),
              child: const Row(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  Icon(Icons.shopping_bag_rounded, size: 20),
                  SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Text('إتمام الطلب',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                          fontSize: 16,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class CheckoutScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  final String merchantId;
  const CheckoutScreen({super.key, required this.merchantId});

  @override
  ConsumerState<CheckoutScreen> createState() => _CheckoutScreenState();
}

class _CheckoutScreenState extends ConsumerState<CheckoutScreen> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final _storeCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final _nameCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final _contactCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final _addressCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final _notesCtrl = TextEditingController();

  LatLng? _location;
  String _paymentMethod = 'cash';
  bool _isLoading = false;
  String? _orderIdempotencyKey;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _prefillMerchantDetails();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) async {
      final changed = await _validateCartBeforeCheckout();
      if (changed && mounted) {
        _notifyCartModified();
      }
    });
  }

  void _notifyCartModified() {
    final cartNow = ref.read(cartProvider);
    final isCartEmpty = cartNow.isEmpty;

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: ctx.bgCard,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title: Row(
          children: [
            Icon(
                isCartEmpty
                    ? Icons.remove_shopping_cart_rounded
                    : Icons.warning_amber_rounded,
                color: isCartEmpty ? Colors.red : Colors.orange),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text(isCartEmpty ? 'السلة أصبحت فارغة' : 'تنبيه في محتويات السلة',
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    fontSize: 16)),
          ],
        ),
        content: Text(
          isCartEmpty
              ? 'نعتذر منك، لم تعد الأصناف التي اخترتها متوفرة في المستودع حالياً. يرجى العودة للتسوق واختيار أصناف أخرى.'
              : 'تم تحديث سلتك واستبعاد بعض الأصناف أو تعديل أسعارها لعدم توفرها في المستودع. يرجى مراجعة إجمالي الطلب قبل المتابعة.',
          style:
              const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo', fontSize: 13, height: 1.6),
        ),
        actions: [
          if (!isCartEmpty)
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () {
                Navigator.pop(ctx);
                if (Navigator.of(context).canPop()) {
                  Navigator.of(context).pop();
                }
              },
              child: const Text('العودة للسلة',
                  style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo', color: Colors.grey)),
            ),
          ElevatedButton(
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: AppColors.primary,
              foregroundColor: Colors.white,
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
            ),
            onPressed: () {
              Navigator.pop(ctx);
              if (isCartEmpty && Navigator.of(context).canPop()) {
                Navigator.of(context)
                    .pop(); // إرجاع المستخدم فوراً إذا فرغت السلة
              }
            },
            child: Text(isCartEmpty ? 'العودة للتسوق' : 'متابعة بالمتوفر',
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'Cairo', fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _prefillMerchantDetails() async {
    final localName = AppStorage.userName ?? '';
    final localPhone = AppStorage.userPhone ?? '';
    final localStore = AppStorage.storeName ?? '';
    if (localStore.isNotEmpty && _storeCtrl.text.isEmpty) {
      _storeCtrl.text = localStore;
    }
    if (localName.isNotEmpty && _nameCtrl.text.isEmpty) {
      _nameCtrl.text = localName;
    }
    if (localPhone.isNotEmpty && _contactCtrl.text.isEmpty) {
      _contactCtrl.text = localPhone.replaceFirst('+967', '0');
    }
    try {
      final doc = await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('profiles')
          .doc(widget.merchantId)
          .get();
      if (!mounted || !doc.exists || doc.data() == null) return;
      final data = doc.data()!;

      setState(() {
        if (_storeCtrl.text.isEmpty) {
          _storeCtrl.text = data['store_name']?.toString() ?? '';
        }
        if (_nameCtrl.text.isEmpty) {
          _nameCtrl.text = data['full_name']?.toString() ?? '';
        }
        if (_contactCtrl.text.isEmpty) {
          final phone = data['phone_number']?.toString() ?? '';
          _contactCtrl.text = phone.replaceFirst('+967', '0');
        }
        if (_location == null) {
          final lat = (data['latitude'] as num?)?.toDouble();
          final lng = (data['longitude'] as num?)?.toDouble();
          if (lat != null && lng != null) {
            _location = LatLng(lat, lng);
          }
        }
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (kDebugMode) {
        debugPrint('[CheckoutScreen] failed to prefill profile data: $e');
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _storeCtrl.dispose();
    _nameCtrl.dispose();
    _contactCtrl.dispose();
    _addressCtrl.dispose();
    _notesCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _pickLocation() async {
    final result = await Navigator.of(context).push<LatLng>(
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const LocationPickerScreen()),
    );
    if (result != null && mounted) setState(() => _location = result);
  }

// تم إلغاء showDialog المعرض لتعارض المسارات واستبداله بـ Overlay مدمج وآمن 100% داخل الشجرة
  bool _isPlacingOrder = false;
  Future<void> _placeOrder() async {
    if (_isPlacingOrder) return;
    setState(() {
      _isPlacingOrder = true;
      _isLoading = true;
    });
    try {
      final cartChanged = await _validateCartBeforeCheckout();
      if (mounted && cartChanged) {
        setState(() => _isLoading = false);
      }
      if (cartChanged) {
        if (mounted) {
          if (ref.read(cartProvider).isEmpty) {
            _notifyCartModified();
            return;
          }
          final proceedWithAvailable = await showDialog<bool>(
            context: context,
            barrierDismissible: false,
            builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
              backgroundColor: ctx.bgCard,
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
              title: const Text('تحديث في محتوى السلة',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'Cairo', fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
              content: const Text(
                'تم استبعاد أصناف غير متوفرة أو تحديث الأسعار. هل تريد المتابعة بالأصناف المتوفرة الآن؟',
                style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo', fontSize: 13),
              ),
              actions: [
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
                  child: const Text('مراجعة السلة',
                      style:
                          TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo', color: Colors.grey)),
                ),
                ElevatedButton(
                  style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: AppColors.primary),
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
                  child: const Text('متابعة بالمتوفر',
                      style:
                          TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo', color: Colors.white)),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );

          if (proceedWithAvailable != true) {
            if (mounted && Navigator.of(context).canPop()) {
              Navigator.of(context).pop();
            }
            return;
          }
        }
      }
      await _placeOrderInternal();
    } catch (_) {
      _showError('تعذر التحقق من أحدث الأسعار والمخزون، يرجى المحاولة مجدداً');
    } finally {
      _isLoading = false;
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isPlacingOrder = false);
      } else {
        _isPlacingOrder = false;
      }
    }
  }

  Future<bool> _validateCartBeforeCheckout() async {
    final cart = ref.read(cartProvider);
    if (cart.isEmpty) return false;
    try {
      final hasNet = await ConnectivityHelper.hasActiveInternet();
      if (!hasNet) return false;

      final productIds = cart.values.map((e) => e.product.id).toSet().toList();
      final chunks = <List<String>>[];
      for (var i = 0; i < productIds.length; i += 30) {
        chunks.add(productIds.sublist(
            i, i + 30 > productIds.length ? productIds.length : i + 30));
      }
      final liveDocs = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      final successfullyQueriedIds = <String>{};

      await Future.wait(
        chunks.map((chunk) async {
          try {
            final snap = await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                .collection('products')
                .where(FieldPath.documentId, whereIn: chunk)
                .get(const GetOptions(source: Source.server))
                .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 4));
            liveDocs.addAll(snap.docs.map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()}));
            successfullyQueriedIds.addAll(chunk);
          } catch (_) {}
        }),
      );

      if (!mounted || successfullyQueriedIds.isEmpty) return false;

      return ref.read(cartProvider.notifier).validateAndUpdatePrices(
            liveDocs,
            queriedBatchIds: successfullyQueriedIds,
          );
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _placeOrderInternal() async {
    // ── 1. فحص الاتصال بالإنترنت أولاً ──
    final bool hasNet = await ConnectivityHelper.hasActiveInternet();
    if (!hasNet) {
      _showError(
          'يتطلب إرسال الطلب اتصالاً نشطاً بالإنترنت لمطابقة المخزون الفعلي');
      return;
    }

    // ── 2. التحقق من السلة ──
    final cart = ref.read(cartProvider);
    if (cart.isEmpty) {
      _showError('السلة فارغة، أضف منتجات أولاً');
      if (mounted && Navigator.of(context).canPop()) {
        Navigator.of(context).pop();
      }
      return;
    }
    if (cart.length > AppConfig.maxOrderItems) {
      _showError(
          'عذراً، لا يمكن أن يحتوي الطلب الواحد على أكثر من ${AppConfig.maxOrderItems} صنفاً مختلفاً. يرجى تقسيم الطلب.');
      return;
    }

    // ── 3. التحقق من الحد الأدنى ──
    final double serverMinOrder = AppConfig.minOrderValue;
    final total = ref.read(cartTotalProvider);
    if (total < serverMinOrder) {
      _showError(
          'الحد الأدنى للطلب هو ${serverMinOrder.toStringAsFixed(0)} ر.ي');
      return;
    }


    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;

    if (_location == null) {
      _showError('يرجى تحديد موقع التوصيل');
      return;
    }
    final cleanContact = _contactCtrl.text.trim();
    if (cleanContact.isEmpty || cleanContact.length < 9) {
      _showError('يرجى إدخال رقم هاتف صحيح للتواصل (9 أرقام على الأقل)');
      return;
    }

    final String normalizedPhone;
    try {
      normalizedPhone = AuthService.formatPhone(cleanContact);
    } catch (e) {
      _showError('صيغة رقم الهاتف غير صحيحة، تأكد من إدخال 9 أرقام تبدأ بـ 7');
      return;
    }

    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    HapticFeedback.heavyImpact();

    final String merchantId = widget.merchantId;
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> itemsList = cart.values
        .map((e) => <String, dynamic>{
              'product_id': e.product.id,
              'product_name': e.displayName,
              'quantity': e.quantity,
              'price': e.unitPrice,
              if (e.selectedVariant != null) ...{
                'variant_id': e.selectedVariant!.id,
                'variant_label': e.selectedVariant!.label,
              },
              if (e.selectedUnit != null) ...{
                'unit_label': e.selectedUnit!.label,
                'unit_qty': e.selectedUnit!.qty,
              },
            })
        .toList();
    final String? notesString =
        _notesCtrl.text.trim().isEmpty ? null : _notesCtrl.text.trim();

    final Map<String, dynamic> extraDataMap = {
      'store_name': _storeCtrl.text.trim(),
      'customer_name': _nameCtrl.text.trim(),
      'merchant_name': _nameCtrl.text.trim(),
      'contact': normalizedPhone,
      'phone_number': normalizedPhone,
      'delivery_address': _storeCtrl.text.trim(),
      'latitude': _location!.latitude,
      'longitude': _location!.longitude,
      'payment_method': _paymentMethod,
    };
    try {
      _orderIdempotencyKey ??=
          FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('orders').doc().id;

      final order = await OrdersService.placeOrder(
        merchantId: merchantId,
        items: itemsList,
        expectedTotal: total,
        notes: notesString,
        extraData: extraDataMap,
        orderId: _orderIdempotencyKey,
      ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 30));

      _orderIdempotencyKey = null;
      if (!mounted) return;
      ref.read(cartProvider.notifier).clear();

      Navigator.of(context).pushAndRemoveUntil(
        PageRouteBuilder(
          pageBuilder: (_, __, ___) => OrderStatusScreen(order: order),
          transitionsBuilder: (_, anim, __, child) => FadeTransition(
            opacity: CurvedAnimation(parent: anim, curve: Curves.easeIn),
            child: child,
          ),
        ),
        (route) => route.isFirst,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      HapticFeedback.vibrate();

      final err = e.toString();
      final RegExp exp = RegExp(
        r'(?:PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE_|OUT_OF_STOCK_)\[([^\]]+)\]',
        caseSensitive: false,
      );
      final matches = exp.allMatches(err);
      if (matches.isNotEmpty && mounted) {
        final cartNotifier = ref.read(cartProvider.notifier);
        final keysToRemove = <String>{};

        for (final m in matches) {
          final rawContent = m.group(1);
          if (rawContent == null || rawContent.trim().isEmpty) continue;

          final tokens = rawContent.split(RegExp(r'[,;]+'));
          for (final token in tokens) {
            final cleanToken = token.trim();
            if (cleanToken.isEmpty) continue;

            if (cleanToken.contains(':')) {
              final parts = cleanToken.split(':');
              final badProdId = parts[0].trim();

              if (parts.length >= 3) {
                final badVarId = parts[1].trim();
                final badUnit = parts.sublist(2).join(':').trim();
                for (final entry in cart.entries) {
                  final itemUnit = entry.value.unitLabel.trim();
                  final itemVarId = entry.value.selectedVariant?.id ?? '';
                  if (entry.value.product.id == badProdId &&
                      (badVarId.isEmpty || itemVarId == badVarId) &&
                      (itemUnit == badUnit || badUnit.isEmpty)) {
                    keysToRemove.add(entry.key);
                  }
                }
              } else {
                final second = parts[1].trim();
                for (final entry in cart.entries) {
                  final itemUnit = entry.value.unitLabel.trim();
                  final itemVarId = entry.value.selectedVariant?.id ?? '';
                  final matchesVariant =
                      itemVarId.isNotEmpty && itemVarId == second;
                  final matchesUnit = itemVarId.isEmpty &&
                      (itemUnit == second || second.isEmpty);
                  if (entry.value.product.id == badProdId &&
                      (matchesVariant || matchesUnit)) {
                    keysToRemove.add(entry.key);
                  }
                }
              }
            } else {
              for (final entry in cart.entries) {
                if (entry.value.product.id == cleanToken) {
                  keysToRemove.add(entry.key);
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
        if (keysToRemove.isNotEmpty) {
          for (final k in keysToRemove) {
            cartNotifier.removeItem(k);
          }
          _orderIdempotencyKey = null;
          _showError(
              'نعتذر، تم استبعاد (${keysToRemove.length}) من الأصناف غير المتوفرة حالياً في المستودع من سلتك.');
          return;
        }
      }

      // 🔒 الحفاظ على _orderIdempotencyKey في حالات انقطاع النت/المهلة لضمان Idempotent Retry
      if (matches.isNotEmpty) {
        _orderIdempotencyKey =
            null; // تصفيره فقط إذا تغيرت محتويات السلة لاستبعاد أصناف
      }

      String friendlyMessage;
      if (e is FirebaseFunctionsException &&
          e.message != null &&
          e.message!.isNotEmpty) {
        if (e.message!.contains('PRICE_DIVERGENCE')) {
          await _validateCartBeforeCheckout();
          friendlyMessage =
              'تغيرت أسعار بعض الأصناف، تم تحديث سلتك بالأسعار الجديدة. يرجى مراجعتها وتأكيد الطلب.';
        } else {
          friendlyMessage = e.message!;
        }
      } else {
        final lowerErr = err.toLowerCase();
        friendlyMessage = (lowerErr.contains('network') ||
                lowerErr.contains('timeout') ||
                lowerErr.contains('socket'))
            ? 'تعذر الاتصال بالخادم، يرجى التحقق من اتصال الإنترنت والمحاولة مجدداً'
            : (lowerErr.contains('permission') ||
                    lowerErr.contains('banned') ||
                    lowerErr.contains('inactive'))
                ? 'حسابك بانتظار التفعيل أو معطل من قبل الإدارة'
                : 'تعذر إتمام الطلب حالياً، يرجى المحاولة بعد لحظات';
      }

      _showError(friendlyMessage);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  void _showError(String msg) {
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
      content: Row(children: [
        const Icon(Icons.error_rounded, color: Colors.white, size: 18),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        Expanded(child: Text(msg, style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo'))),
      ]),
      backgroundColor: Colors.red[700],
      behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
      margin: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
    ));
  }

                              icon: Icons.phone_rounded,

                              inputFormatters: [
                                TextInputFormatter.withFunction(
                                    (oldVal, newVal) {
                                  const arabic = {
                                    '٠': '0',
                                    '١': '1',
                                    '٢': '2',
                                    '٣': '3',
                                    '٤': '4',
                                    '٥': '5',

                                    '٧': '7',
                                    '٨': '8',
                                    '٩': '9',
                                    '۰': '0',
                                    '۱': '1',
                                    '۲': '2',

                                    '۴': '4',
                                    '۵': '5',

                                      'مثال: أرسل بعد العصر\nالتوصيل للباب الخلفي',

class _FormField extends StatelessWidget {
  final TextEditingController controller;
  final String label;
  final String hint;
  final IconData icon;
  final TextInputType? keyboardType;
  final List<TextInputFormatter>? inputFormatters;
  final String? Function(String?)? validator;

  const _FormField({
    required this.controller,
    required this.label,
    required this.hint,
    required this.icon,
    this.keyboardType,
    this.inputFormatters,
    this.validator,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return TextFormField(
      controller: controller,
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      keyboardType: keyboardType,
      inputFormatters: inputFormatters,
      style: TextStyle(
        fontFamily: 'Cairo',
        fontSize: 14,
        color: context.textPrimary,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
      ),
      validator: validator ??
          (v) {
            if (v == null || v.trim().isEmpty) return 'هذا الحقل مطلوب';
            return null;
          },
      decoration: InputDecoration(
        labelText: label,
        hintText: hint,
        labelStyle: TextStyle(
            fontFamily: 'Cairo', color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 13),
        hintStyle: TextStyle(
            fontFamily: 'Cairo', color: context.textHint, fontSize: 13),
        prefixIcon: Icon(icon, color: context.iconSecondary, size: 20),
        filled: true,
        fillColor: context.bgInput,
        border: const OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: AppRadius.mdAll,
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFEEEEEE)),
        ),
        enabledBorder: const OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: AppRadius.mdAll,
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFEEEEEE)),
        ),
        focusedBorder: const OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: AppRadius.mdAll,
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: AppColors.primary, width: 1.5),
        ),
        errorBorder: const OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: AppRadius.mdAll,
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.red),
        ),
        contentPadding:
            const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 14),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _PaymentOption extends StatelessWidget {
  final String value;
  final String groupValue;
  final String label;
  final String subtitle;
  final IconData icon;
  final ValueChanged<String?> onChanged;

  const _PaymentOption({
    required this.value,
    required this.groupValue,
    required this.label,
    required this.subtitle,
    required this.icon,
    required this.onChanged,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isSelected = value == groupValue;
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
        onChanged(value);
      },
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected
              ? AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.15)
              : context.bgCard, // 👈 متكيف تلقائياً مع خلفية الوضع الداكن
          borderRadius: AppRadius.mdAll,
          border: Border.all(
            color: isSelected ? AppColors.primary : context.borderColor,
            width: isSelected ? 1.5 : 1,
          ),
        ),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: isSelected
                    ? AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.15)
                    : context.bgInput,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
              ),
              child: Icon(icon,
                  size: 18,
                  color:
                      isSelected ? AppColors.primary : context.iconSecondary),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(label,
                      style: TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                          fontSize: 14,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                          color: isSelected
                              ? AppColors.primary
                              : context.textPrimary)), // 👈 نص أبيض وواضح
                  Text(subtitle,
                      style: TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                          fontSize: 11,
                          color:
                              context.textSecondary)), // 👈 نص ثانوي رمادي فاتح
                ],
              ),
            ),
            AnimatedContainer(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
              width: 22,
              height: 22,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                color: isSelected ? AppColors.primary : Colors.transparent,
                border: Border.all(
                  color: isSelected ? AppColors.primary : context.borderColor,
                  width: 2,
                ),
              ),
              child: isSelected
                  ? const Icon(Icons.check_rounded,
                      size: 13, color: Colors.white)
                  : null,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// FILE: lib\features\merchant\cart\widgets\cart_floating_button.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../../../core/constants/app_colors.dart';
import '../providers/cart_provider.dart';
import '../screens/cart_screen.dart';

class CartFloatingButton extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const CartFloatingButton({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<CartFloatingButton> createState() => _CartFloatingButtonState();
}

class _CartFloatingButtonState extends ConsumerState<CartFloatingButton>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _pulseCtrl;
  late Animation<double> _pulse;
  int prevCount = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _pulseCtrl = AnimationController(
        vsync: this, duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300));
    _pulse = Tween<double>(begin: 1.0, end: 1.25).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(parent: _pulseCtrl, curve: Curves.elasticOut),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _pulseCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final count = ref.watch(cartCountProvider);
    final total = ref.watch(cartTotalProvider);

    ref.listen<int>(cartCountProvider, (prev, next) {
      if (next > (prev ?? 0)) {
        _pulseCtrl.forward().then((_) => _pulseCtrl.reverse());
      }
    });

    if (count == 0) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
        Navigator.of(context).push(
          MaterialPageRoute(
            builder: (_) => const CartScreen(),
          ),
        );
      },
      child: Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 16),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: AppColors.primary,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
              blurRadius: 16,
              offset: const Offset(0, 6),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Stack(
              clipBehavior: Clip.none,
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.shopping_cart_rounded,
                    color: Colors.white, size: 24),
                Positioned(
                  top: -6,
                  right: -6,
                  child: ScaleTransition(
                    scale: _pulse,
                    child: Container(
                      width: 18,
                      height: 18,
                      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      ),
                      child: Center(
                        child: Text(
                          '$count',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                            fontSize: 10,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                            color: AppColors.primary,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            const Text('السلة',
                style: TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                    fontSize: 15,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    color: Colors.white)),
            const Spacer(),
            Text('${total.toStringAsFixed(0)} ر.ي',
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                    fontSize: 15,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                    color: Colors.white)),
            const SizedBox(width: 6),
            const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_rounded,
                color: Colors.white, size: 14),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
