import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show rootBundle;
import 'package:pdf/pdf.dart';
import 'package:pdf/widgets.dart' as pw;
import 'package:printing/printing.dart';
import '../../../../core/services/local_storage.dart';
import '../models/ledger_customer.dart';
import '../models/ledger_entry.dart';

class LedgerPdfService {
  /// تحويل اليوم إلى اللغة العربية
  static String formatArabicDay(DateTime dt) {
    switch (dt.weekday) {
      case DateTime.saturday:
        return 'السبت';
      case DateTime.sunday:
        return 'الأحد';
      case DateTime.monday:
        return 'الإثنين';
      case DateTime.tuesday:
        return 'الثلاثاء';
      case DateTime.wednesday:
        return 'الأربعاء';
      case DateTime.thursday:
        return 'الخميس';
      case DateTime.friday:
        return 'الجمعة';
      default:
        return '';
    }
  }

  /// تنسيق التاريخ بصيغة YYYY/MM/DD
  static String formatArabicDate(DateTime dt) {
    return '${dt.year}/${dt.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${dt.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

  /// تنسيق الوقت بنظام 12 ساعة (بعد 12 تظهر 01:00 م بدلاً من 13:00)
  static String formatArabicTime12(DateTime dt) {
    int hour = dt.hour;
    final minute = dt.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final period = hour >= 12 ? 'م' : 'ص';

    if (hour == 0) {
      hour = 12;
    } else if (hour > 12) {
      hour -= 12;
    }

    final hourStr = hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    return '$hourStr:$minute $period';
  }

  /// تنسيق كامل للتاريخ والوقت: اليوم التاريخ - الوقت
  static String formatFullDateTime(DateTime dt) {
    return '${formatArabicDay(dt)} ${formatArabicDate(dt)} - ${formatArabicTime12(dt)}';
  }

  /// توليد وثيقة كشف الحساب الرسمية بصيغة PDF
  static Future<Uint8List> generateStatementPdf({
    required LedgerCustomer customer,
    required List<LedgerEntry> entries,
    String? storeName,
    String? storePhone,
  }) async {
    final pdf = pw.Document();

    // تحميل خط Cairo العربي المدمج في المشروع
    final fontRegularData = await rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/Cairo-Regular.ttf');
    final fontBoldData = await rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/Cairo-Bold.ttf');
    final ttfRegular = pw.Font.ttf(fontRegularData);
    final ttfBold = pw.Font.ttf(fontBoldData);

    final merchantName = storeName ?? AppStorage.userName ?? 'متجر البقالة';
    final merchantPhone = storePhone ?? AppStorage.userPhone ?? '';
    final now = DateTime.now();

    // حساب المجاميع
    double totalDebts = 0;
    double totalPayments = 0;
    for (final e in entries) {
      if (e.isVoided) continue;
      if (e.isDebt) totalDebts += e.amount;
      if (e.isPayment) totalPayments += e.amount;
    }

    pdf.addPage(
      pw.MultiPage(
        pageFormat: PdfPageFormat.a4,
        margin: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(28),
        theme: pw.ThemeData.withFont(
          base: ttfRegular,
          bold: ttfBold,
        ),
        textDirection: pw.TextDirection.rtl,
        build: (context) => [
          // ══ Header ══
          pw.Container(
            padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(16),
            decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
              color: PdfColors.blueGrey50,
              borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(10),
              border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.blueGrey200, width: 0.8),
            ),
            child: pw.Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                pw.Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    pw.Text(
                      merchantName,
                      style: pw.TextStyle(
                        font: ttfBold,
                        fontSize: 18,
                        color: PdfColors.blueGrey900,
                      ),
                    ),
                    pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
                    pw.Text(
                      'سجل حسابات العملاء والديون الآجلة',
                      style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfRegular, fontSize: 11, color: PdfColors.grey700),
                    ),
                    if (merchantPhone.isNotEmpty) ...[
                      pw.SizedBox(height: 2),
                      pw.Text(
                        'هاتف المتجر: $merchantPhone',
                        style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfRegular, fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.grey700),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
                pw.Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                  children: [
                    pw.Container(
                      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                      decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
                        color: PdfColors.blue800,
                        borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(6),
                      ),
                      child: pw.Text(
                        'كشف حساب تفصيلي',
                        style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfBold, fontSize: 12, color: PdfColors.white),
                      ),
                    ),
                    pw.SizedBox(height: 6),
                    pw.Text(
                      'تاريخ الاستخراج:',
                      style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfBold, fontSize: 9, color: PdfColors.grey700),
                    ),
                    pw.Text(
                      formatFullDateTime(now),
                      style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfRegular, fontSize: 9, color: PdfColors.black),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),

          pw.SizedBox(height: 14),

          // ══ بيانات العميل ══
          pw.Container(
            padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(12),
            decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
              border: pw.Border.all(color: PdfColors.grey300),
              borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(8),
            ),
            child: pw.Row(
              children: [
                pw.Expanded(
                  child: pw.Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      pw.RichText(
                        text: pw.TextSpan(
                          children: [
                            pw.TextSpan(
                              text: 'اسم العميل: ',
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfBold, fontSize: 11, color: PdfColors.grey800),
                            ),
                            pw.TextSpan(
                              text: customer.name,
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfBold, fontSize: 12, color: PdfColors.black),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
                      pw.RichText(
                        text: pw.TextSpan(
                          children: [
                            pw.TextSpan(
                              text: 'رقم الهاتف: ',
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfRegular, fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.grey700),
                            ),
                            pw.TextSpan(
                              text: customer.phone.isNotEmpty ? customer.phone : 'غير مسجل',
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfRegular, fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.black),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                pw.Container(width: 1, height: 40, color: PdfColors.grey300),
                pw.SizedBox(width: 14),
                pw.Expanded(
                  child: pw.Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      pw.RichText(
                        text: pw.TextSpan(
                          children: [
                            pw.TextSpan(
                              text: 'سقف الدين المحدد: ',
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfRegular, fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.grey700),
                            ),
                            pw.TextSpan(
                              text: customer.creditLimit > 0
                                  ? '${customer.creditLimit.toStringAsFixed(0)} ريال'
                                  : 'مفتوح (بدون سقف)',
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfBold, fontSize: 10, color: PdfColors.black),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      pw.SizedBox(height: 4),
                      pw.RichText(
                        text: pw.TextSpan(
                          children: [
                            pw.TextSpan(
                              text: 'الرصيد المتبقي للدفع: ',
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfBold, fontSize: 11, color: PdfColors.red800),
                            ),
                            pw.TextSpan(
                              text: '${customer.currentBalance.toStringAsFixed(0)} ريال',
                              style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfBold, fontSize: 13, color: PdfColors.red900),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),

          pw.SizedBox(height: 14),

          // ══ بطاقات الإحصاءات السريعة ══
          pw.Row(
            children: [
              pw.Expanded(
                child: _buildSummaryBox(
                  title: 'إجمالي المشتريات الآجلة',
                  value: '${totalDebts.toStringAsFixed(0)} ريال',
                  ttfBold: ttfBold,
                  ttfRegular: ttfRegular,
                  color: PdfColors.orange50,
                  textColor: PdfColors.deepOrange900,
                ),
              ),
              pw.SizedBox(width: 8),
              pw.Expanded(
                child: _buildSummaryBox(
                  title: 'إجمالي السداد النقدي',
                  value: '${totalPayments.toStringAsFixed(0)} ريال',
                  ttfBold: ttfBold,
                  ttfRegular: ttfRegular,
                  color: PdfColors.green50,
                  textColor: PdfColors.green900,
                ),
              ),
              pw.SizedBox(width: 8),
              pw.Expanded(
                child: _buildSummaryBox(
                  title: 'المبلغ المتبقي حالياً',
                  value: '${customer.currentBalance.toStringAsFixed(0)} ريال',
                  ttfBold: ttfBold,
                  ttfRegular: ttfRegular,
                  color: customer.isOverLimit ? PdfColors.red50 : PdfColors.blue50,
                  textColor: customer.isOverLimit ? PdfColors.red900 : PdfColors.blue900,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),

          pw.SizedBox(height: 16),

          // ══ جدول الحركات التفصيلي ══
          pw.Text(
            'سجل الحركات المالية المفصل:',
            style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfBold, fontSize: 12, color: PdfColors.blueGrey900),
          ),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 6),

          pw.TableHelper.fromTextArray(
            border: pw.TableBorder.all(color: PdfColors.grey300, width: 0.5),
            headerStyle: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfBold, fontSize: 9, color: PdfColors.white),
            headerDecoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(color: PdfColors.blueGrey800),
            cellStyle: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfRegular, fontSize: 8.5),
            cellAlignment: pw.Alignment.center,
            columnWidths: {
              0: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(0.6), // #
              1: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(2.3), // التاريخ والوقت
              2: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.2), // نوع الحركة
              3: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(3.2), // البيان والأصناف
              4: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.3), // مدين
              5: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.3), // دائن
              6: const pw.FlexColumnWidth(1.4), // الرصيد بعد الحركة
            },
            headers: [
              '#',
              'اليوم والتاريخ والوقت',
              'نوع القيد',
              'البيان وتفاصيل الأصناف بالحبة',
              'مدين (+)',
              'دائن (-)',
              'الرصيد',
            ],
            data: List.generate(entries.length, (index) {
              final entry = entries[index];
              final dateStr = entry.createdAt != null
                  ? formatFullDateTime(entry.createdAt!)
                  : '-';

              String details = entry.notes;
              if (entry.items.isNotEmpty) {
                final itemsDesc = entry.items.map((i) {
                  return '${i.name} (${i.quantity.toStringAsFixed(0)} حبة × ${i.unitPrice.toStringAsFixed(0)})';
                }).join(' + ');
                details = details.isNotEmpty ? '$itemsDesc | $details' : itemsDesc;
              }
              if (details.isEmpty) {
                details = entry.isDebt ? 'مشتريات آجل' : 'دفعة نقدية كاش';
              }

              if (entry.isVoided) {
                details = '[ملغي] $details';
              }

              return [
                '${index + 1}',
                dateStr,
                entry.typeLabel,
                details,
                entry.isDebt && !entry.isVoided ? '${entry.amount.toStringAsFixed(0)}' : '-',
                entry.isPayment && !entry.isVoided ? '${entry.amount.toStringAsFixed(0)}' : '-',
                entry.isVoided ? 'قيد ملغي' : '${entry.balanceAfter.toStringAsFixed(0)} ريال',
              ];
            }),
          ),

          pw.SizedBox(height: 24),

          // ══ قسم التوقيعات ══
          pw.Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              pw.Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  pw.Text('توقيع العميل / المقر بالدين', style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfBold, fontSize: 10)),
                  pw.SizedBox(height: 30),
                  pw.Container(width: 140, height: 1, color: PdfColors.black),
                ],
              ),
              pw.Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  pw.Text('ختم وتوقيع إدارة المتجر', style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfBold, fontSize: 10)),
                  pw.SizedBox(height: 30),
                  pw.Container(width: 140, height: 1, color: PdfColors.black),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),

          pw.SizedBox(height: 20),

          // ══ Footer ══
          pw.Divider(color: PdfColors.grey300),
          pw.Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              pw.Text(
                'تم إصدار هذا الكشف عبر نظام وصال الذكي لإدارة التوزيع والتجزئة',
                style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfRegular, fontSize: 8, color: PdfColors.grey600),
              ),
              pw.Text(
                'صفحة 1 من 1',
                style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfRegular, fontSize: 8, color: PdfColors.grey600),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    return pdf.save();
  }

  static pw.Widget _buildSummaryBox({
    required String title,
    required String value,
    required pw.Font ttfBold,
    required pw.Font ttfRegular,
    required PdfColor color,
    required PdfColor textColor,
  }) {
    return pw.Container(
      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8, horizontal: 10),
      decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
        color: color,
        borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(6),
        border: pw.Border.all(color: textColor, width: 0.5),
      ),
      child: pw.Column(
        children: [
          pw.Text(title, style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfRegular, fontSize: 8.5, color: PdfColors.grey800)),
          pw.SizedBox(height: 2),
          pw.Text(value, style: pw.TextStyle(font: ttfBold, fontSize: 11, color: textColor)),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  /// معاينة أو طباعة كشف الحساب مباشرة
  static Future<void> printOrShareStatement({
    required LedgerCustomer customer,
    required List<LedgerEntry> entries,
    String? storeName,
    String? storePhone,
  }) async {
    final pdfBytes = await generateStatementPdf(
      customer: customer,
      entries: entries,
      storeName: storeName,
      storePhone: storePhone,
    );

    await Printing.layoutPdf(
      onLayout: (PdfPageFormat format) async => pdfBytes,
      name: 'كشف_حساب_${customer.name}_${formatArabicDate(DateTime.now()).replaceAll('/', '-')}',
    );
  }
}


// ==================================================
// FILE: lib\features\merchant\ledger\services\ledger_service.dart
// ==================================================

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:cloud_functions/cloud_functions.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import '../../../../core/services/app_cache.dart';
import '../../products/services/products_service.dart';
import '../models/ledger_customer.dart';
import '../models/ledger_entry.dart';
import '../models/ledger_item.dart';
import '../models/ledger_summary.dart';

class LedgerService {
  static final FirebaseFirestore _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;
  static final FirebaseFunctions _functions = FirebaseFunctions.instanceFor(region: 'us-central1');

  // ذاكرة تخزين مؤقتة محلية لأسعار التجزئة
  static final Map<String, double> _retailPriceCache = {};

  /// جلب تدفق قائمة العملاء النشطين للتاجر
  static Stream<List<LedgerCustomer>> streamCustomers(String merchantId) {
    return _db
        .collection('merchant_customers')
        .where('merchant_id', isEqualTo: merchantId)
        .where('is_deleted', isEqualTo: false)
        .snapshots()
        .map((snapshot) {
      final list = snapshot.docs
          .map((doc) => LedgerCustomer.fromMap(doc.id, doc.data()))
          .toList();
      // ترتيب تنازلي حسب تاريخ آخر حركة أو التعديل
      list.sort((a, b) {
        final aTime = a.lastTransactionAt ?? a.updatedAt ?? DateTime(2000);
        final bTime = b.lastTransactionAt ?? b.updatedAt ?? DateTime(2000);
        return bTime.compareTo(aTime);
      });
      return list;
    });
  }

  /// جلب ملخص ديون السوق للتاجر
  static Stream<LedgerSummary> streamSummary(String merchantId) {
    return _db
        .collection('merchant_ledger_summaries')
        .doc(merchantId)
        .snapshots()
        .map((doc) {
      if (!doc.exists || doc.data() == null) {
        return LedgerSummary(merchantId: merchantId);
      }
      return LedgerSummary.fromMap(merchantId, doc.data()!);
    });
  }

  /// جلب تدفق سجل الحركات لعميل محدد
  static Stream<List<LedgerEntry>> streamCustomerEntries(String merchantId, String customerId) {
    return _db
        .collection('merchant_ledger_entries')
        .where('merchant_id', isEqualTo: merchantId)
        .where('customer_id', isEqualTo: customerId)
        .snapshots()
        .map((snapshot) {
      final entries = snapshot.docs
          .map((doc) => LedgerEntry.fromMap(doc.id, doc.data()))
          .toList();
      entries.sort((a, b) {
        final aDate = a.createdAt ?? DateTime(2000);
        final bDate = b.createdAt ?? DateTime(2000);
        return bDate.compareTo(aDate);
      });
      return entries;
    });
  }

  /// تسجيل قيد مالي جديد (دين أو سداد دفعة نقدية) عبر Cloud Function الآمنة
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> recordTransaction({
    required String customerId,
    required String type, // 'debt' or 'payment'
    required double amount,
    String? notes,
    List<LedgerItem>? items,
  }) async {
    try {
      final callable = _functions.httpsCallable('recordLedgerTransaction');
      final result = await callable.call({
        'customerId': customerId,
        'type': type,
        'amount': amount,
        'notes': notes,
        'items': items?.map((i) => i.toMap()).toList(),
      });
      return Map<String, dynamic>.from(result.data as Map);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('❌ Error in recordTransaction: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  /// إلغاء قيد مالي وعكس الحساب ذرياً
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> voidTransaction({
    required String customerId,
    required String entryId,
  }) async {
    try {
      final callable = _functions.httpsCallable('voidLedgerTransaction');
      final result = await callable.call({
        'customerId': customerId,
        'entryId': entryId,
      });
      return Map<String, dynamic>.from(result.data as Map);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('❌ Error in voidTransaction: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  /// حفظ أو تعديل عميل في الدفتر
  static Future<String> saveCustomer({
    String? customerId,
    required String name,
    String? phone,
    double creditLimit = 0.0,
    String? notes,
  }) async {
    try {
      final callable = _functions.httpsCallable('saveLedgerCustomer');
      final result = await callable.call({
        if (customerId != null && customerId.isNotEmpty) 'customerId': customerId,
        'name': name,
        'phone': phone ?? '',
        'creditLimit': creditLimit,
        'notes': notes ?? '',
      });
      final data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(result.data as Map);
      return data['customerId']?.toString() ?? '';
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('❌ Error in saveCustomer: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  /// حذف عميل من الدفتر
  static Future<void> deleteCustomer(String customerId) async {
    try {
      final callable = _functions.httpsCallable('deleteLedgerCustomer');
      await callable.call({'customerId': customerId});
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('❌ Error in deleteCustomer: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  /// مطابقة وتدقيق رصيد العميل
  static Future<double> reconcileCustomer(String customerId) async {
    try {
      final callable = _functions.httpsCallable('reconcileLedgerBalance');
      final result = await callable.call({'customerId': customerId});
      final data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(result.data as Map);
      return (data['balance'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('❌ Error in reconcileCustomer: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // 🏷️ ذاكرة تسعير الحبة للبقالة (Retail Unit Pricing Memory)
  // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /// جلب سعر بيع الحبة المخزن لهذا التاجر
  static Future<double?> getStoredRetailPrice(String merchantId, String productId) async {
    if (_retailPriceCache.containsKey(productId)) {
      return _retailPriceCache[productId];
    }
    try {
      final doc = await _db
          .collection('profiles')
          .doc(merchantId)
          .collection('retail_pricing')
          .doc(productId)
          .get();
      if (doc.exists && doc.data() != null) {
        final price = (doc.data()!['price'] as num?)?.toDouble();
        if (price != null && price > 0) {
          _retailPriceCache[productId] = price;
          return price;
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return null;
  }

  /// حفظ سعر بيع الحبة المخصص للتاجر لاستخدامه دائماً عند مسح الباركود
  static Future<void> saveRetailPrice({
    required String merchantId,
    required String productId,
    required double price,
  }) async {
    if (price <= 0) return;
    _retailPriceCache[productId] = price;
    try {
      await _db
          .collection('profiles')
          .doc(merchantId)
          .collection('retail_pricing')
          .doc(productId)
          .set({
        'price': price,
        'updated_at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('❌ Error saving retail price: $e');
    }
  }

  /// البحث عن المنتج بالباركود واحتساب سعر الحبة الافتراضي
  static ProductModel? findProductByBarcode(String barcode) {
    final cleanCode = barcode.trim();
    if (cleanCode.isEmpty) return null;

    final cachedProducts = AppCache.instance.getProducts() ?? [];
    for (final raw in cachedProducts) {
      final p = ProductModel.fromMap(raw);
      // فحص الباركود الرئيسي
      if (p.barcode != null && p.barcode!.trim() == cleanCode) {
        return p;
      }
      // فحص مصفوفة الباركودات
      if (p.allBarcodes.any((b) => b.trim() == cleanCode)) {
        return p;
      }
      // فحص وحدات البيع
      for (final u in p.units) {
        if (u.barcode != null && u.barcode!.trim() == cleanCode) {
          return p;
        }
      }
      // فحص المتغيرات
      for (final v in p.variants) {
        if (v.barcode != null && v.barcode!.trim() == cleanCode) {
          return p;
        }
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  /// احتساب سعر الحبة الافتراضي بناءً على الكرتون أو وحدات البيع
  static double calculateDefaultPiecePrice(ProductModel product) {
    // 1. هل توجد وحدة حبة معرفة؟
    for (final unit in product.units) {
      if (unit.qty == 1 || unit.label.contains('حبة') || unit.label.contains('قطعة')) {
        if (unit.price > 0) return unit.price;
      }
    }
    // 2. حساب من سعة الكرتون
    final capacity = (product.itemsPerCarton != null && product.itemsPerCarton! > 0)
        ? product.itemsPerCarton!
        : 1;
    final pieceWholesale = product.price / capacity;
    // إضافة هامش ربح تجزئة تقديري (15%) وتقريب لأقرب 50 أو 100 ريال
    final estimatedRetail = pieceWholesale * 1.15;
    return double.parse(estimatedRetail.toStringAsFixed(2));
  }
}


// ==================================================
// FILE: lib\features\merchant\ledger\widgets\barcode_debt_scanner_sheet.dart
// ==================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:mobile_scanner/mobile_scanner.dart';
import '../../../../core/constants/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../../core/constants/app_adaptive_colors.dart';
import '../../../../core/services/local_storage.dart';
import '../../products/services/products_service.dart';
import '../models/ledger_item.dart';
import '../services/ledger_service.dart';

class BarcodeDebtScannerSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final Function(LedgerItem item) onItemAdded;

  const BarcodeDebtScannerSheet({
    super.key,
    required this.onItemAdded,
  });

  static Future<void> show(BuildContext context, {required Function(LedgerItem item) onItemAdded}) {
    return showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => BarcodeDebtScannerSheet(onItemAdded: onItemAdded),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<BarcodeDebtScannerSheet> createState() => _BarcodeDebtScannerSheetState();
}

class _BarcodeDebtScannerSheetState extends State<BarcodeDebtScannerSheet> {
  late final MobileScannerController _scannerController;
  bool _isTorchOn = false;
  bool _isProcessing = false;

  // حالة المنتج المفحوص حالياً
  ProductModel? _matchedProduct;
  String? _scannedBarcode;
  double _unitPrice = 0.0;
  double _quantity = 1.0;
  bool _isFirstTimePrice = true;
  bool _saveForFuture = true;
  final _priceController = TextEditingController();
  final _customNameController = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _scannerController = MobileScannerController(
      detectionSpeed: DetectionSpeed.normal,
      facing: CameraFacing.back,
      torchEnabled: false,
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _scannerController.dispose();
    _priceController.dispose();
    _customNameController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _handleBarcodeDetected(BarcodeCapture capture) async {
    if (_isProcessing || _matchedProduct != null) return;
    final barcode = capture.barcodes.firstOrNull?.rawValue?.trim();
    if (barcode == null || barcode.isEmpty) return;

    setState(() => _isProcessing = true);
    HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();

    final merchantId = AppStorage.userId ?? '';
    final product = LedgerService.findProductByBarcode(barcode);

    if (product != null) {
      // فحص هل سُجل سعر حبة مسبقاً لهذا التاجر
      final storedPrice = await LedgerService.getStoredRetailPrice(merchantId, product.id);

      if (storedPrice != null && storedPrice > 0) {
        _isFirstTimePrice = false;
        _unitPrice = storedPrice;
      } else {
        _isFirstTimePrice = true;
        _unitPrice = LedgerService.calculateDefaultPiecePrice(product);
      }

      _matchedProduct = product;
      _scannedBarcode = barcode;
      _priceController.text = _unitPrice.toStringAsFixed(0);
      _quantity = 1.0;
    } else {
      // باركود غير موجود في الكتالوج (صنف خارجي)
      _matchedProduct = null;
      _scannedBarcode = barcode;
      _isFirstTimePrice = true;
      _unitPrice = 0.0;
      _priceController.text = '';
      _customNameController.text = '';
      _quantity = 1.0;
    }

    if (mounted) {
      setState(() => _isProcessing = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _confirmAndAddItem() async {
    final merchantId = AppStorage.userId ?? '';
    final parsedPrice = double.tryParse(_priceController.text.trim()) ?? _unitPrice;

    if (parsedPrice <= 0) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('يرجى تحديد سعر بيع الحبة أولاً', style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo')),
          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final name = _matchedProduct?.name ?? _customNameController.text.trim();
    if (name.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('يرجى كتابة اسم الصنف', style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo')),
          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    // حفظ السعر المستقبلي إذا اختار التاجر ذلك
    if (_saveForFuture && _matchedProduct != null && merchantId.isNotEmpty) {
      await LedgerService.saveRetailPrice(
        merchantId: merchantId,
        productId: _matchedProduct!.id,
        price: parsedPrice,
      );
    }

    final item = LedgerItem(
      productId: _matchedProduct?.id ?? 'custom_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}',
      name: name,
      quantity: _quantity,
      unitLabel: 'حبة',
      unitPrice: parsedPrice,
      subtotal: parsedPrice * _quantity,
      cartonCapacity: _matchedProduct?.itemsPerCarton ?? 1,
      barcode: _scannedBarcode,
    );

    widget.onItemAdded(item);
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();

    // إعادة الضبط لمسح صنف آخر فورا
    setState(() {
      _matchedProduct = null;
      _scannedBarcode = null;
      _priceController.clear();
      _customNameController.clear();
      _quantity = 1.0;
    });

    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text('✅ أُضيف ($name) بسعر ${parsedPrice.toStringAsFixed(0)} للحبة',
            style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo')),
        backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF27AE60),
        duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
      ),
    );
  }

  void _resetCurrentScan() {
    setState(() {
      _matchedProduct = null;
      _scannedBarcode = null;
      _priceController.clear();
      _customNameController.clear();
      _quantity = 1.0;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final bottomInset = MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom;

    return Container(
      height: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height * 0.85,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: context.bgCard,
        borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          // مقبض السحب
          Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 10, bottom: 6),
            width: 40,
            height: 4,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
            ),
          ),

          // العنوان وزر الإغلاق
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18, vertical: 8),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.qr_code_scanner_rounded, color: AppColors.primary),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                const Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    'مسح باركود الصنف لدين الدفتر',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      fontSize: 16,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                IconButton(

            child: IconButton(
              icon: Icon(
                _isTorchOn ? Icons.flash_on_rounded : Icons.flash_off_rounded,
                color: Colors.white,
              ),
              onPressed: () {
                _scannerController.toggleTorch();
                setState(() => _isTorchOn = !_isTorchOn);
              },
            ),

        // نص إرشادي في الأسفل

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import '../../../../core/constants/app_adaptive_colors.dart';
import '../models/ledger_customer.dart';
import '../services/ledger_service.dart';

class CashPaymentDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  final LedgerCustomer customer;
  final VoidCallback? onPaymentSuccess;

  const CashPaymentDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.customer,
    this.onPaymentSuccess,
  });

  static Future<void> show(
    BuildContext context, {
    required LedgerCustomer customer,
    VoidCallback? onPaymentSuccess,
  }) {
    return showDialog(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (_) => CashPaymentDialog(
        customer: customer,
        onPaymentSuccess: onPaymentSuccess,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<CashPaymentDialog> createState() => _CashPaymentDialogState();
}

class _CashPaymentDialogState extends State<CashPaymentDialog> {
  final _amountController = TextEditingController();
  final _notesController = TextEditingController();
  bool _isLoading = false;
  String? _errorMessage;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _amountController.dispose();
    _notesController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _setAmount(double amount) {
    if (amount <= 0) return;
    _amountController.text = amount.toStringAsFixed(0);
    setState(() => _errorMessage = null);
  }

  Future<void> _submitPayment() async {
    final text = _amountController.text.trim();
    final amount = double.tryParse(text);

    if (amount == null || amount <= 0) {
      setState(() => _errorMessage = 'يرجى إدخال مبلغ صحيح أكبر من الصفر');
      return;
    }

    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
      _errorMessage = null;
    });

    try {
      HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
      await LedgerService.recordTransaction(
        customerId: widget.customer.id,
        type: 'payment',
        amount: amount,
        notes: _notesController.text.trim().isNotEmpty
            ? _notesController.text.trim()
            : 'سداد نقدي (كاش)',
      );

      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pop(context);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text(
              '✅ تم تسجيل سداد مبلغ ${amount.toStringAsFixed(0)} ريال بنجاح',
              style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo'),
            ),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF27AE60),
            behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
          ),
        );
        widget.onPaymentSuccess?.call();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isLoading = false;
          _errorMessage = 'حدث خطأ أثناء تسجيل السداد: $e';
        });
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final curBal = widget.customer.currentBalance;

    return Dialog(
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
      backgroundColor: context.bgCard,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              // Header
              Row(
                children: [
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: const Color(0xFF2ECC71).withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                      shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    ),
                    child: const Icon(
                      Icons.payments_rounded,
                      color: Color(0xFF27AE60),
                      size: 26,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        const Text(
                          'سداد دفعة نقدية (كاش)',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            fontSize: 16,
                          ),
                        ),
                        Text(
                          'العميل: ${widget.customer.name}',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                            fontSize: 12,
                            color: Colors.grey[600],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 16),

              // بطاقة الرصيد الحالي
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.2)),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                  children: [
                    const Text(
                      'إجمالي الدين المستحق:',
                      style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo', fontSize: 13),
                    ),
                    Text(
                      '${curBal.toStringAsFixed(0)} ريال',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        fontSize: 15,
                        color: Color(0xFFE74C3C),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 14),

              // أزرار الاختيار السريع
              if (curBal > 0) ...[
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: OutlinedButton(
                        onPressed: _isLoading ? null : () => _setAmount(curBal),
                        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                          side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF27AE60)),
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
                          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
                        ),
                        child: const Text(
                          'سداد كامل المبلغ',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                            fontSize: 12,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            color: Color(0xFF27AE60),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Expanded(
                      child: OutlinedButton(
                        onPressed: _isLoading ? null : () => _setAmount((curBal / 2).roundToDouble()),
                        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                          side: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey[400]!),
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
                          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
                        ),
                        child: const Text(
                          'سداد النصف (50%)',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                            fontSize: 12,
                            color: Colors.grey,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
              ],

              // حقل إدخال المبلغ
              TextField(
                controller: _amountController,
                keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),
                inputFormatters: [FilteringTextInputFormatter.allow(RegExp(r'^\d+\.?\d{0,2}'))],
                autofocus: true,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'المبلغ المدفوع (ريال) *',
                  labelStyle: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo'),
                  prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.money_rounded, color: Color(0xFF27AE60)),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
                  focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                    borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF27AE60), width: 2),
                  ),
                ),
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 12),

              // حقل الملاحظات
              TextField(
                controller: _notesController,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'ملاحظات السداد (اختياري)',
                  labelStyle: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo'),
                  hintText: 'مثال: حوالة، نقداً باليد، دفعة جزئية...',
                  hintStyle: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo', fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey[400]),
                  prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.notes_rounded, color: Colors.grey),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
                ),
              ),

              if (_errorMessage != null) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Text(
                  _errorMessage!,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                    fontSize: 12,
                    color: Colors.red,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),
              ],

              const SizedBox(height: 20),

              // أزرار التحكم
              Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: TextButton(
                      onPressed: _isLoading ? null : () => Navigator.pop(context),
                      child: const Text(

                        style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo', color: Colors.grey),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Expanded(

                      onPressed: _isLoading ? null : _submitPayment,
                      style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF27AE60),
                        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
                        elevation: 0,
                      ),
                      child: _isLoading
                          ? const SizedBox(
                              width: 20,
                              height: 20,
                              child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: Colors.white),
                            )

                              'تأكيد السداد النقدي',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                fontSize: 14,

                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

// FILE: lib\features\merchant\ledger\widgets\credit_limit_indicator.dart
// ==================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../models/ledger_customer.dart';

class CreditLimitIndicator extends StatelessWidget {
  final LedgerCustomer customer;
  final bool showLabel;

  const CreditLimitIndicator({
    super.key,
    required this.customer,
    this.showLabel = true,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (customer.creditLimit <= 0) {
      if (!showLabel) return const SizedBox.shrink();
      return Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
        ),
        child: const Text(
          'سقف مفتوح',
          style: TextStyle(
            fontFamily: 'Cairo',
            fontSize: 11,
            color: Colors.grey,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    final ratio = customer.creditUsageRatio;
    final isOver = customer.isOverLimit;
    final isWarning = ratio >= 0.8 && !isOver;

    Color color = const Color(0xFF2ECC71); // أخضر طبيعي
    if (isWarning) color = const Color(0xFFF39C12); // برتقالي تحذيري
    if (isOver) color = const Color(0xFFE74C3C); // أحمر تجاوز السقف

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        if (showLabel) ...[
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Text(
                isOver
                    ? '⚠️ تجاوز السقف المحدد!'
                    : 'استهلاك السقف: ${(ratio * 100).toStringAsFixed(0)}%',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                  fontSize: 11,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: color,
                ),
              ),
              Text(
                'السقف: ${customer.creditLimit.toStringAsFixed(0)} ريال',
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                  fontSize: 11,
                  color: Colors.grey,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
        ],
        ClipRRect(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
          child: LinearProgressIndicator(
            value: ratio.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
            backgroundColor: Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
            valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(color),
            minHeight: 6,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}


// ==================================================
// FILE: lib\features\merchant\notifications\notifications_screen.dart
// ==================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../../core/constants/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../../core/services/local_storage.dart';
import '../../../../core/services/realtime_hub.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:wissal/core/constants/app_adaptive_colors.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'dart:async';

class NotificationsScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const NotificationsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<NotificationsScreen> createState() =>
      _NotificationsScreenState();
}

class _NotificationsScreenState extends ConsumerState<NotificationsScreen> {
  final ScrollController _scrollCtrl = ScrollController();
  Timer? _markReadDebounce;
  bool _isMarkingRead = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _scrollCtrl.addListener(_onScroll);
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      _markReadDebounce =
          Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 800), _markAllRead);
    });
  }

  void _onScroll() {
    _markReadDebounce?.cancel();
    _markReadDebounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 500), _markAllRead);
  }

  Future<void> _markAllRead() async {
    if (_isMarkingRead || !mounted) return;
    if (ref.read(unreadCountProvider) == 0) return;
    final uid = AppStorage.userId ?? '';
    if (uid.isEmpty) return;
    _isMarkingRead = true;
    try {
      await ref.read(realtimeNotifsProvider.notifier).markAllRead(uid);
    } finally {
      _isMarkingRead = false;
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _markReadDebounce?.cancel();
    _scrollCtrl.removeListener(_onScroll);
    _scrollCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _handleBack(BuildContext context) {
    try {
      if (Navigator.of(context).canPop()) {
        Navigator.of(context).pop();
        return;
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    if (AppStorage.hasAdminAccess) {
      context.go('/admin');
    } else if (AppStorage.isDriver) {
      context.go('/driver');
    } else {
      context.go('/merchant');
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final notifs = ref.watch(realtimeNotifsProvider);
    ref.listen<int>(unreadCountProvider, (prev, next) {
      if (next > 0) {
        _markReadDebounce?.cancel();
        _markReadDebounce =
            Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 800), _markAllRead);
      }
    });
    final notificationsNotifier = ref.read(realtimeNotifsProvider.notifier);

    return PopScope(
      canPop: false,
      onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, _) {
        if (didPop) return;
        _handleBack(context);
      },
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: context.bgPage,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: Column(
            children: [
              // ── Header ──
              Container(
                color: context.bgHeader,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 16, 20, 16),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    GestureDetector(
                      onTap: () => _handleBack(context),
                      child: Container(
                        width: 40,
                        height: 40,
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: context.bgPage,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        ),
                        child: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_new_rounded,
                            size: 16),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    const Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        'الإشعارات',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                            fontSize: 17,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const Icon(Icons.notifications_rounded,
                        color: AppColors.primary, size: 22),
                  ],
                ),
              ),

              // ── القائمة ──
              Expanded(
                child: notifs.isEmpty
                    ? _EmptyNotif()
                    : ListView.builder(
                        controller: _scrollCtrl,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 32),
                        itemCount: notifs.length +
                            (notificationsNotifier.hasMore &&
                                    notifs.length >= 50
                                ? 1
                                : 0),
                        itemBuilder: (context, i) {
                          if (i < notifs.length) {
                            return _NotifCard(data: notifs[i]);
                          }
                          final userId = AppStorage.userId ?? '';
                          return Center(
                            child: Padding(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                              child: notificationsNotifier.isLoadingMore
                                  ? const CircularProgressIndicator()
                                  : TextButton.icon(
                                      onPressed: () => notificationsNotifier
                                          .loadMore(userId),
                                      icon:
                                          const Icon(Icons.expand_more_rounded),
                                      label: Text(
                                        notificationsNotifier.loadMoreError ??
                                            'تحميل الإشعارات الأقدم',
                                      ),
                                    ),
                            ),
                          );
                        },
                      ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// ════════════════════════════════════════
class _NotifCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final Map<String, dynamic> data;
  const _NotifCard({required this.data});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final title = data['title']?.toString() ?? 'إشعار';
    final body = data['body']?.toString() ?? '';
    final isRead = data['is_read'] == true;
    final createdAt = data['created_at'] != null
        ? (data['created_at'] is Timestamp
            ? (data['created_at'] as Timestamp).toDate()
            : DateTime.tryParse(data['created_at'].toString()))
        : null;

    const color = AppColors.primary;

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isRead ? context.bgCard : color.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        border: Border.all(
          color: isRead
              ? Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.12)
              : color.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
        ),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.03), blurRadius: 6),
        ],
      ),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child:
                const Icon(Icons.notifications_rounded, size: 20, color: color),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(title,
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                            fontSize: 13,
                            fontWeight:
                                isRead ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.w800)),
                  ),
                  if (!isRead)
                    Container(
                      width: 8,
                      height: 8,
                      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                          color: color, shape: BoxShape.circle),
                    ),
                ]),
                if (body.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(body,
                      maxLines: 3,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                          fontSize: 12,
                          color: context.textSecondary,
                          height: 1.5)),
                ],
                if (createdAt != null) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  Text(_formatTime(createdAt),
                      style: TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                          fontSize: 10,
                          color: context.textHint)),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  String _formatTime(DateTime dt) {
    final diff = DateTime.now().difference(dt);
    if (diff.inMinutes < 1) return 'الآن';
    if (diff.inMinutes < 60) return 'منذ ${diff.inMinutes} دقيقة';
    if (diff.inHours < 24) return 'منذ ${diff.inHours} ساعة';
    if (diff.inDays < 7) return 'منذ ${diff.inDays} يوم';
    return '${dt.day}/${dt.month}/${dt.year}';
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';

enum OrderStatus {
  pending,
  accepted,
  preparing,
  onTheWay,
  delivered,
  cancelled,
  rejected,
  returned,
  returnRequested,
}

extension OrderStatusX on OrderStatus {
  String get label {
    switch (this) {
      case OrderStatus.pending:
        return 'قيد الانتظار';
      case OrderStatus.accepted:
        return 'تم القبول';
      case OrderStatus.preparing:
        return 'قيد التحضير';
      case OrderStatus.onTheWay:
        return 'في الطريق إليك';
      case OrderStatus.delivered:
        return 'تم التسليم';
      case OrderStatus.cancelled:
        return 'ملغي';
      case OrderStatus.rejected:
        return 'مرفوض';
      case OrderStatus.returned:
        return 'مرتجع';
      case OrderStatus.returnRequested:
        return 'طلب إرجاع';
    }
  }

  Color get color {
    switch (this) {
      case OrderStatus.pending:
        return const Color(0xFFF59E0B);
      case OrderStatus.accepted:
      case OrderStatus.preparing:
        return const Color(0xFF3B82F6);
      case OrderStatus.onTheWay:
        return const Color(0xFF8B5CF6);
      case OrderStatus.delivered:
        return const Color(0xFF10B981);
      case OrderStatus.cancelled:
      case OrderStatus.rejected:
        return const Color(0xFFEF4444);
      case OrderStatus.returned:
      case OrderStatus.returnRequested:
        return const Color(0xFFEA580C);
    }
  }

  String get description {
    switch (this) {
      case OrderStatus.pending:
        return 'طلبك في انتظار مراجعة المدير';
      case OrderStatus.accepted:
        return 'جاري تحضير طلبك الآن';
      case OrderStatus.preparing:
        return 'فريقنا يحضّر طلبك';
      case OrderStatus.onTheWay:
        return 'المندوب في طريقه لتوصيل طلبك';
      case OrderStatus.delivered:
        return 'تم توصيل طلبك بنجاح';
      case OrderStatus.cancelled:
        return 'تم إلغاء هذا الطلب';
      case OrderStatus.rejected:
        return 'تم رفض هذا الطلب';
      case OrderStatus.returned:
        return 'تم إرجاع هذا الطلب';
      case OrderStatus.returnRequested:
        return 'طلب الإرجاع قيد المراجعة';
    }
  }

  int get step {
    switch (this) {
      case OrderStatus.pending:
        return 0;
      case OrderStatus.accepted:
        return 1;
      case OrderStatus.preparing:
        return 2;
      case OrderStatus.onTheWay:
        return 3;
      case OrderStatus.delivered:
        return 4;
      case OrderStatus.cancelled:
      case OrderStatus.rejected:
        return -1;
      case OrderStatus.returned:
      case OrderStatus.returnRequested:
        return -2;
    }
  }

  static OrderStatus parse(String s) {
    switch (s) {
      case 'accepted':
        return OrderStatus.accepted;
      case 'confirmed':
        return OrderStatus.accepted;
      case 'preparing':
        return OrderStatus.preparing;
      case 'shipped':
        return OrderStatus.onTheWay;
      case 'on_the_way':
        return OrderStatus.onTheWay;
      case 'delivered':
        return OrderStatus.delivered;
      case 'cancelled':
        return OrderStatus.cancelled;
      case 'rejected':
        return OrderStatus.rejected;
      case 'returned':
        return OrderStatus.returned;
      case 'return_requested':
        return OrderStatus.returnRequested;
      default:
        return OrderStatus.pending;
    }
  }
}

class OrderModel {
  final String id;
  final String merchantId;
  final double total;
  final double totalProfit;
  final double returnedAmount;
  final double originalTotal;
  final OrderStatus status;
  final String? notes;
  final String? invoiceNumber;
  final String? orderNumber;
  final String? storeName;
  final String? customerName;
  final String? contact;
  final double? latitude;
  final double? longitude;
  final String? paymentMethod;
  final String? signatureUrl;
  final DateTime createdAt;
  const OrderModel({
    required this.id,
    required this.merchantId,
    required this.total,
    this.totalProfit = 0.0,
    this.returnedAmount = 0.0,
    this.originalTotal = 0.0,
    required this.status,
    this.notes,
    this.invoiceNumber,
    this.orderNumber,
    this.storeName,
    this.customerName,
    this.contact,
    this.latitude,
    this.longitude,
    this.paymentMethod,
    this.signatureUrl,
    required this.createdAt,
  });
  factory OrderModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> j) {
    final rawCreatedAt = j['created_at'];

    final createdAt = rawCreatedAt is Timestamp
        ? rawCreatedAt.toDate()
        : DateTime.tryParse(
              rawCreatedAt?.toString() ?? '',
            ) ??
            DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(0);

    final rawTotal = (j['total'] as num?)?.toDouble() ??
        (j['total_amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ??
        0.0;
    final retAmt = (j['returned_amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ??
        (j['refund_amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ??
        0.0;
    final origTotal = (j['original_total'] as num?)?.toDouble() ??
        (rawTotal > 0 ? (rawTotal + retAmt) : retAmt);

    return OrderModel(
      id: j['id']?.toString() ?? '',
      merchantId: j['merchant_id']?.toString() ?? '',
      total: rawTotal,
      returnedAmount: retAmt,
      originalTotal: origTotal,
      status: OrderStatusX.parse(
        j['status']?.toString() ?? 'pending',
      ),
      notes: j['notes']?.toString(),
      invoiceNumber: j['invoice_number']?.toString(),
      orderNumber: j['order_number']?.toString(),
      storeName: j['store_name']?.toString(),
      customerName: j['customer_name']?.toString(),
      contact: (j['contact'] ?? j['phone_number'])?.toString(),
      latitude: (j['latitude'] as num?)?.toDouble(),
      longitude: (j['longitude'] as num?)?.toDouble(),
      paymentMethod: j['payment_method']?.toString(),
      signatureUrl: j['signature_url']?.toString(),
      createdAt: createdAt,
    );
  }
}

// FILE: lib\features\merchant\orders\screens\order_detail_screen.dart
// ==================================================

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import '../../../../../core/constants/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../../../core/constants/app_radius.dart';
import '../../../../../core/services/local_storage.dart';
import '../models/order_model.dart';
import '../services/orders_service.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:wissal/core/constants/app_adaptive_colors.dart';

class OrderDetailScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final OrderModel order;
  const OrderDetailScreen({super.key, required this.order});

  @override
  State<OrderDetailScreen> createState() => _OrderDetailScreenState();
}

class _OrderDetailScreenState extends State<OrderDetailScreen> {
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _items = [];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _returns = [];
  bool _loading = true;
  late OrderModel _currentOrder;
  StreamSubscription<DocumentSnapshot>? _orderSubscription;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _currentOrder = widget.order;
    _load();
    _listenToOrderRealtime();
  }

  StreamSubscription<QuerySnapshot>? _returnsSubscription;

  void _listenToOrderRealtime() {
    _orderSubscription = FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('orders')
        .doc(widget.order.id)
        .snapshots()
        .listen(
      (doc) {
        if (!mounted || !doc.exists || doc.data() == null) return;
        setState(() {
          _currentOrder = OrderModel.fromJson({'id': doc.id, ...doc.data()!});
        });
      },
      onError: (error) {
        _orderSubscription?.cancel();
        _orderSubscription = null;
        debugPrint(
            '[OrderDetailScreen] Live order stream cancelled safely: $error');
      },
      cancelOnError: true,
    );

    _returnsSubscription = FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('order_returns')
        .where('order_id', isEqualTo: widget.order.id)
        .snapshots()
        .listen((snap) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      final returnsList = snap.docs
          .map((d) => {
                'id': d.id,
                ...d.data(),
              })
          .toList();
      returnsList.sort((a, b) {
        DateTime parseDate(dynamic v) {
          if (v is Timestamp) return v.toDate();
          if (v is DateTime) return v;
          if (v is String && v.isNotEmpty) {
            return DateTime.tryParse(v) ?? DateTime(2000);
          }
          return DateTime(2000);
        }

        return parseDate(b['created_at']).compareTo(parseDate(a['created_at']));
      });
      setState(() {
        _returns = returnsList;
      });
    }, onError: (_) {});
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _orderSubscription?.cancel();
    _returnsSubscription?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _loading = true);

    try {
      // ✅ الاكتفاء بجلب عناصر الطلب لأن مستند الطلب يُحدّث تلقائياً عبر _listenToOrderRealtime()
      final items = await OrdersService.getOrderItems(widget.order.id);
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _items = items;
        });
      }
      try {
        final returnsSnap = await FirebaseFirestore.instance
            .collection('order_returns')
            .where('order_id', isEqualTo: widget.order.id)
            .get();

        final returnsList =
            returnsSnap.docs.map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()}).toList();

        returnsList.sort((a, b) {
          DateTime parseDate(dynamic v) {
            if (v is Timestamp) return v.toDate();
            if (v is DateTime) return v;
            if (v is String && v.isNotEmpty) {
              return DateTime.tryParse(v) ?? DateTime(2000);
            }
            return DateTime(2000);
          }

          return parseDate(b['created_at'])
              .compareTo(parseDate(a['created_at']));
        });

        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _returns = returnsList;
          });
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _loading = false);
      }
    }
  }

  Map<String, int> get _acceptedReturnedQtyPerItem {
    final Map<String, int> result = {};
    for (final r in _returns) {
      if (r['status'] != 'accepted') continue;
      final itemId = r['order_item_id']?.toString() ?? '';
      if (itemId.isEmpty) continue;
      result[itemId] =
          (result[itemId] ?? 0) + ((r['quantity'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0);
    }
    return result;
  }

  // كمية مُرجعة (مقبولة أو معلقة) لمنع طلب إرجاع مزدوج لنفس الكمية
  Map<String, int> get _returnedQtyPerItem {
    final Map<String, int> result = {};
    for (final r in _returns) {
      if (r['status'] == 'rejected') continue;
      final itemId = r['order_item_id']?.toString() ?? '';
      if (itemId.isEmpty) continue;
      result[itemId] =
          (result[itemId] ?? 0) + ((r['quantity'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0);
    }
    return result;
  }

  // الكمية المتبقية القابلة للإرجاع لكل عنصر
  Map<String, int> get _remainingQty {
    final returned = _returnedQtyPerItem;
    final Map<String, int> result = {};
    for (final item in _items) {
      final itemId = item['id']?.toString() ?? '';
      final ordered = (item['quantity'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
      final alreadyReturned = returned[itemId] ?? 0;
      result[itemId] = (ordered - alreadyReturned).clamp(0, ordered);
    }
    return result;
  }

  bool get _canReturn =>
      _currentOrder.status == OrderStatus.delivered &&
      _items.isNotEmpty &&
      _remainingQty.values.any((q) => q > 0);

  String _returnStatus(String itemId) {
    final matches =
        _returns.where((r) => r['order_item_id'] == itemId).toList();
    if (matches.isEmpty) return '';
    // أولوية: معلق > مقبول > مرفوض
    if (matches.any((r) => r['status'] == 'pending')) return 'pending';
    if (matches.any((r) => r['status'] == 'accepted')) return 'accepted';
    return 'rejected';
  }

  bool _hasActiveReturn(String itemId) {
    return _returns
        .any((r) => r['order_item_id'] == itemId && r['status'] != 'rejected');
  }

  void _openReturnSheet() {
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => _ReturnSheet(
        order: _currentOrder,
        items: _items,
        remainingQty: _remainingQty,
        onSuccess: _load,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final order = _currentOrder;
    final time =
        '${order.createdAt.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${order.createdAt.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
    final date =
        '${order.createdAt.day}/${order.createdAt.month}/${order.createdAt.year}';

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: context.bgPage,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          children: [
            // ── شريط العنوان ──
            Container(
              color: context.bgHeader,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 16, 20, 16),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  GestureDetector(
                    onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                    child: Container(
                      width: 40,
                      height: 40,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: context.bgPage,
                        borderRadius: AppRadius.mdAll,
                      ),
                      child:
                          const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_ios_rounded, size: 18),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          order.orderNumber ??
                              order.invoiceNumber ??
                              '#${order.id.length >= 6 ? order.id.substring(0, 6).toUpperCase() : order.id.toUpperCase()}',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                              fontSize: 17,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                        ),
                        Text(
                          '$time  •  $date',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                              fontSize: 12,
                              color: context.textSecondary),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  _StatusBadge(status: order.status),
                ],
              ),
            ),

            // ── المحتوى ──
            Expanded(
              child: _loading
                  ? const Center(
                      child:
                          CircularProgressIndicator(color: AppColors.primary))
                  : RefreshIndicator(
                      color: AppColors.primary,
                      onRefresh: _load,
                      child: ListView(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 100),
                        children: [
                          _SummaryCard(order: order),
                          const SizedBox(height: 12),
                          _OrderProgressStepper(status: order.status),
                          const SizedBox(height: 12),
                          // ── التوقيع الرقمي المعتمد لحظياً ──
                          if (order.signatureUrl != null &&
                              order.signatureUrl!.isNotEmpty) ...[
                            _SignatureLiveCard(
                              signatureUrl: order.signatureUrl!,
                              signerName: order.storeName ??
                                  order.customerName ??
                                  'المستلم المعتمد',
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(height: 12),
                          ],
                          _DeliveryCard(order: order),
                          const SizedBox(height: 12),

                          // ── المنتجات ──
                          const _SectionTitle(
                              title: 'المنتجات المطلوبة',
                              icon: Icons.inventory_2_rounded),
                          const SizedBox(height: 8),
                          if (_items.isEmpty)
                            const _EmptyHint(
                                text: 'لا توجد منتجات',
                                icon: Icons.inventory_2_outlined)
                          else
                            ..._items.map((item) {
                              final itemId = item['id']?.toString() ?? '';
                              final acceptedQty =
                                  _acceptedReturnedQtyPerItem[itemId] ?? 0;
                              return _ItemCard(
                                item: item,
                                hasReturn: _hasActiveReturn(itemId),
                                returnStatus: _returnStatus(itemId),
                                returnedQty: acceptedQty,
                              );
                            }),

// ── ملخص الإرجاع إذا وُجد ──
                          if (_returns.isNotEmpty) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 16),
                            _ReturnSummaryBanner(returns: _returns),
                            const SizedBox(height: 8),
                            const _SectionTitle(
                                title: 'طلبات الإرجاع',
                                icon: Icons.assignment_return_rounded),
                            const SizedBox(height: 8),
                            ..._returns.map((r) => _ReturnCard(data: r)),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      bottomNavigationBar: _canReturn
          ? SafeArea(
              top: false,
              maintainBottomViewPadding: true,
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 10, 16, 12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: context.bgCard,
                  border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: context.borderColor)),
                  boxShadow: [
                    BoxShadow(
                      color: context.shadowColor,
                      blurRadius: 12,
                      offset: const Offset(0, -4),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                child: SizedBox(
                  height: 52,
                  child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: _openReturnSheet,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.assignment_return_rounded, size: 20),
                    label: const Text(
                      'طلب إرجاع أصناف',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                        fontSize: 15,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      ),
                    ),
                    style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFEA580C),
                      foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                      ),
                      elevation: 0,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            )
          : null,
    );
  }
}

class _ReturnSummaryBanner extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> returns;
  const _ReturnSummaryBanner({required this.returns});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final pending = returns.where((r) => r['status'] == 'pending').length;
    final accepted = returns.where((r) => r['status'] == 'accepted').length;
    final rejected = returns.where((r) => r['status'] == 'rejected').length;

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: const Color(0xFFFFF7ED),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border:
            Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFEA580C).withValues(alpha: 0.25)),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          const Icon(Icons.info_outline_rounded,
              size: 16, color: Color(0xFFEA580C)),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          Expanded(
            child: Text(
              [
                if (pending > 0) '$pending معلق',
                if (accepted > 0) '$accepted مقبول',
                if (rejected > 0) '$rejected مرفوض',
              ].join('  •  '),
              style: const TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  color: Color(0xFFEA580C)),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
