import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import '../models/order_model.dart';
import 'package:wissal/core/services/app_cache.dart';
import 'package:cloud_functions/cloud_functions.dart';
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:wissal/core/services/local_storage.dart';
import 'package:wissal/core/utils/arabic_normalizer.dart';

class OrdersService {
  static final _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;

  static void _assertMerchantSession(String merchantId) {
    final cleanMerchantId = merchantId.trim();
    final uid = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.uid ?? AppStorage.userId;

    if (uid == null ||
        uid.isEmpty ||
        cleanMerchantId.isEmpty ||
        uid != cleanMerchantId) {
      throw StateError('جلسة التاجر غير صالحة');
    }
  }

  /// 🚀 تنفيذ آمن للمعاملات مع ترك إدارة المهلة لمحرك Firestore داخلياً لمنع تعارض الـ Completer
  static Future<T> runContentionSafeTransaction<T>(
    Future<T> Function(Transaction tx) action,
  ) async {
    return _db.runTransaction<T>(action);
  }

// ════════════════════════════════════════
  // استلام السائق للطلب (عبر السيرفر حصراً)
  // ════════════════════════════════════════
// ✅ عقد برمجي موثق ومطابق للسيرفر: يتم التحقق من السائق عبر سياق المصادقة السحابي
  static Future<void> assignOrderToDriver({
    required String orderId,
  }) async {
    final cleanOrderId = orderId.trim();
    if (cleanOrderId.isEmpty) throw ArgumentError('معرّف الطلب غير صالح');

    final callable = FirebaseFunctions.instanceFor(region: 'us-central1')
        .httpsCallable('assignOrderToDriver',
            options:
                HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 15)));

    await callable.call({'orderId': cleanOrderId});
  }

  // ════════════════════════════════════════
  // تأكيد تسليم السائق للطلب واعتماد الأرباح والتوقيع سحابياً
  // ════════════════════════════════════════
  static Future<void> deliverOrderByDriver({
    required String orderId,
    String? signatureUrl,
  }) async {
    final cleanOrderId = orderId.trim();
    if (cleanOrderId.isEmpty) throw ArgumentError('معرّف الطلب غير صالح');

    final callable = FirebaseFunctions.instanceFor(region: 'us-central1')
        .httpsCallable('deliverOrderByDriver',
            options:
                HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 25)));

    await callable.call({
      'orderId': cleanOrderId,
      'signatureData': signatureUrl,
    });
  }

// ════════════════════════════════════════
// تقديم طلب جديد (عبر السيرفر حصراً)
// ════════════════════════════════════════
  static Future<OrderModel> placeOrder({
    required String merchantId,
    required List<Map<String, dynamic>> items,
    required double expectedTotal,
    String? notes,
    Map<String, dynamic>? extraData,
    String? orderId,
  }) async {
    final cleanMerchantId = merchantId.trim();
    _assertMerchantSession(cleanMerchantId);

    final resolvedOrderId = (orderId != null && orderId.trim().isNotEmpty)
        ? orderId.trim()
        : _db.collection('orders').doc().id;

    final callable = FirebaseFunctions.instanceFor(region: 'us-central1')
        .httpsCallable('placeOrder',
            options:
                HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 25)));

    final response = await callable.call({
      'orderId': resolvedOrderId,
      'items': items,
      'expectedTotal': expectedTotal,
      'notes': notes?.trim(),
      'extraData': extraData,
    });

    final data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(response.data as Map);
    final orderMap = Map<String, dynamic>.from(data['order'] as Map);
    final createdOrder = OrderModel.fromJson(orderMap);

    try {
      await AppCache.instance.invalidateProducts();
    } catch (_) {}

    return createdOrder;
  }

  // ════════════════════════════════════════
  // مراقبة طلب واحد (Realtime)
  // ════════════════════════════════════════
  static Stream<OrderModel?> watchOrder(String orderId) {
    return _db.collection('orders').doc(orderId).snapshots().map(
          (d) =>
              d.exists ? OrderModel.fromJson({'id': d.id, ...d.data()!}) : null,
        );
  }

// ════════════════════════════════════════
  // مراقبة كل طلبات التاجر (Realtime)
  // ════════════════════════════════════════
  static Stream<List<OrderModel>> watchMerchantOrders(String merchantId) {
    return _db
        .collection('orders')
        .where('merchant_id', isEqualTo: merchantId)
        .orderBy('created_at', descending: true)
        .limit(100)
        .snapshots(includeMetadataChanges: false)
        .map((snap) {
      return snap.docs
          .map((d) => OrderModel.fromJson({'id': d.id, ...d.data()}))
          .toList();
    });
  }

  // ════════════════════════════════════════
  // مراقبة طلبات التاجر بحالات محددة (محمية معمارياً من انهيار الفهارس)
  // ════════════════════════════════════════
  static Stream<List<OrderModel>> watchMerchantOrdersByStatuses(
    String merchantId,
    List<String> statuses,
  ) {
    if (statuses.isEmpty) return const Stream.empty();

    return _db
        .collection('orders')
        .where('merchant_id', isEqualTo: merchantId)
        .where('status', whereIn: statuses.take(30).toList())
        .orderBy('created_at', descending: true)
        .limit(200)
        .snapshots(includeMetadataChanges: false)
        .map((snap) {
      return snap.docs
          .map((d) => OrderModel.fromJson({'id': d.id, ...d.data()}))
          .toList();
    });
  }

  // ════════════════════════════════════════
  // مراقبة فواتير المرتجعات للتاجر (مطلوبة لشاشة السجل)
  // ════════════════════════════════════════
  static Stream<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> watchMerchantReturns(
    String merchantId,
  ) {
    return _db
        .collection('order_returns')
        .where('merchant_id', isEqualTo: merchantId)
        .orderBy('created_at', descending: true)
        .limit(100)
        .snapshots(includeMetadataChanges: false)
        .map(
            (snap) => snap.docs.map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()}).toList());
  }

  static Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getOrderItems(
      String orderId) async {
    final snap = await _db
        .collection('order_items')
        .where('order_id', isEqualTo: orderId)
        .get(const GetOptions(source: Source.serverAndCache));
    return snap.docs.map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()}).toList();
  }

  /// جلب سجل الطلبات المسلمة للسائق مفروزة زمنياً ونظيفة معمارياً
  static Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getDriverHistory(
      String driverId) async {
    if (driverId.isEmpty) return [];
    final snap = await _db
        .collection('orders')
        .where('driver_id', isEqualTo: driverId)
        .where('status', isEqualTo: 'delivered')
        .orderBy('created_at', descending: true)
        .limit(100)
        .get(const GetOptions(source: Source.serverAndCache));
    final docs = snap.docs.map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()}).toList();
    docs.sort((a, b) {
      final dateA = AppDateParser.parse(a['delivered_at'] ?? a['created_at']);
      final dateB = AppDateParser.parse(b['delivered_at'] ?? b['created_at']);
      return dateB.compareTo(dateA);
    });
    return docs;
  }

  // ════════════════════════════════════════
  // جلب الطلبات حسب الحالة — فرز بالذاكرة لمنع FAILED_PRECONDITION
  // ════════════════════════════════════════
  static Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getOrdersByStatus({
    required String merchantId,
    required String status,
  }) async {
    final snap = await _db
        .collection('orders')
        .where('merchant_id', isEqualTo: merchantId)
        .where('status', isEqualTo: status)
        .orderBy('created_at', descending: true)
        .limit(200)
        .get(const GetOptions(source: Source.serverAndCache));
    final list = snap.docs.map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()}).toList();
    list.sort((a, b) {
      final aDate = a['created_at'] is Timestamp
          ? (a['created_at'] as Timestamp).toDate()
          : DateTime(2000);
      final bDate = b['created_at'] is Timestamp
          ? (b['created_at'] as Timestamp).toDate()
          : DateTime(2000);
      return bDate.compareTo(aDate);
    });
    return list;
  }

  // ════════════════════════════════════════
  // جلب الطلبات متعددة الحالات دفعةً واحدة
  // ════════════════════════════════════════
  static Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getOrdersByStatuses({
    required String merchantId,
    required List<String> statuses,
  }) async {
    if (statuses.isEmpty) return [];

    final statusGroups = <List<String>>[
      for (var i = 0; i < statuses.length; i += 30)
        statuses.skip(i).take(30).toList(),
    ];
    final snapshots = await Future.wait(statusGroups.map((group) {
      return _db
          .collection('orders')
          .where('merchant_id', isEqualTo: merchantId)
          .where('status', whereIn: group)
          .orderBy('created_at', descending: true)
          .limit(200)
          .get(const GetOptions(source: Source.serverAndCache));
    }));
    final docsById = <String, QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>{};
    for (final snap in snapshots) {
      for (final doc in snap.docs) {
        docsById[doc.id] = doc;
      }
    }
    final list = docsById.values.map((d) => {'id': d.id, ...d.data()}).toList();
    list.sort((a, b) {
      final aDate = a['created_at'] is Timestamp
          ? (a['created_at'] as Timestamp).toDate()
          : DateTime(2000);
      final bDate = b['created_at'] is Timestamp
          ? (b['created_at'] as Timestamp).toDate()
          : DateTime(2000);
      return bDate.compareTo(aDate);
    });
    return list.take(200).toList();
  }

// ════════════════════════════════════════
  // إرسال طلب إرجاع (معالجة سحابية آمنة وموثقة 100%)
  // ════════════════════════════════════════
  static Future<void> submitReturns({
    required String orderId,
    required List<Map<String, dynamic>> itemsToReturn,
    required String merchantId,
    String? storeName,
    String? contact,
    double? latitude,
    double? longitude,
    required String reason,
  }) async {
    final cleanOrderId = orderId.trim();
    final cleanMerchantId = merchantId.trim();
    final cleanReason = reason.trim();

    if (cleanOrderId.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('معرّف الطلب غير صالح');
    }
    if (cleanMerchantId.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('معرّف التاجر غير صالح');
    }
    _assertMerchantSession(cleanMerchantId);

    if (itemsToReturn.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('يجب تحديد عنصر واحد على الأقل للإرجاع');
    }
    if (cleanReason.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('سبب الإرجاع مطلوب');
    }

    // 🚀 استدعاء الدالة السحابية الآمنة لمعالجة الطلب في السيرفر
    final callable =
        FirebaseFunctions.instanceFor(region: 'us-central1').httpsCallable(
      'submitReturnRequest',
      options: HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 25)),
    );

    try {
      await callable.call({
        'orderId': cleanOrderId,
        'itemsToReturn': itemsToReturn,
        'storeName': storeName?.trim(),
        'contact': contact?.trim(),
        'latitude': latitude,
        'longitude': longitude,
        'reason': cleanReason,
      });
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      throw StateError(e.message ?? 'فشل تقديم طلب الإرجاع من الخادم');
    }
  }

// ════════════════════════════════════════
// إلغاء الطلب واسترجاع المخزون (عبر السيرفر حصراً)
// ════════════════════════════════════════
  static Future<void> cancelOrder(
    String orderId,
    String merchantId,
  ) async {
    final cleanOrderId = orderId.trim();
    _assertMerchantSession(merchantId.trim());

    final callable = FirebaseFunctions.instanceFor(region: 'us-central1')
        .httpsCallable('cancelOrder',
            options:
                HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 15)));

    await callable.call({'orderId': cleanOrderId});
    await AppCache.instance.invalidateProducts();
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../../core/constants/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../../core/constants/app_radius.dart';
import '../../../../core/constants/app_text_styles.dart';
import '../../../../core/services/catalog_service.dart';
import '../../../../core/services/realtime_hub.dart';
import '../../../../core/services/app_cache.dart';
import '../../cart/providers/cart_provider.dart';
import '../../cart/screens/cart_screen.dart';
import '../widgets/product_card.dart';
import 'package:wissal/core/constants/app_adaptive_colors.dart';
import 'package:wissal/core/utils/arabic_normalizer.dart';
import 'package:wissal/features/merchant/products/services/products_service.dart';
import 'package:cached_network_image/cached_network_image.dart';

enum ProductSortCriteria {
  defaultSort,
  cheapest,
  highestPrice,
  bestSelling,
  mostPopular,
}

class ProductsScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  final String? categoryId;
  final String? categoryName;
  final String? brandId;
  final String? brandName;

  const ProductsScreen({
    super.key,
    this.categoryId,
    this.categoryName,
    this.brandId,
    this.brandName,
  });

  @override
  ConsumerState<ProductsScreen> createState() => _ProductsScreenState();
}

class _ProductsScreenState extends ConsumerState<ProductsScreen> {
  String? _selectedBrandId;
  ProductSortCriteria _selectedSort = ProductSortCriteria.defaultSort;
  String _searchQuery = '';
  final TextEditingController _searchCtrl = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _selectedBrandId = widget.brandId;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _showSortModalSheet() {
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) => Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 16, 20, 32),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: context.bgCard,
          borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
        ),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Center(
              child: Container(
                width: 40,
                height: 4,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: context.borderColor,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Text(
              'ترتيب المنتجات حسب:',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                fontSize: 16,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                color: context.textPrimary,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            _buildSortOption(
              label: 'الترتيب الافتراضي (حسب التنظيم المعتمد)',
              icon: Icons.sort_rounded,
              criteria: ProductSortCriteria.defaultSort,
            ),
            _buildSortOption(
              label: 'الأرخص سعراً أولاً (أفضل توفير 💰)',
              icon: Icons.arrow_downward_rounded,
              criteria: ProductSortCriteria.cheapest,
            ),
            _buildSortOption(
              label: 'الأعلى سعراً أولاً',
              icon: Icons.arrow_upward_rounded,
              criteria: ProductSortCriteria.highestPrice,
            ),
            _buildSortOption(
              label: 'الأكثر مبيعاً في السوق (الأعلى طلباً 🔥)',
              icon: Icons.local_fire_department_rounded,
              criteria: ProductSortCriteria.bestSelling,
            ),
            _buildSortOption(
              label: 'الأكثر رواجاً وتوفراً في المستودع ⭐',
              icon: Icons.star_rounded,
              criteria: ProductSortCriteria.mostPopular,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSortOption({
    required String label,
    required IconData icon,
    required ProductSortCriteria criteria,
  }) {
    final isSelected = _selectedSort == criteria;
    return ListTile(
      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
      leading: Icon(icon,
          color: isSelected ? AppColors.primary : context.iconSecondary),
      title: Text(
        label,
        style: TextStyle(
          fontFamily: 'Cairo',
          fontSize: 13.5,
          fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w600,
          color: isSelected ? AppColors.primary : context.textPrimary,
        ),
      ),
      trailing: isSelected
          ? const Icon(Icons.check_circle_rounded,
              color: AppColors.primary, size: 20)
          : null,
      onTap: () {
        HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
        setState(() => _selectedSort = criteria);
        Navigator.pop(context);
      },
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isBrandOnly = widget.categoryId == null && widget.brandId != null;
    final brandPageAsync =
        isBrandOnly ? ref.watch(productsStreamProvider(widget.brandId!)) : null;
    final productsAsync = isBrandOnly
        ? brandPageAsync!.whenData(
            (page) =>
                page.products.map((p) => {'id': p.id, ...p.toJson()}).toList(),
          )
        : ref.watch(productsProvider(widget.categoryId));
    final displayName = widget.categoryName ?? widget.brandName ?? 'المنتجات';

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: context.bgPage,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: RefreshIndicator(
          color: AppColors.primary,
          onRefresh: () async {
            if (isBrandOnly) {
              ref.invalidate(productsStreamProvider(widget.brandId!));
            } else {
              await ref
                  .read(productsProvider(widget.categoryId).notifier)
                  .refresh();
            }
          },
          child: CustomScrollView(
            physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(
                parent: AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics()),
            slivers: [
              // ══ 1. الترويسة العليا ══
              SliverToBoxAdapter(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(8, 14, 16, 0),

              SliverToBoxAdapter(

                      // زر الفرز السريع المتقدم

                                Icons.tune_rounded,

                              Text(
                                _getSortLabel(_selectedSort),
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontFamily: 'Cairo',

                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,

                                          ProductSortCriteria.defaultSort

                                      : context.textPrimary,

                    ],

              // ══ 4. شريط الشركات والماركات في الأعلى (Brands Bar) ══
              productsAsync.when(
                data: (rawList) {
                  final liveBrands = ref.watch(realtimeBrandsProvider);
                  final allBrandsList = liveBrands.isNotEmpty
                      ? liveBrands
                      : (AppCache.instance.getBrands() ?? []);
                  final brandsMap =
                      _extractDistinctBrands(rawList, allBrandsList);

                  return SliverToBoxAdapter(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        const SizedBox(height: 10),

                            child: ListView(

                              physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),

                                ),
                                ...brandsMap.entries.map((entry) {

                                  final bData = entry.value;
                                  return _buildBrandChip(
                                    label: bData['name'] ?? 'شركة',
                                    logoUrl: bData['logo_url'],
                                    isSelected: _selectedBrandId == bId,
                                    count: bData['count'] ?? 0,
                                    onTap: () {

                                      setState(() {
                                        _selectedBrandId =
                                            (_selectedBrandId == bId)
                                                ? null

                                      });

                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      ],

                  );

                    const SliverToBoxAdapter(child: SizedBox(height: 16)),
                error: (_, __) =>
                    const SliverToBoxAdapter(child: SizedBox.shrink()),
              ),

              // ══ 5. قائمة المنتجات المرتبة والمصفاة بالكامل ══
              SliverPadding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
                sliver: productsAsync.when(
                  loading: () =>
                      const SliverToBoxAdapter(child: _ProductsSkeletonList()),
                  error: (e, _) => SliverToBoxAdapter(

  // ── محرك المعالجة المتكامل: فلترة الماركة + البحث المطبّع + الترتيب الذكي ──
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _processProducts(List<Map<String, dynamic>> list) {
    final normQuery = ArabicNormalizer.normalize(_searchQuery);
    final queryTokens =
        normQuery.split(' ').where((t) => t.isNotEmpty).toList();
    final rawBarcodeQuery =
        ArabicNormalizer.normalizeDigits(_searchQuery).trim();

    // 1. التصفية
    final filtered = list.where((p) {
      if (p['is_deleted'] == true || p['is_active'] == false) return false;
      // فلترة الشركة
      if (_selectedBrandId != null &&
          p['brand_id']?.toString() != _selectedBrandId) {
        return false;
      }

      // فلترة البحث المطبّع والباركودات الشاملة
      if (normQuery.isNotEmpty) {
        final normName =
            ArabicNormalizer.normalize(p['name']?.toString() ?? '');
        final nameMatch = queryTokens.isNotEmpty &&
            queryTokens.every((t) => normName.contains(t));
        final barcodeMatch = rawBarcodeQuery.isNotEmpty &&
            ((p['barcode']?.toString() ?? '').contains(rawBarcodeQuery) ||
                (p['all_barcodes'] is List &&
                    (p['all_barcodes'] as List)
                        .any((b) => b.toString().contains(rawBarcodeQuery))) ||
                (p['units'] is List &&
                    (p['units'] as List).any((u) =>
                        u is Map &&
                        (u['barcode']?.toString() ?? '')
                            .contains(rawBarcodeQuery))) ||
                (p['variants'] is List &&
                    (p['variants'] as List).any((v) =>
                        v is Map &&
                        ((v['barcode']?.toString() ?? '')
                                .contains(rawBarcodeQuery) ||
                            (v['units'] is List &&
                                (v['units'] as List).any((vu) =>
                                    vu is Map &&
                                    (vu['barcode']?.toString() ?? '')
                                        .contains(rawBarcodeQuery)))))));
        if (!nameMatch && !barcodeMatch) {
          return false;
        }
      }

      return true;
    }).toList();
    // 2. الترتيب والفرز المتقدم
    switch (_selectedSort) {
      case ProductSortCriteria.cheapest:
        filtered.sort((a, b) {
          double minPriceOf(Map<String, dynamic> m) {
            final v = m['variants'];
            if (v is List && v.isNotEmpty) {
              final prices = v
                  .whereType<Map>()
                  .map((e) => (e['price'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0)
                  .toList();
              if (prices.isNotEmpty)
                return prices.reduce((x, y) => x < y ? x : y);
            }
            return (m['price'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
          }

          return minPriceOf(a).compareTo(minPriceOf(b));
        });
        break;

      case ProductSortCriteria.highestPrice:
        filtered.sort((a, b) {
          double maxPriceOf(Map<String, dynamic> m) {
            final v = m['variants'];
            if (v is List && v.isNotEmpty) {
              final prices = v
                  .whereType<Map>()
                  .map((e) => (e['price'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0)
                  .toList();
              if (prices.isNotEmpty) {
                return prices.reduce((x, y) => x > y ? x : y);
              }
            }
            return (m['price'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
          }

          return maxPriceOf(b).compareTo(maxPriceOf(a));
        });
        break;

      case ProductSortCriteria.bestSelling:
        filtered.sort((a, b) {
          final sA = (a['sales_count'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
          final sB = (b['sales_count'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
          return sB.compareTo(sA); // الأكثر مبيعاً أولاً
        });
        break;

      case ProductSortCriteria.mostPopular:
        filtered.sort((a, b) {
          // دمج الأكثر مبيعاً مع الأصناف المتوفرة بمخزون قوي
          final sA = ((a['sales_count'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0) * 2 +
              ((a['stock'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0);
          final sB = ((b['sales_count'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0) * 2 +
              ((b['stock'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0);
          return sB.compareTo(sA);
        });
        break;

      case ProductSortCriteria.defaultSort:
        filtered.sort((a, b) => ((a['sort_order'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 999)
            .compareTo((b['sort_order'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 999));
        break;
    }

    return filtered;
  }

  String _getSortLabel(ProductSortCriteria c) => switch (c) {
        ProductSortCriteria.cheapest => 'الأرخص 💰',
        ProductSortCriteria.highestPrice => 'الأعلى سعراً',
        ProductSortCriteria.bestSelling => 'الأكثر مبيعاً 🔥',
        ProductSortCriteria.mostPopular => 'الأكثر رواجاً ⭐',
        ProductSortCriteria.defaultSort => 'الترتيب',
      };
  Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> _extractDistinctBrands(
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> list,
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> allBrands,
  ) {
    final Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> brands = {};
    final brandsLookup = {for (final b in allBrands) b['id'].toString(): b};

    for (final p in list) {
      final bId = p['brand_id']?.toString();
      if (bId != null && bId.isNotEmpty) {
        final brandInfo = brandsLookup[bId];
        final brandName = brandInfo?['name'] ?? p['brand_name'] ?? 'شركة';
        final brandLogo = brandInfo?['logo_url'] ?? p['brand_logo'];

        if (!brands.containsKey(bId)) {
          brands[bId] = {
            'name': brandName,
            'logo_url': brandLogo,
            'count': 1,
          };
        } else {
          brands[bId]!['count'] =
              ((brands[bId]!['count'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0) + 1;
        }
      }
    }
    return brands;
  }

  Widget _buildBrandChip({
    required String label,
    String? logoUrl,
    required bool isSelected,
    required int count,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
  }) {
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: onTap,
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 8),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected ? AppColors.primary : context.bgCard,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          border: Border.all(
            color: isSelected ? AppColors.primary : context.borderColor,
            width: isSelected ? 1.5 : 1,
          ),
          boxShadow: isSelected
              ? [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                    blurRadius: 8,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 3),
                  )
                ]
              : null,
        ),
        child: Row(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            if (logoUrl != null && logoUrl.isNotEmpty) ...[
              ClipOval(
                child: CachedNetworkImage(
                  imageUrl: logoUrl,
                  width: 18,
                  height: 18,
                  fit: BoxFit.cover,
                  errorWidget: (_, __, ___) =>
                      const Icon(Icons.business, size: 14),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
            ],
            Text(
              label,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                fontSize: 12,
                fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w600,
                color: isSelected ? Colors.white : context.textPrimary,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 5),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 1),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: isSelected
                    ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.25)
                    : context.bgInput,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
              ),
              child: Text(
                '$count',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                  fontSize: 10,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  color: isSelected ? Colors.white : AppColors.primary,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ProductsSkeletonList extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ProductsSkeletonList();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      children: List.generate(
        4,
        (i) => Container(
          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
          height: 130,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:wissal/core/models/product_unit.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

enum ProductSizeTier { all, small, medium, large }

class ProductModel {
  final String id;
  final String name;
  final double price;
  final String? imageUrl;
  final String brandId;
  final String? description;
  final double? sizeMl;
  final String? sizeText;
  final int? itemsPerCarton;
  final String? productionDate;
  final String? expiryDate;
  final double costPrice;
  final double stock;
  final double baseStock;
  final bool hasBaseStock;
  final int salesCount; // 👈 عداد المبيعات الفعلي الموثق سحابياً
  final String? barcode;
  final int sortOrder;
  final List<String> allBarcodes;
  final List<ProductUnit> units;
  final List<ProductVariant> variants;

  const ProductModel({
    required this.id,
    required this.name,
    required this.price,
    this.imageUrl,
    required this.brandId,
    this.description,
    this.sizeMl,
    this.sizeText,
    this.itemsPerCarton,
    this.productionDate,
    this.expiryDate,
    this.costPrice = 0,
    this.stock = 0.0,
    this.baseStock = 0.0,
    this.hasBaseStock = false,
    this.salesCount = 0,
    this.barcode,
    this.sortOrder = 999,
    this.allBarcodes = const [],
    this.units = const [],
    this.variants = const [],
  });

  bool get hasVariants => variants.isNotEmpty;

  /// دمج بيانات المنتج الأساسي تلقائياً كأول حجم فقط إذا كان له مخزون أساسي مستقل
  List<ProductVariant> get allVariantsWithBase {
    if (variants.isEmpty) return const [];
    if (!hasBaseStock && baseStock <= 0) return variants;
    final baseVariant = ProductVariant(
      id: 'base_default',
      label: (sizeText != null && sizeText!.trim().isNotEmpty)
          ? sizeText!.trim()
          : 'الحجم الأساسي',
      price: price,
      stock: baseStock,
      itemsPerCarton: itemsPerCarton ?? 1,
      sizeText: sizeText,
      sizeMl: sizeMl,
      imageUrl: imageUrl,
      barcode: barcode,
      units: units,
    );
    return [baseVariant, ...variants];
  }

  double get effectiveMinPrice {
    if (variants.isEmpty) return price;
    return allVariantsWithBase
        .map((v) => v.price)
        .reduce((a, b) => a < b ? a : b);
  }

  double get totalStock {
    if (variants.isEmpty) return baseStock;
    return baseStock +
        variants.fold(0.0, (sum, v) => sum + (v.stock > 0 ? v.stock : 0.0));
  }

  // 🚀 خوارزمية تصنيف الحجم الذكية (كبير / وسط / صغير)
  ProductSizeTier get sizeTier {
    final txt = (sizeText ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
    final ml = sizeMl ?? 0.0;

    if (txt.contains('عائلي') ||
        txt.contains('كبير') ||
        txt.contains('لتر') ||
        txt.contains('كجم') ||
        txt.contains('كيلو') ||
        ml >= 900) {
      return ProductSizeTier.large;
    }
    if (txt.contains('صغير') || (ml > 0 && ml < 250)) {
      return ProductSizeTier.small;
    }
    if (txt.contains('وسط') || (ml >= 250 && ml < 900)) {
      return ProductSizeTier.medium;
    }
    return ProductSizeTier.all;
  }

  factory ProductModel.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> m) {
    final rawUnits = m['units'];

    final units = rawUnits is List
        ? rawUnits
            .whereType<Map>()
            .map(
              (e) => ProductUnit.fromMap(
                Map<String, dynamic>.from(e),
              ),
            )
            .toList()
        : <ProductUnit>[];

    String? readDate(dynamic value) {
      if (value == null) return null;
      if (value is Timestamp) {
        return value.toDate().toIso8601String();
      }
      if (value is DateTime) {
        return value.toIso8601String();
      }
      return value.toString();
    }

    final basePrice = (m['price'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
    final cartonItems = (m['items_per_carton'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 1;
    final sizeMl = (m['size_ml'] as num?)?.toDouble();
    final prodDate = readDate(m['production_date']);
    final expDate = readDate(m['expiry_date']);
    final imageUrl = m['image_url'] as String?;
    final barcode = m['barcode']?.toString().trim();

// حجب أسعار التكلفة تماماً عن هواتف التجار، وتوريث باركود المنتج للكميات التابعة له
    final sanitizedUnits = units
        .map((u) => ProductUnit(
              label: u.label,
              qty: u.qty,
              price: u.price,
              costPrice: null, // حجب التكلفة
              imageUrl: u.imageUrl,
              sizeMl: u.sizeMl,
              productionDate: u.productionDate,
              expiryDate: u.expiryDate,
              barcode: barcode,
            ))
        .toList();

    final cartonIndex =
        sanitizedUnits.indexWhere((u) => u.label.trim() == 'كرتون');
    if (cartonIndex == -1) {
      sanitizedUnits.insert(
        0,
        ProductUnit(
          label: 'كرتون',
          qty: cartonItems > 0 ? cartonItems : 1,
          price: basePrice,
          costPrice: null,
          imageUrl: imageUrl,
          sizeMl: sizeMl,
          productionDate: prodDate != null ? DateTime.tryParse(prodDate) : null,
          expiryDate: expDate != null ? DateTime.tryParse(expDate) : null,
          barcode: barcode,
        ),
      );
    } else {
      final existingCarton = sanitizedUnits[cartonIndex];
      sanitizedUnits[cartonIndex] = ProductUnit(
        label: 'كرتون',
        qty: existingCarton.qty > 0
            ? existingCarton.qty
            : (cartonItems > 0 ? cartonItems : 1),
        // الحفاظ على السعر المخصص للكرتون إن وُجد وإلا استخدام basePrice
        price: existingCarton.price > 0 ? existingCarton.price : basePrice,
        costPrice: null,
        imageUrl: existingCarton.imageUrl ?? imageUrl,
        sizeMl: existingCarton.sizeMl ?? sizeMl,
        productionDate: existingCarton.productionDate ??
            (prodDate != null ? DateTime.tryParse(prodDate) : null),
        expiryDate: existingCarton.expiryDate ??
            (expDate != null ? DateTime.tryParse(expDate) : null),
        barcode: existingCarton.barcode ?? barcode,
      );
    }
    final rawVariants = m['variants'];
    final sanitizedVariants = rawVariants is List
        ? rawVariants.whereType<Map>().map((rawV) {
            final v = ProductVariant.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic>.from(rawV));
            final String? variantBarcode =
                (v.barcode != null && v.barcode!.isNotEmpty) ? v.barcode : null;
            final String? effectiveVarBarcode = variantBarcode ?? barcode;

            List<ProductUnit> vUnits = v.units
                .map((u) => ProductUnit(
                      label: u.label,
                      qty: u.qty,
                      price: u.price,
                      costPrice: null,
                      imageUrl: u.imageUrl,
                      sizeMl: u.sizeMl,
                      productionDate: u.productionDate,
                      expiryDate: u.expiryDate,
                      barcode: effectiveVarBarcode,
                    ))
                .toList();

            // 🌟 توريث كافة كميات ووحدات المنتج الأساسي للحجم مع ربطها بباركود الحجم نفسه
            final hasCustomSubUnits =
                vUnits.any((u) => u.label.trim() != 'كرتون');
            if (!hasCustomSubUnits && sanitizedUnits.length > 1) {
              final double ratio = basePrice > 0 ? (v.price / basePrice) : 1.0;
              vUnits = sanitizedUnits.map((pUnit) {
                if (pUnit.label.trim() == 'كرتون') {
                  return ProductUnit(
                    label: 'كرتون',
                    qty: v.itemsPerCarton > 0 ? v.itemsPerCarton : pUnit.qty,
                    price: v.price,
                    costPrice: null,
                    imageUrl: v.imageUrl ?? imageUrl,
                    sizeMl: v.sizeMl ?? pUnit.sizeMl,
                    productionDate: v.productionDate ?? pUnit.productionDate,
                    expiryDate: v.expiryDate ?? pUnit.expiryDate,
                    barcode: effectiveVarBarcode,
                  );
                }
                final double scaledPrice =
                    double.parse((pUnit.price * ratio).toStringAsFixed(6))
                        .roundToDouble();
                return ProductUnit(
                  label: pUnit.label,
                  qty: pUnit.qty,
                  price: scaledPrice > 0 ? scaledPrice : pUnit.price,
                  costPrice: null,
                  imageUrl: v.imageUrl ?? pUnit.imageUrl,
                  sizeMl: v.sizeMl ?? pUnit.sizeMl,
                  productionDate: v.productionDate ?? pUnit.productionDate,
                  expiryDate: v.expiryDate ?? pUnit.expiryDate,
                  barcode: effectiveVarBarcode,
                );
              }).toList();
            } else {
              final cIdx = vUnits.indexWhere((u) => u.label.trim() == 'كرتون');
              if (cIdx == -1) {
                vUnits.insert(
                  0,
                  ProductUnit(
                    label: 'كرتون',
                    qty: v.itemsPerCarton > 0 ? v.itemsPerCarton : cartonItems,
                    price: v.price,
                    costPrice: null,
                    imageUrl: v.imageUrl ?? imageUrl,
                    sizeMl: v.sizeMl ?? sizeMl,
                    productionDate: v.productionDate,
                    expiryDate: v.expiryDate,
                    barcode: effectiveVarBarcode,
                  ),
                );
              }
            }

            return ProductVariant(
              id: v.id,
              label: v.label,
              price: v.price,
              costPrice: null,
              stock: v.stock,
              itemsPerCarton: v.itemsPerCarton,
              sizeText: v.sizeText,
              sizeMl: v.sizeMl,
              imageUrl: v.imageUrl ?? imageUrl,
              barcode: variantBarcode,
              productionDate: v.productionDate,
              expiryDate: v.expiryDate,
              units: vUnits,
            );
          }).toList()
        : <ProductVariant>[];
    return ProductModel(
      id: m['id']?.toString() ?? '',
      name: (m['name'] as String?)?.trim() ?? '',
      price: basePrice,
      imageUrl: imageUrl,
      brandId: m['brand_id']?.toString() ?? '',
      description: m['description'] as String?,
      sizeMl: sizeMl,
      sizeText: m['size_text']?.toString() ?? m['size_label']?.toString(),
      itemsPerCarton: (m['items_per_carton'] as num?)?.toInt(),
      productionDate: prodDate,
      expiryDate: expDate,
      costPrice: 0.0,
      stock: (m['stock'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
      baseStock: m['base_stock'] != null
          ? (m['base_stock'] as num).toDouble()
          : (sanitizedVariants.isEmpty
              ? ((m['stock'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0)
              : 0.0),
      hasBaseStock: m['has_base_stock'] == true ||
          sanitizedVariants.isEmpty ||
          (m['base_stock'] != null && (m['base_stock'] as num).toDouble() > 0),
      salesCount: (m['sales_count'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
      barcode: barcode,
      sortOrder: (m['sort_order'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 999,
      allBarcodes: (m['all_barcodes'] as List? ?? const [])
          .map((e) => e.toString())
          .toList(),
      units: sanitizedUnits,
      variants: sanitizedVariants,
    );
  }

  factory ProductModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> m) =>
      ProductModel.fromMap(m);

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    return {
      'id': id,
      'name': name,
      'price': price,
      'image_url': imageUrl,
      'brand_id': brandId,
      'description': description,
      'size_ml': sizeMl,
      'size_text': sizeText,
      'items_per_carton': itemsPerCarton,
      'production_date': productionDate,
      'expiry_date': expiryDate,
      'cost_price': costPrice,
      'stock': stock,
      'base_stock': baseStock,
      'has_base_stock': hasBaseStock,
      'sales_count': salesCount,
      'sort_order': sortOrder,
      if (allBarcodes.isNotEmpty) 'all_barcodes': allBarcodes,
      if (barcode != null && barcode!.isNotEmpty) 'barcode': barcode,
      'units': units.map((unit) => unit.toMap()).toList(),
      'variants': variants.map((v) => v.toJson()).toList(),
    };
  }
}

class ProductCatalogPage {
  final List<ProductModel> products;
  final bool hasMore;
  final bool isLoadingMore;
  final String? loadMoreError;

  const ProductCatalogPage({
    required this.products,
    required this.hasMore,
    this.isLoadingMore = false,
    this.loadMoreError,
  });

  ProductCatalogPage copyWith({
    List<ProductModel>? products,
    bool? hasMore,
    bool? isLoadingMore,
    String? loadMoreError,
    bool clearLoadMoreError = false,
  }) {
    return ProductCatalogPage(
      products: products ?? this.products,
      hasMore: hasMore ?? this.hasMore,
      isLoadingMore: isLoadingMore ?? this.isLoadingMore,
      loadMoreError:
          clearLoadMoreError ? null : loadMoreError ?? this.loadMoreError,
    );
  }
}

final productsStreamProvider = StateNotifierProvider.autoDispose
    .family<ProductCatalogNotifier, AsyncValue<ProductCatalogPage>, String>(
  (ref, brandId) => ProductCatalogNotifier(brandId),
);

class ProductCatalogNotifier
    extends StateNotifier<AsyncValue<ProductCatalogPage>> {
  ProductCatalogNotifier(this.brandId) : super(const AsyncValue.loading()) {
    _subscribeToFirstPage();
  }

  static const int _pageSize = 50;
  final String brandId;
  final _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;
  StreamSubscription<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>? _subscription;
  DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? _cursor;
  final Map<String, ProductModel> _firstPage = {};
  final Map<String, ProductModel> _loadedPages = {};
  String? firstPageLastId;
  bool _hasMore = true;
  bool _isLoadingMore = false;
  Query<Map<String, dynamic>> get _baseQuery => _db
      .collection('products')
      .where('brand_id', isEqualTo: brandId)
      .where('is_deleted', isEqualTo: false)
      .orderBy('name');
  void _subscribeToFirstPage() {
    _subscription = _baseQuery
        .limit(_pageSize)
        .snapshots(includeMetadataChanges: false)
        .listen(
      (snapshot) {
        firstPageLastId = snapshot.docs.isEmpty ? null : snapshot.docs.last.id;
        if (_loadedPages.isEmpty) {
          _cursor = snapshot.docs.isEmpty ? null : snapshot.docs.last;
          _hasMore = snapshot.docs.length == _pageSize;
        }
        _firstPage
          ..clear()
          ..addEntries(
            snapshot.docs
                .where((doc) =>
                    doc.data()['is_deleted'] != true &&
                    doc.data()['is_active'] != false)
                .map((doc) {
              final product = ProductModel.fromMap({
                'id': doc.id,
                ...doc.data(),
              });
              return MapEntry(product.id, product);
            }).where((entry) => entry.value.name.trim().isNotEmpty),
          );
        for (final id in _firstPage.keys) {
          _loadedPages.remove(id);
        }
        _publish();
      },
      onError: (Object error, StackTrace stackTrace) {
        if (state.value == null) {
          state = AsyncValue.error(error, stackTrace);
        } else {
          debugPrint('Product first-page stream failed for $brandId: $error');
        }
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> loadMore() async {
    if (!_hasMore || _isLoadingMore || _cursor == null) return;
    _isLoadingMore = true;
    _publish(clearLoadMoreError: true);

    try {
      final snapshot = await _baseQuery
          .startAfterDocument(_cursor!)
          .limit(_pageSize)
          .get(const GetOptions(source: Source.serverAndCache));
      if (!mounted) return;

      if (snapshot.docs.isNotEmpty) {
        _cursor = snapshot.docs.last;
        for (final doc in snapshot.docs) {
          final data = doc.data();
          if (data['is_deleted'] == true || data['is_active'] == false) {
            _loadedPages.remove(doc.id);
            continue;
          }
          final product = ProductModel.fromMap({'id': doc.id, ...data});
          if (product.name.trim().isNotEmpty) {
            _loadedPages[product.id] = product;
          }
        }
      }
      _hasMore = snapshot.docs.length == _pageSize;
      _isLoadingMore = false;
      _publish();
    } catch (error, stackTrace) {
      _isLoadingMore = false;
      debugPrint('Product pagination failed for $brandId: $error');
      if (kDebugMode) debugPrintStack(stackTrace: stackTrace);
      if (mounted) {
        _publish(loadMoreError: 'تعذر تحميل المزيد من المنتجات');
      }
    }
  }

  void _publish({
    String? loadMoreError,
    bool clearLoadMoreError = false,
  }) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    final products = <String, ProductModel>{..._loadedPages, ..._firstPage};
    final sorted = products.values.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => a.name.compareTo(b.name));
    state = AsyncValue.data(ProductCatalogPage(
      products: sorted,
      hasMore: _hasMore,
      isLoadingMore: _isLoadingMore,
      loadMoreError: clearLoadMoreError
          ? null
          : loadMoreError ?? state.value?.loadMoreError,
    ));
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _subscription?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }
}
