import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:cached_network_image/cached_network_image.dart';
import '../../../../core/constants/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../../core/constants/app_adaptive_colors.dart';
import '../../../../core/services/image_precache_service.dart';
import '../services/products_service.dart';
import '../../cart/providers/cart_provider.dart';
import 'package:wissal/core/models/product_unit.dart';
import 'package:wissal/core/utils/arabic_normalizer.dart';
import 'product_details_sheet.dart';

class ProductCard extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  final ProductModel product;
  const ProductCard({super.key, required this.product});

  @override
  ConsumerState<ProductCard> createState() => _ProductCardState();
}

class _ProductCardState extends ConsumerState<ProductCard> {
  int _qty = 1;
  int _selectedVariantIndex = 0;
  ProductUnit? _selectedUnit;

  List<ProductVariant> get _allVariants => widget.product.hasVariants
      ? widget.product.allVariantsWithBase
      : const [];

  ProductVariant? get _activeVariant =>
      _allVariants.isNotEmpty ? _allVariants[_selectedVariantIndex] : null;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _initSelection();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant ProductCard oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.product.id != widget.product.id) {
      _initSelection();
    }
  }

  void _initSelection() {
    _qty = 1;
    _selectedVariantIndex = 0;
    _updateSelectedUnit();
  }

  void _updateSelectedUnit() {
    final v = _activeVariant;
    final units =
        (v != null && v.units.isNotEmpty) ? v.units : widget.product.units;
    _selectedUnit = units.isNotEmpty ? units.first : null;
  }

  double get _currentUnitPrice {
    if (_selectedUnit != null) return _selectedUnit!.price;
    if (_activeVariant != null) return _activeVariant!.price;
    return widget.product.price;
  }

  String get _currentUnitLabel => _selectedUnit?.label ?? 'كرتون';

  String? get _currentImage {
    if (_selectedUnit?.imageUrl != null &&
        _selectedUnit!.imageUrl!.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      return _selectedUnit!.imageUrl!.trim();
    }
    if (_activeVariant?.imageUrl != null &&
        _activeVariant!.imageUrl!.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      return _activeVariant!.imageUrl!.trim();
    }
    return widget.product.imageUrl;
  }

  double get _currentStock => _activeVariant?.stock ?? widget.product.baseStock;
  void _onVariantSelected(int index) {
    if (_selectedVariantIndex == index) return;
    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
    setState(() {
      _selectedVariantIndex = index;
      _qty = 1;
      _updateSelectedUnit();
    });
  }

  void _onUnitSelected(ProductUnit unit) {
    if (_selectedUnit?.label == unit.label) return;
    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
    setState(() {
      _selectedUnit = unit;
      _qty = 1;
    });
  }

  void _addToCart() {
    final v = _activeVariant;
    final isBaseVariant = v == null || v.id == 'base_default';
    final effectiveVariant = isBaseVariant ? null : v;
    final availableStock = _currentStock;

    if (availableStock <= 0) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).clearSnackBars();
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('عذراً، هذا الحجم غير متوفر حالياً في المستودع',
              style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo')),
          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final cartonCap = (v?.itemsPerCarton ?? widget.product.itemsPerCarton ?? 1);
    final safeCap = cartonCap > 0 ? cartonCap : 1;
    final unitQty = (_selectedUnit?.qty ?? safeCap) > 0
        ? (_selectedUnit?.qty ?? safeCap)
        : 1;

    double usedCartons = 0.0;
    for (final cItem in ref.read(cartProvider).values) {
      if (cItem.product.id == widget.product.id &&
          (cItem.selectedVariant?.id ?? '') == (effectiveVariant?.id ?? '')) {
        final cCap = cItem.selectedVariant?.itemsPerCarton ??
            cItem.product.itemsPerCarton ??
            1;
        final uQty = cItem.selectedUnit?.qty ?? cCap;
        usedCartons += (cItem.quantity * uQty) / (cCap > 0 ? cCap : 1);
      }
    }

    final remainingCartons =
        (availableStock - usedCartons).clamp(0.0, availableStock);
    final maxAddableUnits = ((remainingCartons * safeCap) / unitQty).floor();

    if (maxAddableUnits <= 0) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).clearSnackBars();
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            'وصلت للحد الأقصى المتوفر في المستودع لهذا الصنف داخل سلتك',
            style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo'),
          ),
          backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final qtyToAdd = _qty > maxAddableUnits ? maxAddableUnits : _qty;
    HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();

    ref.read(cartProvider.notifier).addItem(
          widget.product,
          qtyToAdd,
          unit: _selectedUnit,
          variant: effectiveVariant,
        );

    final title = !isBaseVariant
        ? '${v.label} - $_currentUnitLabel'
        : '${widget.product.name} - $_currentUnitLabel';

    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).clearSnackBars();
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(
          '✅ تمت إضافة $qtyToAdd من $title للسلة',
          style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo'),
          textAlign: TextAlign.right,
        ),
        backgroundColor: AppColors.primary,
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 85),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1500),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _openSheet() {
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => ProductDetailsSheet(
        product: widget.product,
        initialVariant: _activeVariant,
        initialUnit: _selectedUnit,
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _showManualQtyDialog() async {
    HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
    final result = await showDialog<int>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => _ManualQtyDialog(
        initialQty: _qty,
        unitLabel: _currentUnitLabel,
        productName:
            (_activeVariant != null && _activeVariant!.id != 'base_default')
                ? _activeVariant!.label
                : widget.product.name,
      ),
    );

    if (result != null && result > 0 && mounted) {
      final v = _activeVariant;
      final availableStock = _currentStock;
      final cartonCap =
          (v?.itemsPerCarton ?? widget.product.itemsPerCarton ?? 1);
      final safeCap = cartonCap > 0 ? cartonCap : 1;
      final unitQty = (_selectedUnit?.qty ?? safeCap) > 0
          ? (_selectedUnit?.qty ?? safeCap)
          : 1;

      final maxUnits = availableStock > 0
          ? ((availableStock * safeCap) / unitQty).floor().clamp(1, 999)
          : 999;

      final finalQty = result > maxUnits ? maxUnits : result;
      setState(() => _qty = finalQty);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final v = _activeVariant;
    final isOutOfStock = _currentStock <= 0;
    final currentPrice = _currentUnitPrice;
    final pageTotal = currentPrice * _qty;
    final availableUnits =
        (v != null && v.units.isNotEmpty) ? v.units : widget.product.units;

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: context.bgCard,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
        border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: context.shadowColor.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
            blurRadius: 12,
            offset: const Offset(0, 4),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            // ── 1. اسم المنتج + شريط الأحجام المتوفرة ──
            GestureDetector(
              onTap: _openSheet,
              child: Text(
                (v != null && v.id != 'base_default')
                    ? v.label
                    : widget.product.name,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                  fontSize: 15.5,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  color: context.textPrimary,
                ),
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              ),
            ),

            // شريط اختيار الحجم بنقرة واحدة فائقة السلاسة
            if (_allVariants.isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              SizedBox(
                height: 32,
                child: ListView.builder(
                  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                  physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                  itemCount: _allVariants.length,
                  itemBuilder: (ctx, idx) {
                    final variant = _allVariants[idx];
                    final isSel = idx == _selectedVariantIndex;
                    final vOut = variant.stock <= 0;

                    return GestureDetector(
                      onTap: () => _onVariantSelected(idx),
                      child: AnimatedContainer(
                        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
                        margin: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(end: 6),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: isSel
                              ? AppColors.primary
                              : AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                          border: Border.all(
                            color: isSel
                                ? AppColors.primary
                                : (vOut
                                    ? Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.3)
                                    : AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.2)),
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: Row(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            if (vOut) ...[
                              const Icon(Icons.block_rounded,
                                  size: 11, color: Colors.red),
                              const SizedBox(width: 3),
                            ],
                            Text(
                              variant.label,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                                fontSize: 11,
                                fontWeight:
                                    isSel ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w700,
                                color: isSel
                                    ? Colors.white
                                    : (vOut ? Colors.red : AppColors.primary),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ],

            const SizedBox(height: 10),

            // ── 2. المنطقة الوسطى (الصورة + الأسعار مع التحديث الفوري) ──
            Row(
              children: [
                // الإجمالي
                Expanded(
                  flex: 3,
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        'الإجمالي',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                          fontSize: 11,
                          color: context.textSecondary,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 2),
                      AnimatedSwitcher(
                        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
                        child: Text(
                          key: ValueKey(pageTotal),
                          '${pageTotal.toStringAsFixed(0)} ر.ي',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                            fontSize: 16,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                            color: context.textPrimary,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),

                // سعر الوحدة المحددة
                Expanded(
                  flex: 3,
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        'سعر $_currentUnitLabel',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                          fontSize: 11,
                          color: context.textSecondary,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 2),
                      AnimatedSwitcher(
                        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
                        child: Text(
                          key: ValueKey('${currentPrice}_$_currentUnitLabel'),
                          '${currentPrice.toStringAsFixed(0)} ر.ي',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                            fontSize: 15,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                            color: context.textPrimary,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),

                const SizedBox(width: 10),

                // صورة المنتج أو الحجم أو الوحدة المحددة
                GestureDetector(
                  onTap: _openSheet,
                  child: ClipRRect(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                    child: Container(
                      width: 76,
                      height: 76,
                      color: context.bgInput,
                      child: _currentImage != null && _currentImage!.isNotEmpty
                          ? CachedNetworkImage(
                              cacheManager:
                                  ImagePrecacheService.instance.cacheManager,
                              imageUrl: _currentImage!,
                              fit: BoxFit.contain,
                              memCacheWidth: 200,
                              placeholder: (_, __) => const Center(
                                child: Icon(Icons.inventory_2_outlined,
                                    color: Colors.grey, size: 28),
                              ),
                              errorWidget: (_, __, ___) => const Center(
                                child: Icon(Icons.inventory_2_outlined,
                                    color: AppColors.primary, size: 28),
                              ),
                            )
                          : const Center(
                              child: Icon(Icons.inventory_2_outlined,
                                  color: AppColors.primary, size: 28),
                            ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),

            // ── 3. شريط وحدات الحجم المحدد (كرتون / نصف كرتون / حبة) ──
            if (availableUnits.length > 1) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              SizedBox(
                height: 28,
                child: ListView.builder(
                  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                  physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                  itemCount: availableUnits.length,
                  itemBuilder: (ctx, uIdx) {
                    final unit = availableUnits[uIdx];
                    final isSelUnit = _selectedUnit?.label == unit.label;

                    return GestureDetector(
                      onTap: () => _onUnitSelected(unit),
                      child: AnimatedContainer(
                        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 150),
                        margin: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(end: 6),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 9, vertical: 3),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: isSelUnit
                              ? const Color(0xFF1B8E3D)
                              : context.bgInput,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                          border: Border.all(
                            color: isSelUnit
                                ? const Color(0xFF1B8E3D)
                                : context.borderColor,
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: Text(
                          '${unit.label} (${unit.price.toStringAsFixed(0)} ر.ي)',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                            fontSize: 10.5,
                            fontWeight:
                                isSelUnit ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w600,
                            color:
                                isSelUnit ? Colors.white : context.textPrimary,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ],

            const SizedBox(height: 12),

            // ── 4. عداد الكمية (+ / -) وزر الإضافة للسلة المباشر ──
            Row(
              children: [
                // أزرار التحكم بالكمية
                Container(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: context.bgInput,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      GestureDetector(
                        onTap: () {
                          if (_qty > 1) {
                            HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                            setState(() => _qty--);
                          }
                        },
                        child: Container(
                          width: 36,
                          height: 36,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: context.bgInput,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                          ),
                          child: Icon(
                            Icons.remove_rounded,
                            color: _qty > 1
                                ? context.textPrimary
                                : Colors.grey.shade400,
                            size: 18,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      GestureDetector(
                        onTap: _showManualQtyDialog,
                        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                        child: Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 12, vertical: 4),
                          child: Text(
                            '$_qty',
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                              fontSize: 16,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                              color: context.textPrimary,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      GestureDetector(
                        onTap: () {
                          HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                          setState(() => _qty++);
                        },
                        child: Container(
                          width: 36,
                          height: 36,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: AppColors.primary,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                          ),
                          child: const Icon(Icons.add_rounded,
                              color: Colors.white, size: 18),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),

                const SizedBox(width: 10),

                // زر الإضافة للسلة المباشر
                Expanded(
                  child: SizedBox(
                    height: 42,
                    child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                      onPressed: isOutOfStock ? null : _addToCart,
                      icon: Icon(
                        isOutOfStock
                            ? Icons.remove_shopping_cart_rounded
                            : Icons.shopping_cart_outlined,
                        size: 17,
                      ),
                      label: Text(
                        isOutOfStock
                            ? 'نفد المخزون'
                            : 'إضافة ($_currentUnitLabel)',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                          fontSize: 13,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                        ),
                      ),
                      style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor:
                            isOutOfStock ? Colors.grey : AppColors.primary,
                        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                        elevation: 0,
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// نافذة إدخال الكمية اليدوية وتدعم الأرقام العربية والإنجليزية
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
class _ManualQtyDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  final int initialQty;
  final String unitLabel;
  final String productName;

  const _ManualQtyDialog({
    required this.initialQty,
    required this.unitLabel,
    required this.productName,
  });

  @override
  State<_ManualQtyDialog> createState() => _ManualQtyDialogState();
}

class _ManualQtyDialogState extends State<_ManualQtyDialog> {
  late final TextEditingController _controller;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = TextEditingController(text: '${widget.initialQty}');
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _submit() {
    final text = ArabicNormalizer.normalizeDigits(_controller.text).trim();
    final val = int.tryParse(text);
    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
    Navigator.pop(context, (val != null && val > 0) ? val : null);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AlertDialog(
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22)),
      backgroundColor: context.bgCard,
      title: Text(
        'تحديد الكمية (${widget.unitLabel})',
        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
        style: TextStyle(
          fontFamily: 'Cairo',
          fontSize: 16,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
          color: context.textPrimary,
        ),
      ),
      content: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          Text(
            widget.productName,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontFamily: 'Cairo',
              fontSize: 12,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: context.textSecondary,
            ),
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            maxLines: 2,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          Text(
            'أدخل عدد (${widget.unitLabel}) المطلوبة:',
            style: TextStyle(
              fontFamily: 'Cairo',
              fontSize: 12,
              color: context.textSecondary,
            ),
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          TextField(
            controller: _controller,
            autofocus: true,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
            textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
            onSubmitted: (_) => _submit(),
            inputFormatters: [
              TextInputFormatter.withFunction((oldVal, newVal) {
                // تحويل الأرقام العربية المشرقية (١، ٢، ٣...) تلقائياً لأرقام قياسية
                final normalized =
                    ArabicNormalizer.normalizeDigits(newVal.text);
                final digitsOnly = normalized.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9]'), '');
                return TextEditingValue(
                  text: digitsOnly,
                  selection: TextSelection.collapsed(offset: digitsOnly.length),
                );
              }),
              LengthLimitingTextInputFormatter(4),
            ],
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontFamily: 'Cairo',
              fontSize: 28,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
              color: AppColors.primary,
            ),
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              filled: true,
              fillColor: context.bgInput,
              hintText: '1',
              border: OutlineInputBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                borderSide:
                    const BorderSide(color: AppColors.primary, width: 1.5),
              ),
              focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                borderSide:
                    const BorderSide(color: AppColors.primary, width: 2),
              ),
              contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () {
            FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
            Navigator.pop(context);
          },
          child: const Text(
            'إلغاء',
            style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo', color: Colors.grey),
          ),
        ),
        ElevatedButton(
          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
            backgroundColor: AppColors.primary,
            foregroundColor: Colors.white,
            shape:
                RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
          ),
          onPressed: _submit,
          child: const Text(
            'تأكيد',
            style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo', fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}


// ==================================================
// FILE: lib\features\merchant\products\widgets\product_details_sheet.dart
// ==================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../../core/constants/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../../core/constants/app_radius.dart';
import '../../cart/providers/cart_provider.dart';
import '../services/products_service.dart';
import 'package:wissal/core/models/product_unit.dart';
import 'package:cached_network_image/cached_network_image.dart';
import '../../../../core/services/image_precache_service.dart';
import 'package:wissal/core/constants/app_adaptive_colors.dart';

class ProductDetailsSheet extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  final ProductModel product;
  final ProductVariant? initialVariant;
  final ProductUnit? initialUnit;
  const ProductDetailsSheet({
    super.key,
    required this.product,
    this.initialVariant,
    this.initialUnit,
  });

  @override
  ConsumerState<ProductDetailsSheet> createState() =>
      _ProductDetailsSheetState();
}

class _ProductDetailsSheetState extends ConsumerState<ProductDetailsSheet> {
  int _qty = 1;
  int _variantIndex = 0;
  ProductUnit? _selectedUnit;
  final Map<int, ProductUnit?> _variantUnits = {};
  final Map<int, int> _variantQtys = {};
  PageController? _pageController;

  List<ProductVariant> get _effectiveVariants => widget.product.hasVariants
      ? widget.product.allVariantsWithBase
      : const [];

  ProductVariant? get _currentVariant =>
      _effectiveVariants.isNotEmpty ? _effectiveVariants[_variantIndex] : null;
  ProductUnit? _unitForIndex(int idx) {
    if (!widget.product.hasVariants) return _selectedUnit;
    if (_variantUnits.containsKey(idx) && _variantUnits[idx] != null) {
      return _variantUnits[idx];
    }
    final v = _effectiveVariants[idx];
    final units = v.units.isNotEmpty ? v.units : widget.product.units;
    return units.isNotEmpty ? units.first : null;
  }

  int _qtyForIndex(int idx) {
    if (!widget.product.hasVariants) return _qty;
    return _variantQtys[idx] ?? 1;
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final allVars = _effectiveVariants;
    if (widget.product.hasVariants && allVars.isNotEmpty) {
      if (widget.initialVariant != null) {
        final idx = allVars.indexWhere(
          (v) =>
              v.id == widget.initialVariant!.id ||
              v.label.trim() == widget.initialVariant!.label.trim(),
        );
        if (idx != -1) _variantIndex = idx;
      }
      _pageController = PageController(initialPage: _variantIndex);
      for (var i = 0; i < allVars.length; i++) {
        final units = allVars[i].units.isNotEmpty
            ? allVars[i].units
            : widget.product.units;
        _variantUnits[i] = (i == _variantIndex && widget.initialUnit != null)
            ? (units
                    .where((u) =>
                        u.label.trim() == widget.initialUnit!.label.trim())
                    .firstOrNull ??
                (units.isNotEmpty ? units.first : null))
            : (units.isNotEmpty ? units.first : null);
        _variantQtys[i] = 1;
      }
      _selectedUnit = _variantUnits[_variantIndex];
      _qty = 1;
    } else {
      _selectedUnit = widget.initialUnit ??
          (widget.product.units.isNotEmpty ? widget.product.units.first : null);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _pageController?.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  double _priceFor(ProductVariant? v) =>
      _selectedUnit?.price ?? v?.price ?? widget.product.price;

  String get _currentUnitLabel => _selectedUnit?.label ?? 'كرتون';

  String? _imageFor(ProductVariant? v, {ProductUnit? unit}) {
    final activeUnit = unit ?? _selectedUnit;
    if (activeUnit?.imageUrl != null &&
        activeUnit!.imageUrl!.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      return activeUnit.imageUrl!.trim();
    }
    if (v?.imageUrl != null && v!.imageUrl!.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      return v.imageUrl!.trim();
    }
    return widget.product.imageUrl;
  }

  String _sizeDisplayFor(ProductVariant? v, {ProductUnit? unit}) {
    final activeUnit = unit ?? _selectedUnit;
    if (activeUnit != null &&
        activeUnit.label.trim() != 'كرتون' &&
        activeUnit.sizeMl != null) {
      final us = activeUnit.sizeMl!;
      return us % 1 == 0 ? '${us.toInt()} مل' : '$us مل';
    }
    if (v?.sizeText != null && v!.sizeText!.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      return v.sizeText!.trim();
    }
    if (widget.product.sizeText != null &&
        widget.product.sizeText!.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      return widget.product.sizeText!.trim();
    }
    final s = activeUnit?.sizeMl ?? v?.sizeMl ?? widget.product.sizeMl;
    if (s != null) {
      return s % 1 == 0 ? '${s.toInt()} مل' : '$s مل';
    }
    return '—';
  }

  int? _itemsFor(ProductVariant? v, {ProductUnit? unit}) {
    final activeUnit = unit ?? _selectedUnit;
    return activeUnit?.qty ??
        v?.itemsPerCarton ??
        widget.product.itemsPerCarton;
  }

  String _formatDate(String? date) {
    if (date == null || date.isEmpty) return '—';
    try {
      final dt = DateTime.parse(date);
      return '${dt.year}/${dt.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/${dt.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
    } catch (_) {
      return date.replaceAll('-', '/');
    }
  }

  void _onVariantChanged(int newIndex) {
    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
    setState(() {
      _variantIndex = newIndex;
      _qty = _qtyForIndex(newIndex);
      _selectedUnit = _unitForIndex(newIndex);
    });
  }

  void _addToCart() {
    final v = _currentVariant;
    final isBaseVariant = v == null || v.id == 'base_default';
    final effectiveVariant = isBaseVariant ? null : v;
    final availableStock = v?.stock ?? widget.product.baseStock;
    if (availableStock <= 0) return;

    final cartonCap = v?.itemsPerCarton ?? widget.product.itemsPerCarton ?? 1;
    final safeCap = cartonCap > 0 ? cartonCap : 1;
    final unitQty = (_selectedUnit?.qty ?? safeCap) > 0
        ? (_selectedUnit?.qty ?? safeCap)
        : 1;

    double usedCartons = 0.0;
    for (final cItem in ref.read(cartProvider).values) {
      if (cItem.product.id == widget.product.id &&
          (cItem.selectedVariant?.id ?? '') == (effectiveVariant?.id ?? '')) {
        final cCap = cItem.selectedVariant?.itemsPerCarton ??
            cItem.product.itemsPerCarton ??
            1;
        final uQty = cItem.selectedUnit?.qty ?? cCap;
        usedCartons += (cItem.quantity * uQty) / (cCap > 0 ? cCap : 1);
      }
    }

    final remainingCartons =
        (availableStock - usedCartons).clamp(0.0, availableStock);
    final maxAddableUnits = ((remainingCartons * safeCap) / unitQty).floor();

    if (maxAddableUnits <= 0) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            'وصلت للحد الأقصى المتوفر في المستودع لهذا الصنف داخل سلتك',
            style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo'),
          ),
          backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final qtyToAdd = _qty > maxAddableUnits ? maxAddableUnits : _qty;
    HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
    ref.read(cartProvider.notifier).addItem(
          widget.product,
          qtyToAdd,
          unit: _selectedUnit,
          variant: effectiveVariant,
        );
    final title = !isBaseVariant
        ? '${v.label} - $_currentUnitLabel'
        : '${widget.product.name} - $_currentUnitLabel';
    Navigator.pop(context);

    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(
          '✅ تمت إضافة $title للسلة',
          style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Cairo'),
          textAlign: TextAlign.right,
        ),
        backgroundColor: AppColors.primary,
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 85),
        duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final product = widget.product;
    final currentVariant = _currentVariant;
    final activeStock = currentVariant?.stock ?? product.baseStock;
    final isOutOfStock = activeStock <= 0;
    final total = _priceFor(currentVariant) * _qty;

    return ConstrainedBox(
      constraints: BoxConstraints(
        maxHeight: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height * 0.90,
      ),
      child: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: context.bgCard,
          borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
        ),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            // مقبض السحب
            Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
              width: 40,
              height: 4,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.grey[400],
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
              ),
            ),

            // شريط الأحجام العلوي القابل للنقر + تلميح السحب
            if (product.hasVariants) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      'الأحجام المتوفرة:',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                        color: context.textSecondary,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const Spacer(),
                    Text(
                      '← اسحب يميناً أو يساراً →',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                        fontSize: 10.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        color: AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.85),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              SizedBox(
                height: 38,
                child: ListView.builder(
                  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
                  itemCount: _effectiveVariants.length,
                  itemBuilder: (_, idx) {
                    final v = _effectiveVariants[idx];
                    final isSel = idx == _variantIndex;
                    final vOut = v.stock <= 0;
                    return GestureDetector(
                      onTap: () {
                        _pageController?.animateToPage(
                          idx,
                          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 280),
                          curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                        );
                      },
                      child: AnimatedContainer(
                        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
                        margin: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(end: 8),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 14, vertical: 6),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: isSel ? AppColors.primary : context.bgInput,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                          border: Border.all(
                            color: isSel
                                ? AppColors.primary
                                : (vOut
                                    ? Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.3)
                                    : context.borderColor),
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: Center(
                          child: Text(
                            vOut ? '${v.label} (نفد)' : v.label,
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                              fontSize: 12,
                              fontWeight:
                                  isSel ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w600,
                              color: isSel
                                  ? Colors.white
                                  : (vOut ? Colors.red : context.textPrimary),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 6),
              Divider(height: 1, color: context.borderColor),
            ],

            // محتوى الصفحة (يدعم السحب الأفقي بالـ PageView عند وجود أحجام متعددة)
            if (product.hasVariants)
              Expanded(
                child: PageView.builder(
                  controller: _pageController,
                  itemCount: _effectiveVariants.length,
                  onPageChanged: _onVariantChanged,
                  itemBuilder: (context, idx) => _buildPageContent(
                    context,
                    product,
                    _effectiveVariants[idx],
                    pageIndex: idx,
                  ),
                ),
              )
            else
              Flexible(
                child: _buildPageContent(context, product, null, pageIndex: 0),
              ),
            // زر الإضافة للسلة الثابت بالأسفل
            Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                  20, 8, 20, MediaQuery.of(context).padding.bottom + 16),
              child: GestureDetector(
                onTap: isOutOfStock ? null : _addToCart,
                child: AnimatedContainer(
                  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
                  width: double.infinity,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: isOutOfStock ? Colors.grey : AppColors.primary,
                    borderRadius: AppRadius.lgAll,
                    boxShadow: isOutOfStock

                              offset: const Offset(0, 5),
                            ),
                          ],
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        isOutOfStock
                            ? Icons.remove_shopping_cart_rounded

                        color: Colors.white,
                        size: 20,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 10),
                      AnimatedSwitcher(
                        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),

                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,

          ],

      ),

  }

  Widget _buildPageContent(
    BuildContext context,
    ProductModel product,
    ProductVariant? v, {
    int pageIndex = 0,
  }) {
    final pageUnit =
        product.hasVariants ? _unitForIndex(pageIndex) : _selectedUnit;
    final pageQty = product.hasVariants ? _qtyForIndex(pageIndex) : _qty;
    final pageUnitLabel = pageUnit?.label ?? 'كرتون';
    final currentImage = _imageFor(v, unit: pageUnit);
    final hasImage = currentImage != null && currentImage.isNotEmpty;
    final currentPrice = pageUnit?.price ?? v?.price ?? product.price;
    final units = (v != null && v.units.isNotEmpty) ? v.units : product.units;
    final currentBarcode = (v?.barcode != null && v!.barcode!.trim().isNotEmpty)
        ? v.barcode!.trim()
        : (pageUnit?.barcode != null && pageUnit!.barcode!.trim().isNotEmpty)
            ? pageUnit.barcode!.trim()
            : product.barcode;
    final currentStock = v?.stock ?? product.baseStock;
    final currentProduction = pageUnit?.productionDate ??
        v?.productionDate ??
        DateTime.tryParse(product.productionDate ?? '');
    final currentExpiry = pageUnit?.expiryDate ??
        v?.expiryDate ??
        DateTime.tryParse(product.expiryDate ?? '');
    final isExpiringSoon = currentExpiry != null &&
        currentExpiry.isBefore(DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 30)));
    final isCustomVariant = v != null && v.id != 'base_default';
    final titleText = isCustomVariant
        ? '${v.label} - $pageUnitLabel'
        : '${product.name} - $pageUnitLabel';
    return SingleChildScrollView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 16, 20, 8),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Container(
                width: 100,
                height: 100,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: context.bgInput,
                  borderRadius: AppRadius.lgAll,
                  border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
                ),
                child: ClipRRect(
                  borderRadius: AppRadius.lgAll,
                  child: hasImage
                      ? CachedNetworkImage(
                          cacheManager:
                              ImagePrecacheService.instance.cacheManager,
                          imageUrl: currentImage,
                          fit: BoxFit.contain,
                          placeholder: (_, __) => const Icon(
                            Icons.shopping_bag_outlined,
                            color: Colors.grey,
                            size: 40,
                          ),
                          errorWidget: (_, __, ___) => const Icon(
                            Icons.shopping_bag_outlined,
                            color: AppColors.primary,
                            size: 40,
                          ),
                        )
                      : const Icon(
                          Icons.shopping_bag_outlined,
                          color: AppColors.primary,
                          size: 40,
                        ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 14),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      titleText,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                        fontSize: 16,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                        color: context.textPrimary,
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (product.description != null &&
                        product.description!.isNotEmpty) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      Text(
                        product.description!,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                          fontSize: 12,
                          color: context.textSecondary,
                        ),
                        maxLines: 2,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      ),
                    ],
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                        borderRadius: AppRadius.circleAll,
                      ),
                      child: Text(
                        '${currentPrice.toStringAsFixed(0)} ر.ي / $pageUnitLabel',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                          fontSize: 15,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                          color: AppColors.primary,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),

          if (units.isNotEmpty) ...[
            Text(
              'اختر الكمية / الوحدة المطلوبة:',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                fontSize: 14,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                color: context.textPrimary,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Wrap(
              spacing: 10,
              runSpacing: 10,
              children: units.map((unit) {
                final selected = pageUnit?.label == unit.label;
                return GestureDetector(
                  onTap: () {
                    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                    setState(() {
                      if (product.hasVariants) {
                        _variantUnits[pageIndex] = unit;
                        if (pageIndex == _variantIndex) {
                          _selectedUnit = unit;
                        }

                    duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),

                            selected ? AppColors.primary : context.borderColor,
                        width: selected ? 1.5 : 1,
                      ),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      '${unit.label} (${unit.price.toStringAsFixed(0)} ر.ي)',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                        fontSize: 13,
                        fontWeight:
                            selected ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w600,
                        color: selected ? Colors.white : context.textPrimary,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              }).toList(),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
          ],

          Container(
            width: double.infinity,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: context.bgInput,
              borderRadius: AppRadius.lgAll,
              border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),

              children: [
                if (currentBarcode != null && currentBarcode.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  _InfoTile(
                    icon: Icons.qr_code_2_rounded,
                    label: 'الباركود الموحد',

                    valueColor: AppColors.primary,
                  ),
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 12),

                  ),
                  _divider(context),
                ],
                _InfoTile(
                  icon: Icons.straighten_rounded,
                  label: 'الحجم',

                _divider(context),
                _InfoTile(
                  icon: Icons.layers_rounded,

                  valueColor: currentStock <= 0 ? Colors.red : null,
                ),
                _divider(context),

                  icon: Icons.calendar_month_rounded,

                  value: currentProduction == null
                      ? '—'
                      : _formatDate(currentProduction.toIso8601String()),
                ),
                _divider(context),
                _InfoTile(
                  icon: Icons.event_busy_rounded,
                  label: 'تاريخ الانتهاء',
                  value: currentExpiry == null
                      ? '—'
                      : _formatDate(currentExpiry.toIso8601String()),
                  valueColor: isExpiringSoon ? Colors.red : null,
                  badge: isExpiringSoon ? 'ينتهي قريباً' : null,
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
// عداد الكمية (مقيد بالمخزون المتاح)
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              _QtyBtn(
                icon: Icons.remove_rounded,
                onTap: () {
                  if (pageQty > 1) {
                    setState(() {
                      final next = pageQty - 1;
                      if (product.hasVariants) {
                        _variantQtys[pageIndex] = next;
                        if (pageIndex == _variantIndex) _qty = next;
                      } else {
                        _qty = next;
                      }
                    });
                  }
                },
              ),
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24),
                child: AnimatedSwitcher(
                  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
                  transitionBuilder: (child, anim) =>
                      ScaleTransition(scale: anim, child: child),
                  child: Text(
                    '$pageQty',
                    key: ValueKey('${pageIndex}_$pageQty'),
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                      fontSize: 28,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                      color: context.textPrimary,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              _QtyBtn(
                icon: Icons.add_rounded,
                onTap: () {
                  final cartonCap =
                      (v?.itemsPerCarton ?? product.itemsPerCarton ?? 1)
                          .clamp(1, 9999);
                  final unitQty = (pageUnit?.qty ?? cartonCap).clamp(1, 9999);
                  final maxUnits = ((currentStock * cartonCap) / unitQty)
                      .floor()
                      .clamp(1, 999);
                  if (currentStock > 0 && pageQty < maxUnits) {
                    setState(() {
                      final next = pageQty + 1;
                      if (product.hasVariants) {
                        _variantQtys[pageIndex] = next;
                        if (pageIndex == _variantIndex) _qty = next;
                      } else {
                        _qty = next;
                      }
                    });
                  }
                },
                filled: true,
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _divider(BuildContext context) =>
      Divider(height: 1, color: context.borderColor);
}

class _BarcodeVisualBox extends StatelessWidget {
  final String barcode;
  const _BarcodeVisualBox({required this.barcode});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      width: double.infinity,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade300, width: 1.2),
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          CustomPaint(
            size: const Size(double.infinity, 48),
            painter: _BarcodePainter(code: barcode),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          Text(
            barcode.split('').join('  '),
            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontFamily: 'Cairo',
              fontSize: 12.5,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
              letterSpacing: 1.5,
              color: Color(0xFF1A1A2E),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _BarcodePainter extends CustomPainter {
  final String code;
  _BarcodePainter({required this.code});

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final paint = Paint()
      ..color = Colors.black
      ..style = PaintingStyle.fill;

    final width = size.width;
    final height = size.height;
    final hashValues = code.codeUnits;
    const totalBars = 55;
    final barUnitWidth = width / totalBars;

    for (int i = 0; i < totalBars; i++) {
      final isGuard = (i < 3) || (i > totalBars - 4) || (i >= 26 && i <= 28);
      final charVal = hashValues[i % hashValues.length];
      final isBlack = isGuard || ((charVal + i * 7) % 3 != 0);

      if (isBlack) {
        final barHeight = isGuard ? height : height * 0.88;
        canvas.drawRect(
          Rect.fromLTWH(i * barUnitWidth, 0, barUnitWidth * 0.78, barHeight),
          paint,
        );
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant CustomPainter oldDelegate) => false;
}

import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import '../../../../core/services/app_cache.dart';
import '../../../../core/services/image_precache_service.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:wissal/core/utils/arabic_normalizer.dart';
import 'package:firebase_crashlytics/firebase_crashlytics.dart'; // ✅ إضافة استيراد Crashlytics

final _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;
final _cache = <String, _CachedSearchResult>{};

class _CachedSearchResult {
  final SearchResult result;
  final DateTime cachedAt;

  const _CachedSearchResult(this.result, this.cachedAt);
}

class SearchResult {
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> products;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> brands;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> categories;

  const SearchResult({
    required this.products,
    required this.brands,
    required this.categories,
  });

  bool get isEmpty => products.isEmpty && brands.isEmpty && categories.isEmpty;
}

class SearchService {
  static const _cacheTtl = Duration(seconds: 30);

  Future<SearchResult> search(String query) async {
    final q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (q.isEmpty) {
      return const SearchResult(products: [], brands: [], categories: []);
    }

    final cached = _cache[q];
    if (cached != null &&
        DateTime.now().difference(cached.cachedAt) < _cacheTtl) {
      return cached.result;
    }
    _cache.remove(q);

    // 1. البحث الفوري المحلي في الذاكرة (0ms)
    final localResult = _searchLocally(q);
    if (localResult != null && !localResult.isEmpty) {
      _putInCache(q, localResult);
      unawaited(_fetchAndUpdateCache(q));
      return localResult;
    }

    final serverResult = await _fetchAndUpdateCache(q);
    _putInCache(q, serverResult);
    return serverResult;
  }

  void _putInCache(String query, SearchResult result) {
    if (_cache.length >= 60) {
      final now = DateTime.now();
      _cache.removeWhere(
        (_, entry) => now.difference(entry.cachedAt) >= _cacheTtl,
      );
      if (_cache.length >= 60) _cache.clear();
    }
    _cache[query] = _CachedSearchResult(result, DateTime.now());
  }

  static String normalizeArabic(String text) =>
      ArabicNormalizer.normalize(text);

  static bool _matchesTokens(String target, List<String> tokens) =>
      ArabicNormalizer.matches(target, tokens);
  SearchResult? _searchLocally(String q) {
    final cache = AppCache.instance;
    final allProducts = cache.getAllCachedProducts();
    final allCategories = cache.getCategories() ?? [];
    final allBrands = cache.getBrands() ?? [];

    if (allProducts.isEmpty && allCategories.isEmpty && allBrands.isEmpty) {
      return null;
    }

    final tokens =
        normalizeArabic(q).split(' ').where((t) => t.isNotEmpty).toList();
    if (tokens.isEmpty) return null;

    final products = allProducts
        .where((p) {
          if (p['is_deleted'] == true || p['is_active'] == false) return false;
          final name = p['name']?.toString() ?? '';
          if (_matchesTokens(name, tokens)) return true;
          return _matchesBarcode(p, q);
        })
        .take(30)
        .toList();
    final brands = allBrands
        .where((b) {
          if (b['is_deleted'] == true || b['is_active'] == false) return false;
          return _matchesTokens(b['name']?.toString() ?? '', tokens);
        })
        .take(15)
        .toList();

    final categories = allCategories
        .where((c) {
          if (c['is_deleted'] == true || c['is_active'] == false) return false;
          return _matchesTokens(c['name']?.toString() ?? '', tokens);
        })
        .take(10)
        .toList();

    return SearchResult(
      products: products,
      brands: brands,
      categories: categories,
    );
  }

  Future<SearchResult> _fetchAndUpdateCache(String q) async {
    final tokens =
        normalizeArabic(q).split(' ').where((t) => t.isNotEmpty).toList();
    // Firestore stores the original product names; normalize only after retrieval.
    final firstToken = q.split(RegExp(r'\s+')).first;
    final prefixesToQuery = <String>{firstToken};
    if (firstToken.isNotEmpty) {
      prefixesToQuery
          .add(firstToken[0].toUpperCase() + firstToken.substring(1));
    }
    if (firstToken.startsWith('ا') ||
        firstToken.startsWith('أ') ||
        firstToken.startsWith('إ') ||
        firstToken.startsWith('آ')) {
      final rest = firstToken.substring(1);
      prefixesToQuery.addAll(['ا$rest', 'أ$rest', 'إ$rest', 'آ$rest']);
    }

    final cleanBarcode = ArabicNormalizer.normalizeDigits(q)
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9a-zA-Z]'), '')
        .trim();

    final results = await Future.wait([
      _safeQuery('products', () async {
        final combinedDocs = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
        if (cleanBarcode.isNotEmpty) {
          final barcodeVariants = <String>{
            cleanBarcode,
            cleanBarcode.toLowerCase(),
            cleanBarcode.toUpperCase(),
          }.toList();
          final barcodeQuery = await _db
              .collection('products')
              .where('all_barcodes', arrayContainsAny: barcodeVariants)
              .limit(15)
              .get(const GetOptions(source: Source.serverAndCache));
          for (final d in barcodeQuery.docs) {
            if (d.data()['is_deleted'] != true &&
                d.data()['is_active'] != false) {
              combinedDocs[d.id] = {'id': d.id, ...d.data()};
            }
          }
        }

        await Future.wait(prefixesToQuery.map((pfx) async {
          final matchedList = await _fetchNameMatches(
            collectionName: 'products',
            prefix: pfx,
            tokens: tokens,
            resultLimit: 30,
          );
          for (final product in matchedList) {
            combinedDocs[product['id'].toString()] = product;
          }
        }));

        final filteredList = combinedDocs.values.where((p) {
          final name = p['name']?.toString() ?? '';
          return _matchesTokens(name, tokens) || _matchesBarcode(p, q);
        }).toList();

        ImagePrecacheService.instance.prewarmProducts(filteredList);
        return filteredList.take(30).toList();
      }),
      _safeQuery('brands', () async {
        final combined = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
        await Future.wait(prefixesToQuery.map((pfx) async {
          final items = await _fetchNameMatches(
            collectionName: 'brands',
            prefix: pfx,
            tokens: tokens,
            resultLimit: 15,
          );
          for (final item in items) {
            combined[item['id'].toString()] = item;
          }
        }));
        final list = combined.values.take(15).toList();
        ImagePrecacheService.instance.prewarmBrands(list);
        return list;
      }),
      _safeQuery('categories', () async {
        final combined = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
        await Future.wait(prefixesToQuery.map((pfx) async {
          final items = await _fetchNameMatches(
            collectionName: 'categories',
            prefix: pfx,
            tokens: tokens,
            resultLimit: 10,
          );
          for (final item in items) {
            combined[item['id'].toString()] = item;
          }
        }));
        final list = combined.values.take(10).toList();
        ImagePrecacheService.instance.prewarmCategories(list);
        return list;
      }),
    ]);
    final result = SearchResult(
      products: results[0],
      brands: results[1],
      categories: results[2],
    );

    _putInCache(q, result);
    return result;
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _fetchNameMatches({
    required String collectionName,
    required String prefix,
    required List<String> tokens,
    required int resultLimit,
  }) async {
    const pageSize = 60;
    final collection = _db.collection(collectionName);
    final matches = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
    DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? cursor;

    // 1. البحث السحابي المباشر بالبادئة الأولى
    while (matches.length < resultLimit) {
      Query<Map<String, dynamic>> query = collection
          .where('name', isGreaterThanOrEqualTo: prefix)
          .where('name', isLessThanOrEqualTo: '$prefix\uf8ff')
          .orderBy('name')
          .limit(pageSize);
      if (cursor != null) query = query.startAfterDocument(cursor);

      final page =
          await query.get(const GetOptions(source: Source.serverAndCache));
      if (page.docs.isEmpty) break;

      for (final doc in page.docs) {
        final data = doc.data();
        if (data['is_deleted'] == true || data['is_active'] == false) {
          continue;
        }
        final product = {'id': doc.id, ...data};
        if (_matchesTokens(data['name']?.toString() ?? '', tokens)) {
          matches[doc.id] = product;
          if (matches.length >= resultLimit) break;
        }
      }

      if (matches.length >= resultLimit || page.docs.length < pageSize) break;
      cursor = page.docs.last;
    }
// 2. بحث موسع مطبّع في الكاش ثم دفعة السيرفر (للكلمات الوسطى واختلاف ة/ه وى/ي)
    if (matches.length < resultLimit) {
      final cachedList = switch (collectionName) {
        'products' => AppCache.instance.getAllCachedProducts(),
        'brands' => AppCache.instance.getBrands() ?? const [],
        'categories' => AppCache.instance.getCategories() ?? const [],
        _ => const <Map<String, dynamic>>[],
      };

      for (final item in cachedList) {
        if (item['is_deleted'] == true || item['is_active'] == false) {
          continue;
        }
        if (_matchesTokens(item['name']?.toString() ?? '', tokens)) {
          matches[item['id'].toString()] = item;
          if (matches.length >= resultLimit) break;
        }
      }

      if (matches.length < resultLimit) {
        final fallbackLimit = collectionName == 'products' ? 300 : 150;
        final fallbackSnap = await collection
            .where('is_deleted', isEqualTo: false)
            .limit(fallbackLimit)
            .get(const GetOptions(source: Source.serverAndCache));
        for (final doc in fallbackSnap.docs) {
          final data = doc.data();
          if (data['is_active'] == false) continue;
          if (_matchesTokens(data['name']?.toString() ?? '', tokens)) {
            matches[doc.id] = {'id': doc.id, ...data};
            if (matches.length >= resultLimit) break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return matches.values.toList(growable: false);
  }

  bool _matchesBarcode(Map<String, dynamic> product, String query) {
    final cleanQ = ArabicNormalizer.normalizeDigits(query).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (cleanQ.isEmpty) return false;

    bool matches(Object? value) =>
        value?.toString().trim().toLowerCase().contains(cleanQ) ?? false;

    if (matches(product['barcode'])) return true;
    final barcodes = product['all_barcodes'];
    if (barcodes is List && barcodes.any(matches)) return true;
    final units = product['units'];
    if (units is List &&
        units.any((unit) => unit is Map && matches(unit['barcode']))) {
      return true;
    }
    final variants = product['variants'];
    return variants is List &&
        variants.any((v) =>
            v is Map &&
            (matches(v['barcode']) ||
                (v['units'] is List &&
                    (v['units'] as List)
                        .any((vu) => vu is Map && matches(vu['barcode'])))));
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _safeQuery(
    String tableName,
    Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> Function() query,
  ) async {
    try {
      return await query();
    } catch (e, st) {
      if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('SEARCH ERROR [$tableName]: $e');
      if (!kIsWeb) {
        FirebaseCrashlytics.instance
            .recordError(e, st, reason: 'Search query error in $tableName');
      }
      return [];
    }
  }

  static void clearCache() => _cache.clear();
}

final searchServiceProvider = Provider<SearchService>((ref) => SearchService());
final searchQueryProvider = StateProvider<String>((ref) => '');

final searchResultsProvider = StreamProvider.autoDispose
    .family<SearchResult, String>((ref, query) async* {
  final cleanQ = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (cleanQ.isEmpty) {
    yield const SearchResult(products: [], brands: [], categories: []);
    return;
  }

  final cached = _cache[cleanQ];
  if (cached != null &&
      DateTime.now().difference(cached.cachedAt) < SearchService._cacheTtl) {
    yield cached.result;
    return;
  }

  final service = ref.read(searchServiceProvider);
  final local = service._searchLocally(cleanQ);
  if (local != null && !local.isEmpty) {
    yield local;
  }

  final fresh = await service._fetchAndUpdateCache(cleanQ);
  if (!fresh.isEmpty || local == null || local.isEmpty) {
    yield fresh;
  }
});

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../../../core/constants/app_radius.dart';

class CategoriesSkeleton extends StatefulWidget {
  final int itemCount;

  const CategoriesSkeleton({
    super.key,
    this.itemCount = 9,
  });

  @override
  State<CategoriesSkeleton> createState() => _CategoriesSkeletonState();
}

class _CategoriesSkeletonState extends State<CategoriesSkeleton>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _controller;
  late Animation<double> _animation;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 900),
    )..repeat(reverse: true);

    _animation = Tween<double>(begin: 0.3, end: 1.0).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(parent: _controller, curve: Curves.easeInOut),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _animation,
      builder: (context, _) {
        return GridView.builder(
          shrinkWrap: true,
          physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
          gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
            crossAxisCount: 3,
            crossAxisSpacing: 12,
            mainAxisSpacing: 12,
            childAspectRatio: 0.85,
          ),
          itemCount: widget.itemCount,
          itemBuilder: (_, index) {
            // تأخير متتالي لكل بطاقة
            final delay = (index % 3) * 0.1;
            final opacity = (_animation.value - delay).clamp(0.2, 1.0);

            return Opacity(
              opacity: opacity,
              child: Container(
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  borderRadius: AppRadius.lgAll,
                  boxShadow: [
                    BoxShadow(
                      color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.04),
                      blurRadius: 8,
                      offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    // دائرة الأيقونة
                    Container(
                      width: 52,
                      height: 52,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.grey[100],
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                    // سطر النص
                    Container(
                      width: 50,
                      height: 10,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.grey[200],
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 5),
                    // سطر نص أصغر
                    Container(
                      width: 32,
                      height: 8,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.grey[100],
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }
}
